Job Description & Summary
A career within General Consulting services, will provide you with the opportunity to help clients seize essential advantages by working alongside business leaders to solve their toughest problems and capture their greatest opportunities. We work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever changing environment. We help create sustainable change by stimulating innovation, unlocking data possibilities, navigating risk and regulatory complexity, optimising deals, and aligning costs with business strategy to create a competitive advantage.
To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose-led and values-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.
As an Associate, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:
• Use feedback and reflection to develop self awareness, personal strengths and address development areas.
• Delegate to others to provide stretch opportunities, coaching them to deliver results.
• Demonstrate critical thinking and the ability to bring order to unstructured problems.
• Use a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from current industry or sector trends.
• Review your work and that of others for quality, accuracy and relevance.
• Know how and when to use tools available for a given situation and can explain the reasons for this choice.
• Seek and embrace opportunities which give exposure to different situations, environments and perspectives.
• Use straightforward communication, in a structured way, when influencing and connecting with others.
• Able to read situations and modify behavior to build quality relationships.
• Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-BS-HC
description:
Summary
 Position Summary 
Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)
 At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.  We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.  But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.  Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation.  If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move. The team
Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy & Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
 Work you will do 
Deloitte’s ‘Healthcare Strategy’ team helps companies (providers, payers, pharmacies, etc.) address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
•  Identify strategies for growth and value creation
•  Develop the appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
•  Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies
Required Experience And Skills
 Strategy-specific experience: 
 Enterprise and Growth Strategy – Health Care 
•  Experience working for / with corporate strategy teams of leading companies in the US Provider and/or US Payor/Health Plan/PBM industries, OR Consulting experience serving Healthcare clients
•  Hands-on exposure of one or more of the following: Payer, Provider, Market access, Enrolment, Distribution, Network, Claims service, Population health management, Value based care in a consulting / advisory role
•  Interest and knowledge about the current trends in Healthcare space, especially pertaining to the US market
•  Understanding of the Medicare, Medicaid and Commercial payer businesses
•  Exposure to working in non-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders is a plus
•  Ability to generate leading market insights from market data
•  Certifications in healthcare domain (AHM 250/500, HIPAA etc.) are a plus
Core Consulting Skills
•  Ability to develop understanding of new topics quickly; conduct targeted research and derive insights relevant for client
•  Clear and concise communication – ability to articulate thoughts well, ask relevant questions – be able to participate in team discussions (both internally and with clients)
•  Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members, conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
•  Analytical thinking - ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
•  Logical structuring - structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
•  Deadline-oriented and quality focused - develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
•  Collaboration - Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
•  Network - ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization
 Qualifications Required:
•  MBA or other Master’s degree from a premier (Tier-1) school in India or abroad
•  3 - 7 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA), with focus on Healthcare sector
Our purpose
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
Our people and culture
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
Professional development
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
Benefits To Help You Thrive
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
Recruiting tips
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Manager - BTS
description:
Description
Company Profile:
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
Team Profile
Alvarez & Marsal’s BTS team works with healthy and distressed middle market PE firms as well as with mid-to-large cap companies with growth aspirations and profitability / efficiency related challenges.
The team works as partners to develop and execute restructuring plans. It provides liquidity assessment, business plan evaluation, creditworthiness assessment, & stakeholder negotiation services to clients. The BTS team helps client’s effect positive change, manage risk and unlock value.
BTS also offers detailed due diligence, financial analysis and valuation, liquidity management, business plan development, investment / market entry solutions, revenue enhancement solutions, supply chain & operations improvement, and digital transformation.
BTS team consists of highly trained and experienced cross disciplinary advisors with strategy, operations, finance, IT and legal backgrounds.
The practice covers varied sectors such as Transportation & Logistics, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food & Agri, Healthcare, Financial Services, Automotive, Energy, Digital & Tech, Industrial Goods, Aviation, Metals & Mining, Real Estate, Retail.
How Will You Contribute
Delivery Excellence
• Do in-depth research and generate reliable data
• Distill insights from analyses by identifying second order implications
• Systematically break down the problem into relevant focus areas
• Develop a quick understanding of clients’ businesses and its derivers and leverages the same for project delivery
• Discern patterns of complex diligence matters and provide accurate understanding
Project Management
• Plan and execute tasks effectively by prioritizing various activities with team
• Meticulous attention to detail, a sense of curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, and a dedication to customer satisfaction
• Collaborate with colleagues, identify and implement opportunities for improved effectiveness, efficiency and risk mitigation
• Capture and record time and costs incurred on each project every week
• Ensure the timely delivery of work allocated
• Ensure timely actions on feedback by clients/Senior Manager/Director
Client Management
• Interact with clients and seniors independently and effectively
• Set clear and unambiguous expectations on deliverables
• Manage client expectations and make changes accordingly
• Earn client’s trust by displaying superior work ethic with utmost importance on client confidentiality
• Satisfy client expectations by delivering superior quality work
Communication
• Articulate ideas in confident and concise manner
• Engage audience by responding effectively & succinctly
• Prepares high-quality slides and decks
• Narrative building capability to distill complex ideas into a compelling story
Basic Qualifications
• MBA or equivalent master’s degree in finance, Statistics, Economics or Mathematics from premium institutes required.
Experience Required
• Relevant consulting experience OR industry experience at a renowned corporate in strategy / Consumer Due diligence / ODD / Transformation / Performance Improvement.
• Experience in turnaround / distress situations advisory, interim management roles, operational restructuring environment
Your Journey At A&M
• We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
• We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Manager Corporate Strategy
description:
Must have skills: Corporate growth and Strategy
Good to have skills: Corporate Strategy, Growth strategy, Business Case, Market entry, Market expansion, Pricing
Role Summary-
The candidate should possess post-MBA experience in driving strategic initiatives across one or more of the following areas: Corporate Strategy, Growth Strategy, Business Case Development, Market Entry and Expansion, Pricing and Profit Optimization, Innovation-led Growth, Strategic Planning, Customer Strategy, Value Realization, Sales Acceleration, and Channel Transformation. The role demands strong analytical capabilities, stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to deliver impactful business outcomes.
Roles & Responsibilities:
• Corporate Strategy & Growth : Accelerate measurable and sustained growth for clients with an unrivaled set of data-driven capabilities from strategy to execution.
• Mergers & Acquisitions: Support clients in their inorganic growth agenda across the deal lifecycle, i.e., target screening, synergy assessment, due diligence, post-merger integration and portfolio interventions.
• Operating Model & Org Design: Partner with CEOs to architect future proof operating models embracing future of work, workforce and workplace powered by transformational technology, ecosystems and analytics.
• Sustainability & Responsible Business: Work with our ecosystem partners, help clients reach their sustainability goals through digital transformation.
Professional & Technical Skills: 
 Strategic Thinking: Proven ability to develop and execute Corporate and Growth Strategies aligned with business goals.
 Business Case Development: Experience in building and evaluating business cases for new initiatives, investments, or market opportunities.
 Market Entry & Expansion: Knowledge of go-to-market strategies, competitive analysis, and market dynamics for domestic and international expansion.
 Pricing & Profit Optimization: Familiarity with pricing strategies, margin analysis, and financial modeling to drive profitability.
 Innovation & Growth Initiatives: Ability to identify growth levers and lead innovation-driven initiatives.
 Strategic Planning: Strong experience in annual/long-term planning, OKRs/KPIs setting, and performance tracking.
 Customer Strategy & Value Realization: Experience with customer segmentation, journey mapping, and value realization frameworks.
Additional Information
• MBA from a tier 1 institute
•  Experience in one or more of the following: Corporate Strategy, Growth strategy, Business Case, Market entry, Market expansion, Pricing and Profit Optimization, Growth and Innovation, Strategic Planning, Customer Strategy, Value Realization, Sales Acceleration, Channel Transformation

description:

As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we hire and develop the most passionate people in their field to help build a better working world. This starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom. At EY, we don't just focus on who you are now, but who you can become. We believe that it’s your career and ‘It’s yours to build’ which means potential here is limitless and we'll provide you with motivating and fulfilling experiences throughout your career to help you on the path to becoming your best professional self.
The opportunity : Project Manager-GOV-Business Consulting PI-CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery - New Delhi
GOV :
Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. We actively focus on building solutions that help public sector entities face the challenges of the future and reinvent themselves.
Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.
CNS - BC - Transformation Delivery :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a m?ultidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations’ performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.
Your Key Responsibilities
Technical Excellence
• Strong understanding of the MSME ecosystem, including policy landscape, sector challenges, and growth enablers. Proven experience in government consulting engagements with exposure to public sector transformation initiatives. Ability to support strategy, diagnostics, and program design for MSME-focused government projects. Skilled in conducting research, analyzing data, and translating findings into actionable consulting outputs. Capable of preparing high-quality presentations, reports, and recommendations for stakeholders in government and consulting contexts.
Skills And Attributes
To qualify for the role you must have
Qualification
• Post Graduate Diploma in Management
• Master of Business Administration
Experience
• business consulting
What We Look For
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
What We Offer
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. As an organization, we are investing more time, technology, and money than ever before in skills and learning for our people. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

• Experience applying project management methodologies to oversee workstreams and complex initiatives.

title: Project Leader- Healthcare (MedTech)
description:
ABOUT US:  
Bain & Company is a global consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property.
WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:
This is a full-time position based in Bain’s Gurugram office and forms an integral part of the Healthcare & Life Sciences Centre of Expertise (HLS CoE). The HLS CoE provides specialized support to global consulting teams across the healthcare and life sciences value chain, enabling clients to make strategic business and investment decisions. The team partners closely with case teams as a thought-partner, delivering high-quality, industry-specific analytical products and expertise to address the most critical strategic questions facing Bain’s healthcare clients.
The HLS practice serves leading organizations across Pharmaceuticals, MedTech, Providers, Payers, Global Health, and Digital Health. As part of the HLS CoE, you will collaborate with teams across all major regions (EMEA, Americas, and APAC) in a fast-paced, dynamic environment—working closely with global Bain teams to deliver impactful results for our clients.
Role:
We are looking for a high performing Project Leader to lead a team of 3-4 members focused on MedTech (Medical Devices, Equipment’s, OEMs, Distribution etc.) as a subsector with HLS. A Project Leader (PL) is responsible for ensuring high quality delivery of projects while building strong client relationships and providing day to day coaching and mentoring to team members. The PL works with his/her team to build direction and work-plan, approach to problem solving, hypothesis generation by leveraging the research toolkit. 
 In this role, you will lead a team comprising Associates and Analysts to deliver high-impact, client-ready proposals, case specific outputs, and go-to-market materials. You will also support the development of intellectual property (IP), thought leadership, and Bain’s internal capabilities. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, understanding of healthcare landscape, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across levels. The PL is also expected to participate in office initiatives such as recruiting, training, and business strategy.
Key responsibilities
• Lead a case/ proposal engagement for our MedTech clients
• Collaborate with Partners/case teams to deliver active cases and develop proposals with domain specific insights in a client ready format
• Engage with Practice leadership on evolving IP/existing products; and ideate in developing new products/IP for Healthcare clients
• Build a strong understanding of MedTech IPs and concepts within the team
• Drive structured problem solving and storytelling for client situations and ensure alignment with Bain’s quality standards
• Provide direct, day-to-day management to a group of 3-4 team members with limited guidance from the Manager
• Ensuring timely, high-quality delivery to clients through effective team management; creating hypothesis; defining deliverables and design outputs; drawing the structure and plan; prioritizing and setting daily timelines; reviewing the team’s output, providing feedback and ensuring quality control
• Identify and proactively engage on critical issues on projects and with clients; proactively resolve problems, remove roadblocks, and escalate issues as needed
• Is proficient at identifying and using the relevant analytical tools and ensures zero-defect in all work streams and ensures quality work delivery; Wherever needed, leverages advanced tools (Tableau, Alteryx, Python, R, SPSS) to improve team efficiency
• Foster collaboration with other BCN and global teams to ensure knowledge sharing
• Own and maintain client relationships
• Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations.
• Communicate data, knowledge, and clearly explain insights and implications for the client to the entire team; Generate and screen realistic answers based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions. 
• Effectively manage client and team meetings and deliver clear and professional presentations to the team, team leaders and managers/partners across the Bain system.
• Exerts strong positive influence over developing and retaining top talent 
• Develop professional development plans, provide coaching/training, recognize accomplishments of direct reports
• Provides day-to-day coaching on work-planning, problem solving, hypothesis generation and research toolkit
• Ability to build connect with the team members through a trust-based relationship at all levels is a must. Acts as a role model and brand ambassador of the Bain culture
• Constructively engages in mutual feedback process with supervisor and direct reportees; provides concrete, regular and actionable feedback
• Deliver performance reviews and recommends ratings
ABOUT YOU: 
1. Experience & Education
• Undergraduate degree (bachelor’s in medicine, pharma, Biomedical, Biotechnology engineering or other science/medical related fields) with 5–8 years of relevant experience in a global professional services environment, with exposure to business research, analytics, and consulting in the MedTech/Healthcare domain
• Postgraduate degree (master’s or equivalent) with 3–6 years of relevant experience in MedTech consulting services
• Strong academic track record and demonstrated analytical excellence
• Proven experience in consulting or proposal development, preferably within the Healthcare and Life Sciences domain
2. Leadership & Team Management
• Demonstrated ability to manage and motivate teams, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality outputs under tight deadlines
• Maturity to lead by example, balancing attention to detail with effective delegation
• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and geographies
3. Core Skills & Personal Attributes
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to drive senior client and stakeholder discussions
• Ability to deal with ambiguity and translate open-ended ideas into practical, actionable results
• A strong team player with proven interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted working relationships
• Proficient in both written and spoken English
4. Domain & Technical Expertise
• Deep expertise across the MedTech value chain, including market dynamics, customer segments, regulatory and reimbursement environments, key OEMs, portfolio optimization, and growth and competitive strategy, with a strong end-to-end perspective on the sector
• Experience leading MedTech strategy engagements, including growth strategy, portfolio rationalization, M&A commercial diligence, and post-merger integration
• Ability to translate clinical, technical, and regulatory complexity into clear, actionable strategic insights for senior executives
• Strong understanding of MedTech commercialization and operating models, including pricing, go-to-market design, sales force effectiveness, and lifecycle management
• Strong analytical, problem-structuring, and project management capabilities, with advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint to deliver structured, high-impact outputs
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Manager- BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
What You'll Do
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's India PIPE Practice Area, you will work in a growing team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain-specific data and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute to cases through thought partnership in your area of expertise, deliver original analyses and insights helping drive strong impact with clients. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected to understand client requirements, and design / develop solutions.
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, providing insights & advice for proposals and client workshops. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you may lead development of intellectual property & assets for the business and mentor and guide junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise.
BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area is one of the firm's largest and fastest-growing practices, working with the world's leading investment firms across the full deal and value-creation lifecycle — from thesis generation and commercial due diligence through 100-day planning, hold-period value creation, and exit readiness.
To succeed in this environment, our teams blend deep investor perspective with digital and human capabilities, bringing rigorous diligence discipline, portfolio operating expertise, and proprietary data and tools to every engagement. You will support commercialization efforts across PIPE topics and asset classes — contributing diligence-ready analysis, benchmarking, and insights to proposals, investment committee materials, client workshops, and marketing content
What You'll Bring
•  3+ years consulting experience in relevant PIPE required, candidates with private equity, investment banking, or transaction advisory consulting experience preferred
•  In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required (e.g., private equity, investment banking, corporate development, portfolio operations); 5-8+ years of relevant industry experience strongly preferred
•  Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree, e.g., MBA or CFA, preferred)
•  Fluency in English; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
•  Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholders — including deal teams, investor clients, and portfolio company executives — while working in a collaborative team environment
•  Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g., APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the diligence and analytics landscape evolves
•  Familiarity with investor workflows and terminology (e.g., LOIs, IC memos, LBO mechanics, value creation plans, GP/LP reporting) a strong plus
•  Strong problem solving skills
Who You'll Work With
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants in India, for India. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
Additional info
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)
•  Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets
Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)
•  Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients
Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)
•  Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data
YOU'RE GOOD AT
•  Solving complex investor and portfolio-company problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions across one or more PIPE topic areas or asset classes (e.g., commercial due diligence, value creation, exit readiness, private credit, infrastructure investing)
•  Engaging senior stakeholders and client team members, delivering targeted communication based on stakeholder settings - deal partners, portfolio operating executives, and investor clients — demonstrating the ability to engage a sophisticated, deal-focused audience effectively
•  Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance diligence quality, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable and knowledge frameworks tailored to investor workflows
•  Managing projects with ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating business sense and adaptability
•  Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
•  Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

description:
Job Title: Senior Associate – GDN Advisory
Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
Experience: 4–7 years of relevant post MBA experience 
About the Company
Alvarez & Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance, create value and accelerate results. Founded in 1983, A&M is recognized for its entrepreneurial, action-oriented culture and hands-on approach to client problems. Its professionals work as independent thinkers and operators, combining practical execution with deep advisory expertise across industries and geographies. A&M’s Global Capability Center in India, established in 2023, partners with business units and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC to deliver end-to-end client work, not only back-office support. The rapidly growing center brings together consulting and industry professionals across Consumer & Retail, Healthcare, Software & Technology, Automotive & Industrials, Hospitality & Leisure, Energy & Natural Resources and Financial Services. Guided by Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward and Inclusive Diversity, A&M focuses on leadership, action and results while creating measurable value for clients and stakeholders.
About the Role
As a Senior Associate in GDN Advisory, you will lead consulting workstreams that help organizations design, launch and optimize Global Business Services and Global Capability Center models. You will translate strategic priorities into practical operating models, business cases, transition plans and transformation roadmaps that improve service quality, efficiency and enterprise value. Working with A&M leaders, client executives and cross-functional teams, you will own analysis, solution design and client-ready deliverables across global markets and industries. The role combines structured problem solving with hands-on implementation, requiring confidence in senior stakeholder discussions and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. You will also strengthen the practice through mentoring, proposal development and reusable GCC/GBS frameworks.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead GCC and GBS strategy and setup or expansion workstreams, converting client objectives into business cases, target operating models, governance structures and implementation priorities.
• Design TOMs, service delivery frameworks, SLAs and performance metrics that clarify accountability, improve service quality and enable measurable operating performance.
• Conduct location strategy, benchmarking, feasibility and cost-benefit analyses using market, workforce and financial evidence to support defensible investment decisions.
• Manage transition and implementation planning, including milestones, risks, dependencies, change actions and adoption levers that move recommendations into sustained execution.
• Build financial models, process maps and analytical views that identify efficiency, automation and service excellence opportunities across corporate functions.
• Partner with client executives, A&M leaders and cross-functional teams to shape solutions, facilitate discussions and deliver clear, high-quality outputs aligned to strategic priorities.
• Mentor Associates and Analysts while contributing to proposals, pitches, thought leadership and reusable GCC/GBS playbooks that expand team capability and business development impact.
Essential Skills & Technologies
• Demonstrated expertise in GBS, GCC or shared services setup, expansion or optimization, with strong understanding of operating model design, process transformation and transition execution.
• Proven ability to develop business cases, financial models, feasibility studies, investment cases and cost-benefit analyses that support senior client decisions.
• Strong proficiency in Excel modelling, PowerPoint and structured data analysis, with the ability to convert complex findings into concise, client-ready recommendations.
• Experience with TOM design, benchmarking, governance frameworks, SLAs, performance metrics and service delivery models across corporate functions or global operating environments.
• Familiarity with digital enablement, intelligent automation, analytics solutions or technology-led transformation, including how these levers improve efficiency and service outcomes.
• Excellent problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence interacting independently with senior client executives and leading workstream discussions.
• Strong project management, organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage deliverables, risks and timelines in fast-paced, global and multicultural teams.
Additional Plus
• Experience in a top-tier consulting firm, Big Four environment or a recognized advisory practice serving global transformation, shared services or operating model clients.
• Exposure to advanced degrees or professional qualifications such as CA, CFA or a master’s degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline.
• Experience supporting proposal development, thought leadership, internal knowledge building or the creation of GCC/GBS frameworks, tools and playbooks.
What You'll Bring
• You bring 4–7 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years after completing an MBA, with direct exposure to GBS, GCC or shared services strategy, transformation, setup, expansion or optimization.
• You bring the judgment to lead workstreams from structured analysis through client-ready recommendations, balancing strategic thinking with the practical detail required for transition and implementation.
• You bring strong commercial and analytical capability across business case development, financial modelling, benchmarking, location assessment, process mapping, operating model design and performance measurement.
• You bring clear communication and stakeholder leadership, enabling productive discussions with senior executives while mentoring junior colleagues and maintaining high standards for quality, organization and delivery.
• You bring an action-oriented consulting mindset: independent thinking, comfort with ambiguity, attention to detail and a commitment to creating tangible business value rather than producing recommendations that cannot be implemented.
Why Join Us
At A&M, you will work where advisory insight and operational execution meet. The GDN Advisory team helps organizations make high-stakes decisions about operating models, service delivery, talent ecosystems, transformation and technology-enabled performance. Your work will influence how global businesses structure capabilities, improve efficiency and create measurable value across markets. You will gain exposure to senior client stakeholders, complex cross-border programs and varied industries while working alongside experienced operators and consultants who value practical results. A&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high-performing professionals early responsibility and room to shape solutions, relationships and the growth of the practice. You will also benefit from mentorship, structured performance development, technical training, on-the-job learning and opportunities to build expertise through A&M University and internal knowledge platforms. The firm’s commitment to inclusive diversity, wellbeing, flexible support and professional mobility creates an environment where you can grow with purpose. This is an opportunity to build a differentiated career in transformation advisory while helping clients turn stagnation into growth.
What We Offer
• Early ownership of meaningful client work across GCC, GBS, operating model and transformation programs, with exposure to senior stakeholders and global industries.
• Structured performance development, technical training, on-the-job learning and mentorship that support continuous growth, broader consulting capability and career progression.
• An entrepreneurial, inclusive environment with opportunities for internal mobility, employee resource groups, wellness support, flexible work models and comprehensive benefits.

title: Senior Associate – Energy
description:
Job Title: Senior Associate – Energy
Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
Experience: 4-8 years of relevant post MBA experience 
About the Company
Alvarez & Marsal is a global professional services firm known for solving complex business challenges and delivering measurable results. Our teams work with organizations facing transformation, performance, restructuring, and growth priorities where practical execution matters as much as strategic direction. The firm brings together industry expertise, analytical rigor, and hands-on leadership to help clients improve performance and build lasting value. In India, our professionals collaborate across sectors and capabilities to address high-impact business problems for leading organizations. The Energy practice advises clients across the energy value chain, including oil and gas, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities. We value professionals who combine structured problem-solving with commercial judgment, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and take ownership for outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work on challenging engagements, contribute to business development, and help shape solutions that influence critical decisions across the Energy sector.
About the Role
The Senior Associate will own high-impact workstreams for Energy-sector clients, combining deep sub-sector expertise with adaptable advisory skills across adjacent markets. The role will diagnose performance, strategy, restructuring, and operational challenges; convert analysis into clear recommendations; and support implementation that improves value, resilience, and execution. You will work across O&G upstream and downstream, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities, with the expectation of developing a differentiated point of view in at least one sub-sector. Success requires strong ownership of analyses, client-ready communication, team leadership, and the judgment to connect operational levers with financial and strategic impact. Based in Gurgaon and working onsite, you will collaborate closely with senior professionals and client teams on complex, time-sensitive engagements.
Key Responsibilities
• Own end-to-end workstreams across Energy consulting engagements, structuring ambiguous problems, defining analyses, and converting findings into decisions that improve client performance and enterprise value.
• Lead market, operational, financial, and strategic analyses using structured problem-solving, data, and business judgment to identify root causes and prioritize value-creation opportunities.
• Develop actionable recommendations for strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, and operational transformation, linking each initiative to measurable commercial or operating outcomes.
• Manage client interactions and senior stakeholder communication, presenting concise insights, challenging assumptions constructively, and building alignment around implementation priorities and ownership.
• Guide analysts and associates through problem definition, quality assurance, synthesis, and delivery, raising team capability while maintaining high standards for accuracy, pace, and clarity.
• Contribute to proposals, business development, and knowledge building by applying Energy-sector expertise to shape differentiated perspectives, compelling solutions, and repeatable intellectual capital.
• Adapt across adjacent Energy sub-sectors while maintaining deep expertise in at least one area, ensuring recommendations reflect sector economics, operating realities, and relevant value drivers.
Essential Skills & Technologies
• Deep expertise in at least one Energy sub-sector, such as O&G upstream or downstream, chemicals, mining, power, or utilities, with the ability to transfer insights across adjacent markets.
• Strong experience in consulting, advisory, or relevant industry roles spanning strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting, with ownership of complex workstreams.
• Advanced problem-solving, financial and operational analysis, executive communication, and stakeholder-management skills, supported by strong proficiency in standard analytical and presentation tools.
Additional Plus
• Experience delivering implementation programs or transformation initiatives where recommendations were translated into operating changes, performance gains, or measurable financial improvement.
• Exposure to multiple Energy sub-sectors, market situations, or geographies, enabling faster pattern recognition and more relevant recommendations for complex client contexts.
• Demonstrated contribution to proposals, client development, thought leadership, or internal capability building that strengthens the practice and creates new commercial opportunities.
What You'll Bring
• 4–8 years of total professional experience, including 3–6 years of post-MBA experience, gained in consulting, advisory, or relevant Energy industry roles.
• A strong academic foundation, including an MBA or related postgraduate qualification, with the commercial maturity to engage senior client stakeholders and influence important decisions.
• Demonstrated depth in at least one Energy sub-sector and the adaptability to work credibly across O&G, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities as client priorities require.
• A record of owning analytical and problem-solving workstreams across strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting engagements.
• The ability to move from data and diagnosis to practical recommendations, implementation priorities, and measurable business impact without losing attention to detail.
• Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the confidence to synthesize complex issues for executives and facilitate productive discussions with diverse stakeholders.
• A collaborative leadership style that develops junior team members, improves quality, and maintains momentum in fast-paced, high-expectation environments.
• Willingness to work onsite in Gurgaon and contribute actively to a team culture built around accountability, intellectual rigor, and hands-on delivery.
Why Join Us
• Work on consequential Energy-sector challenges where your analyses directly influence strategy, performance, restructuring, and investment decisions. You will see recommendations move from diagnosis into implementation and measurable client outcomes.
• Build differentiated expertise across a broad Energy landscape while developing depth in a chosen sub-sector. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, complex situations, and adjacent industries that accelerate commercial judgment.
• Join a performance-oriented team that values practical problem solving, clear communication, and ownership. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who expect high standards and support meaningful professional growth.
• Contribute beyond individual engagements through proposals, knowledge building, and practice development. Your perspectives can shape how the firm addresses evolving Energy-sector priorities and creates value for future clients.
What We Offer
• The opportunity to work on high-impact Energy engagements spanning strategy, performance improvement, restructuring, analytics, and operational transformation across leading industry segments.
• A platform for accelerated learning through direct client exposure, cross-sector problem solving, senior mentorship, and responsibility for workstreams with visible business impact.
• A collaborative, onsite Gurgaon environment with strong expectations for ownership, analytical rigor, practical execution, and contribution to the growth of the Energy advisory practice.

title: Associate Consultant – Strategy and Consulting
description:

• Access to cutting-edge research, data, and technology. 
• Opportunities for continuous learning, career advancement, and professional growth. 
• A culture that values collaboration, innovation, and diversity. 
• Competitive compensation, benefits, and recognition for your contributions. 
About this role:
As an Associate Consultant at Gartner, you will have the opportunity to accelerate your personal and professional growth while delivering meaningful impact for our clients. Working closely with Gartner Consulting leaders and leveraging Gartner’s proprietary research, benchmarks, and industry insights, you will help develop tailored, practical, and actionable solutions to address complex business and technology challenges.
What you’ll do:
• Support the delivery of high-impact consulting engagements across industries, contributing to the growth of Gartner’s IT Strategy offerings. 
• Contribute to go-to-market strategy, benchmarking, competitive landscape, sourcing strategy, and IT strategy engagements. 
• Conduct primary and secondary research using Gartner research, benchmarks, and external sources to identify market trends and generate actionable insights. 
• Gather, structure, validate, and analyze qualitative and quantitative information from multiple sources. 
• Apply advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities - including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and statistical analysis, to support consulting analyses. 
• Develop storyboards, exhibits, charts, reports, and executive presentations using Microsoft PowerPoint. 
• Maintain a high level of accuracy, consistency, transparency, and quality across analyses and client deliverables. 
• Translate research and analytical findings into clear business implications and practical recommendations. 
• Communicate complex information in a concise, structured, and visually compelling manner to senior client stakeholders. 
• Collaborate with global teams and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality client solutions. 
• Contribute to project coordination, quality assurance, knowledge sharing, and the development of team best practices. 
What you’ll need:
• Bachelor's degree, ideally a Master's degree, preferably in business, management, computer science, or a related field. 
• 2-3 years of previous experience in Digital Business, IT Strategy / Operating Model or similar, ideally within the Consulting Industry
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 
• Ability to work across diverse consulting topics and quickly develop knowledge of new industries, business models, technologies, and analytical approaches. 
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to work confidently with large and complex data sets. 
• Strong Microsoft PowerPoint and executive communication skills, including the ability to create clear, compelling presentations and communicate insights through effective data storytelling. 
• Ability to synthesize complex information, identify key messages, and communicate findings concisely to a range of stakeholders. 
• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 
Who are we? 
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
What makes Gartner a great place to work? 
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
Gartner is the world authority on AI
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
What do we offer? 
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

title: Associate (CE) - Customer CoE
description:
About us
Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

BCN Customer COE, as part of Bain’s expert client delivery network, has the vision to lend expertise, speed and competitiveness to Bain’s Pricing, Commercial Excellence, Marketing & Customer Experience projects by co-developing and delivering Pricing products, designing Go-to-Market strategy solutions and improving customer experience effectively through client-specific analysis and solutions. We develop products and deliver solutions that help clients identify and fulfill their full potential across the entire sales value chain and customer journey. We also capture value across all stages—from problem identification and solution design to implementation and capability transfer.
The CoE has fast-paced, dynamic environment with continuous innovation and learning. We offer multitude of professional development opportunities for those who like to problem-solve in an analytical environment. The COE provides a truly global experience with opportunity to work with Bain teams, experts and clients across the world in an inclusive, collaborative and fun-loving team culture along with global transfer opportunities.
What you’ll do 
We are hyper-focused on developing and deploying solutions that help clients accelerate growth sustainably through their go-to-market engine and help them reach full potential growth – from market opportunity identification to coverage planning, pricing, account cadence to optimization of sales and marketing functions, among other levers.
This is an opportunity to drive the development and deployment of our suite of cutting-edge solutions that help clients realize untapped value in their existing go-to-market engine within days and weeks, supported by analysis of client data and benchmarks and define the roadmap for the next ~12-18 months of work for the client and the Bain case teams.
Associate (Commercial Excellence) is an expert on developing and deploying solutions on projects and leads a work-stream with support from analysts (as needed) end-to-end – from ideation to delivery and presentation, leading discussions with key internal and client stakeholders including Bain Partners, Directors, and Case teams. Usually an associate is staffed 100% on a project and works under the guidance of the COE Project Leader/ Manager, playing a key role in output delivery and client communication
• Leads and executes key client delivery and analyses across identified GTM levers, from solution ideation, development and development, as needed and ensure timely, high quality, error-free analysis and output
• Bring strong problem solving skills clubbed with specialised knowledge of various analytical tools and best practices to deploy them
• Demonstrate logical thinking and apply sound business judgment to drive the overall output across every stage (from data gathering to final presentation)
• Brainstorm with the BCN Project Leader/ Manager and Bain consulting/ specialist team on various aspects of a client project or new IP development
• Drive conversations through data analysis to help drive insights through data analysis and story-lining the deliverable to prove/disprove hypotheses in the best interest of the client/project
• Provide actionable feedback, coaching and mentoring to analysts (as needed) to address their professional development needs
About you
• Work experience range in case highest qualification is undergraduate studies – 2-5 years and in case of postgraduate studies 0-3 years with relevant experience in industry or consulting firms with  exposure   to   go-to-market strategy, sales strategy and execution
• Hands on executional expertise on advanced MS-Excel and MS-PowerPoint is a must, prior experience in Tableau and Alteryx is preferred (good to have)
• Possess excellent analytic and communication skills, and should have experience working in a team environment with ability to handle multiple tasks and tight timelines
• Ability to combine business context and technical implementation
• Possess excellent time management and prioritization skills
• Able to drive thought leadership with guidance and brainstorm with project leader, partner and clients to come up with creative new solutions to complex problems
What makes us a great place to work
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. Market Access & Custom Analytics (MACA) is Intuitive’s healthcare analytics and strategic consulting function, partnering with hospital leaders to solve complex strategic questions using clinical, operational, financial, and market data. • Outcome Translation: Convert analysis into measurable outcomes by defining practical actions, impact metrics, and follow-through mechanisms for stakeholders
• Asset Creation: Develop scalable analytics assets, repeatable methodologies, and digital tools that strengthen MACA’s customer-facing consulting work in collaboration with Commercial & Enabling functions
• AI & Innovation: Apply emerging analytics and AI-enabled approaches to improve speed, quality, and scalability of insight generation
Desired
Experience 
• 4-8 years of experience in healthcare analytics, data science, business intelligence, consulting analytics, or a related field
• Experience working with healthcare, hospital, payer, provider, or life sciences data
Technical Skill Set
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and at least one analytics platform or language such as Python, R, Power BI, or SQL

What We Look For
• Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills
• Ability to derive insights, not just report metrics; simplify complexity
• Strong attention to detail and intellectual curiosity
• Self-starter with a high degree of ownership and bias for action
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Comfort working with ambiguity and open-ended business questions
Qualifications
Education
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Public Health, Healthcare Management, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline required
• MBA or Master’s degree preferred

Why Join MACA?
This is not a traditional reporting or dashboarding role. You will work at the intersection of healthcare strategy, advanced analytics, and executive decision-making, helping leading healthcare organizations evaluate growth opportunities, improve operational performance, and drive sustainable value

title: Strategy Associate- Himalayan Systems Change
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.
As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.
Strategy Associate | Himalayan Systems Change
Location: India, with regular travel, including to the Himalayan region
Level: Associate
The opportunity
Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to support our growing portfolio of work in the Himalayan region, building on our recently launched report, Prosperous and Resilient Himalayas.
The report sets out an agenda for sustainable economic growth and resilience, protecting natural systems while creating new opportunities for mountain communities. Our work aims to translate this vision into practical programmes, partnerships and financing solutions.
You will contribute to projects spanning water security, climate and disaster resilience, sustainable tourism, mountain products, enterprise development and policy. Working with colleagues across Systemiq's global network, you will help develop solutions that address the connections between environmental, economic and social challenges.
We are looking for someone with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, sound economic and financial understanding, and an interest in translating strategy into practical action. You will take ownership of defined workstreams, support engagement with a diverse range of stakeholders and contribute to an evolving portfolio of high-impact work across India and the wider Himalayan region.
Key responsibilities
• Deliver research and strategic analysis. Conduct research, interviews and quantitative analysis to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities and develop clear, evidence-based recommendations.
• Support programme development. Help design projects, pilots and implementation approaches, including concept notes, workplans, delivery models and assessments of costs, risks and scalability.
• Apply economic and financial analysis. Build and adapt financial models, assess project economics and business cases, and identify potential financing approaches.
• Support enterprise and investment opportunities. Assess businesses, innovations and projects for commercial viability, market potential and impact, contributing to strategies for growth and investment.
• Engage stakeholders and partners. Support relationships with government, businesses, research institutions, funders and local communities, including meetings, workshops and field visits.
• Contribute to project delivery. Produce high-quality presentations, reports and proposals, coordinate project activities and help monitor progress, budgets and risks.
• Collaborate across disciplines. Draw on expertise across Systemiq's global teams to develop solutions that connect policy, business, finance, environmental resilience and local economic development.
The experience and capabilities we are looking for
Strategy and analytical capabilities
• Typically 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in management consulting, strategy advisory, economic or financial analysis, public policy, international development or related fields.
• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex questions and translate evidence into practical recommendations.
• Confidence working with Excel, including financial modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis.
• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise written materials and engage effectively with different audiences.
• Experience managing workstreams, coordinating activities and delivering high-quality outputs against deadlines.
Relevant sector and regional experience
• An understanding of sustainable development challenges in India, ideally including climate resilience, natural resources, rural livelihoods, enterprise development or sustainable finance.
• Experience working with government, businesses, investors, development organisations or local institutions in India or comparable emerging markets.
• Exposure to the Himalayan region, mountain economies or related sectors such as water, sustainable tourism and agricultural value chains would be an advantage.
• Familiarity with project finance, grants, investment assessment or blended finance would be beneficial.
• A strong academic background in economics, finance, business, public policy, engineering, environmental science or a related discipline.
Leadership and personal attributes
• Curious and intellectually rigorous, with an interest in understanding how economic, environmental and social systems interact.
• Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of tasks while working collaboratively with colleagues and external partners.
• Adaptable and pragmatic, with the ability to work across different topics and navigate an evolving project portfolio.
• Motivated to translate research and strategic thinking into practical solutions that create lasting economic and environmental impact.
• Committed to Systemiq's mission and to supporting sustainable, inclusive development in the Himalayan region.
Languages and travel
• Fluent English is essential. Hindi and/or another relevant Indian or Himalayan language would be an advantage.
• Willingness to travel regularly, including field visits across the Himalayan region, is essential.
What we offer
• Meaningful impact: Contribute to work that supports economic prosperity, environmental resilience and sustainable livelihoods across the Himalayan region.
• Diverse project experience: Work across strategy, finance, policy, enterprise development and implementation.
• Global collaboration: Work with international colleagues and draw on expertise across Systemiq's global network.
• Learning and development: Build your analytical, consulting and stakeholder engagement capabilities through challenging projects and experienced colleagues.
• A purpose-driven culture: Join a collaborative team guided by our values of creativity, challenge, collaboration, change and care.
Diversity & Inclusion
At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people feel respected, supported and able to do their best work.

title: Associate Consultant — Analytics
description:
