Blue Matter Consulting is a rapidly growing management consultancy focused on the biopharmaceutical industry. We partner with life sciences companies to commercialize therapies that extend and improve human life — translating data and insights into strategies that matter.
We operate across seven global offices with an entrepreneurial culture built on curiosity, integrity, and collective excellence. At Blue Matter Insights, Associate Consultants are core contributors who own work, shape recommendations, and grow into tomorrow's leads.
Our Core Values — The Foundation Of How We Work
At BMI values are the operating system behind every deliverable, every client conversation, and every promotion decision.
Speak the TRUTH — "True to the data; true to the client"
We let the data lead. Our recommendations are grounded in evidence, and when analysis contradicts expectations, we say so with clarity and respect.Solve for SO WHAT — "Be the client, own the impact"
Every analysis we deliver connects to a real business need. We dig past the technical ask to understand the underlying question — and hold ourselves to delivering meaningful impact, not just outputs.Stay CURIOUS — "Dig deeper, see further to innovate"
Curiosity is our superpower. We ask 'why' continuously, build T-shaped expertise across data, analytics, and business context, and embrace new tools and methods to solve old problems in better ways.Win TOGETHER — "Individually experts; collectively transformative"
We encourage every voice regardless of level, hold each other accountable, and step up when it counts — across time zones and across teams.
The Role
As an Associate Consultant at Blue Matter, you are stepping into ownership. You will independently drive analytical workstreams on live client engagements, translate complex data into crisp strategic insights, and begin mentoring junior analysts. This role is for someone who does not just execute tasks — they interrogate them, improve them, and connect them to the bigger picture.
You will be expected to embody all four BMI core values in practice: staying curious about every client's business, speaking the truth to the data, ensuring every output has a clear 'So What?', and winning alongside your team every step of the way.
What You'll Do
You will own analytical modules end-to-end on active client projects. Your responsibilities span the full arc from data to decision:
Develop deep expertise, explore new frontiers
• Research therapy areas, pipeline landscapes, and competitor dynamics with the goal of knowing more than the client about their own market
• Independently investigate data anomalies and unexpected findings until you understand the story behind them — never accept outputs at face value
• Proactively bring emerging analytical methodologies, AI-driven tools, and best practices to the team; help elevate how BMI does its work
Deliver evidence-grounded insights with confidence
• Own the integrity of your analysis — ensure every recommendation is backed by data, not narrative convenience
• Clearly communicate findings that challenge client assumptions when the evidence calls for it, framing difficult messages with professionalism and precision
• Raise risks, blockers, and quality issues proactively; create a culture on your team where problems surface fast and get solved faster
Move from analysis to impact
• Translate quantitative outputs into strategic recommendations that connect directly to the client's commercial challenge — every chart, every model, every slide must earn its place
• Ask 'How will this analysis change the client's decision?' before designing an approach; suggest a simpler, higher-impact methodology when it better serves the need
• Design and build polished, client-ready deliverables: dashboards, forecasting models, segmentation analyses, and executive presentations using Excel, Python/R, Tableau, Qlik, or PowerPoint
• Mentor junior analysts on framing insights and connecting analytical work to business outcomes
Lead from within, lift others up
• Actively bridge onshore and offshore teams — share context generously so that the full team can contribute, not just execute
• Invite junior colleagues into internal reviews; create space for their voices and incorporate their perspectives
• Step in to support teammates when capacity is tight — a deliverable belongs to the team, not just to the person whose name is on it
• Build trusted client relationships as a day-to-day point of contact, representing BMI's values in every interaction
Required
What You'll Bring
• 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or management consulting (life sciences exposure is a strong plus)
• Advanced proficiency in at least two analytical tools: SQL, Python, R, Excel/VBA, or Alteryx
• Demonstrated ability to translate data into clear, decision-ready insights — not just technically accurate outputs
• Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders
• Proven experience working across global, cross-functional teams
Preferred
• Experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics: forecasting, patient analytics, market segmentation, or launch readiness
• Proficiency in visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or Power BI
• BE/BTech/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
• MTech/MS (Statistics or Data Science) is a plus
What Success Looks Like In This Role
A strong Associate Consultant at BMI will:
• Own and deliver full analytical workstreams independently - on time, with a clear 'So What?' in every output
• Be trusted by the engagement lead to interface directly with clients and represent BMI's analytical rigor
• Proactively identify gaps in the analytical approach and propose improvements before being asked
• Be the teammate others want on their project — reliable, generous with knowledge, and never leaving anyone to fail alone
Why Blue Matter
• Shape how life-saving therapies reach patients - your models and recommendations influence real commercial decisions in oncology, rare disease, immunology, and more
• Accelerated growth: BMI's flat hierarchy means your ideas get heard at every level, and strong performers move fast
• T-shaped development: deepen your analytics expertise while building strategic business acumen across the full life sciences commercial lifecycle
• Global team, flat hierarchy: your ideas are heard at every level, regardless of tenure

With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.
But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.
We are looking for a someone to join Razorpay’s high-impact Strategy team and work closely with the Founders, CXOs, and BU Heads to solve complex organizational and business challenges. This is a unique opportunity to drive strategic thinking, business transformation, and future growth initiatives across a rapidly scaling fintech organization.

Lead cross-functional strategic projects from ideation to execution, including market entry strategies, product-market fit, and scale-up plans.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 
Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 
We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. 
 About the role
This is an end-to-end ownership role. The Senior Business Analyst (BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge. 
• Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold. 
• Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval. 
• Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity. 
• Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall. 
• Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency. 
• Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability. 
• Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each. 
• Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins. 
• Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release. 
• Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is. 
• Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it. 
Deliverables Owned by This Role 
• Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model. 
• As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams. 
• Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD). 
• Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules. 
• Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report. 
• Exception handling and business continuity procedure. 
• End-user training material, SOPs and user guides. 
• Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover. 
• Post-implementation benefit realisation report. 
Must Have Qualifications: 
• 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath), or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity. 
• Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing. 
• Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability. 
• Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods. 
• Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath and/or Blue Prism. 
• Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase. 
Strong Plus: 
• UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA). 
• Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements. 
What We Offer 
• A truly international environment, collaborating on global automation projects. 
• The opportunity to experiment and innovate with Agentic AI solutions as we pioneer and rebrand our offering in the consultancy space 
• Work at the core of the automation and AI wave — we’re a pure-play automation company fully focused on innovation and future-ready solutions. 
• A growth-focused environment where you’re empowered to develop, excel, and contribute meaningfully — no corporate silos, no red tape. 
• This is not your standard corporate job — we value initiative over hierarchy, and you’ll have room to make a real impact from day one. 
• A vibrant team culture, collaborative spirit and culture you can’t experience anywhere else! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation. We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services. 
Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate. 
We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs. 
 About the role
This is an end-to-end ownership role. The Senior Business Analyst (BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge. 
• Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold. 
• Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval. 
• Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity. 
• Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall. 
• Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency. 
• Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability. 
• Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each. 
• Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins. 
• Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release. 
• Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is. 
• Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it. 
Deliverables Owned by This Role 
• Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model. 
• As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams. 
• Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD). 
• Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules. 
• Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report. 
• Exception handling and business continuity procedure. 
• End-user training material, SOPs and user guides. 
• Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover. 
• Post-implementation benefit realisation report. 
Must Have Qualifications: 
• 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath), or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity. 
• Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing. 
• Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability. 
• Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods. 
• Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath and/or Blue Prism. 
• Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase. 
Strong Plus: 
• UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA). 
• Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements. 
What We Offer 
• A truly international environment, collaborating on global automation projects. 
• The opportunity to experiment and innovate with Agentic AI solutions as we pioneer and rebrand our offering in the consultancy space 
• Work at the core of the automation and AI wave — we’re a pure-play automation company fully focused on innovation and future-ready solutions. 
• A growth-focused environment where you’re empowered to develop, excel, and contribute meaningfully — no corporate silos, no red tape. 
• This is not your standard corporate job — we value initiative over hierarchy, and you’ll have room to make a real impact from day one. 
• A vibrant team culture, collaborative spirit and culture you can’t experience anywhere else! 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Decision Analytics Consultant - Value & Access (Market Access)
description:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
Insights & Analytics
ZS's Insights & Analytics group partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.   
What You’ll Do
• 
• Design and execute market access projects, including payer landscape assessments, formulary access analyses, deep dives into access barriers, contracting scenario modeling, and contract operations etc.
• Analyze and interpret quantitative/ qualitative research data to provide clear, actionable insights.
• Collaborate with internal leadership and client teams to define project objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
• Present analytical findings and recommendations through compelling slide decks and/or excel workbooks to effectively communicate insights and support stakeholder decision‑making. 
• Manage overall project, stakeholder and clients, day-to-days tasks and lead a team of Associates and Associate Consultants.
• Act as a Market Access subject matter expert, guiding and onboarding Associates and Associate Consultants.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams across geographies on a day-to-day basis and on multiple projects simultaneously.
What You’ll Bring
• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (any discipline) with strong academic performance, particularly in analytics and quantitative coursework
• 5 – 7 years of relevant job experience. An MBA/PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience
• Good to have a deep understanding of the U.S. healthcare system, including payer mix (commercial, Medicaid, Medicare) and market access levers (rebates, contracting)
• Hands‑on experience with claims and formulary databases
• Strong analytical mindset with meticulous attention to detail
• Advanced skills in MS Excel, SQL, MS PowerPoint for report creation, familiarity with Power BI, Tableau and Python/R is a plus
• Structured communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner to clients
• Fluency in English
• Client-first mentality
• Intense work ethic
• Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach
How you’ll grow:
• Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
• Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
• Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions
Perks & Benefits:
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
Hybrid working model:
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
Travel:
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
Considering applying?
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
To complete your application:
Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.
NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

www.zs.com

title: Analyst, Client Consulting - AI
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Role Summary:
Client Consulting Analysts play a critical role in supporting Visa’s clients by applying analytical solutions to business challenges in the payments and financial services industry. The role involves leveraging data science, analytics, and business consulting expertise to deliver actionable insights and drive portfolio growth, profitability, and operational efficiency. Analysts are expected to manage projects, collaborate across teams, and translate complex data into strategic recommendations for clients.
All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
Key Responsibilities
• Apply analytical and data science solutions to address business problems for clients in payments, financial institutions, and related sectors.
• Manage end-to-end project delivery, including planning, organizing, and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
• Translate analytics outputs into actionable recommendations and present findings to stakeholders.
• Support business development initiatives and contribute to portfolio optimization, product launches, and customer loyalty strategies.
• Collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural environments, adapting communication for various audience levels.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:
• 2 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD).
• Experience in applying solutions to business problems in analytics, business consulting, product ownership, or data science.
• Background in payments, financial institutions, consumer lending, risk management, portfolio management, corporate payments, retail and merchant business, or digital projects.
• Experience in project management, including managing team and client expectations and deliverables.
• Agile experience is mandatory.
• Experience working with extremely large data sets.
• Experience planning, organizing, and managing end-to-end projects with diverse cross-functional teams.
• Proven skills in translating analytics output to actionable recommendations.
• Hands-on experience with modern distributed systems, including Hadoop, Hive/SQL, and Apache Spark.
Preferred Qualifications
• 3 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD).
• Prior consulting or product management experience.
• Experience with a top-tier bank or financial services practice of a top-tier consulting firm, with a combination of regional and global experience.
• Advanced skills in PowerPoint and Excel.
• Proficiency in creating reproducible analytic pipelines using tools such as Python and R.
• Proficiency with version control systems like git or GitHub.
• Data visualization using Tableau, Power BI, or R/Python.
Visa is an EEO Employer
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:

P&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. The Opportunity
We are looking for a Digital Product Manager to join our Digital Products team and build digital products and capabilities that solve meaningful business problems. This role is designed for a professional with prior technology experience who can connect business needs with technology solutions and translate strategy into products that deliver measurable outcomes.
You will work at the intersection of business, technology, data, users, and AI. You will understand user and business needs, shape product strategy, prioritize opportunities, work closely with engineering and technology teams, and drive products from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

Own Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap

Drive Product Delivery

Influence Stakeholders & Drive Change

• Anticipate resistance and create practical approaches to move users and stakeholders toward adoption.

• Define product KPIs, adoption metrics, user experience measures, and value metrics.
• Use product usage and business performance signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
• Develop stakeholder engagement and adoption plans for new capabilities.
• Create feedback mechanisms that continuously bring user and business insights back into product development.
• Ensure products deliver measurable value beyond initial launch.
Partner with Technology & External Teams
• Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, design, cybersecurity, IT, and vendor teams.
• Manage technology and business dependencies required to deliver product outcomes.
• Partner with vendors and external technology providers where required, ensuring clarity of outcomes, delivery expectations, and accountability.
• Contribute to solution design, testing, release planning, reliability, security, data quality, and long-term sustainability.
The Ideal Candidate
• Has an MBA or prior hands-on experience in technology, software, data, IT, digital engineering, or a related technical environment building AI native products.
• Has less than 3 years of post-MBA experience / Relevant experience and is looking to build a career at the intersection of business, technology, and product management.
• Can combine business thinking with enough technical depth to engage credibly with engineers and technology teams.
• Is comfortable translating ambiguous business problems into structured product opportunities and clear requirements.
• Has strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills and can create alignment without formal authority.
• Demonstrates the ability to drive adoption and change across diverse stakeholder groups.
• Is analytically strong and comfortable using data, KPIs, user feedback, and business signals to make decisions.
• Can communicate clearly with senior leaders, business users, engineers, data teams, designers, vendors, and other partners.
• Has strong ownership, bias for action, learning agility, and resilience in a fast-moving environment.
• Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, cloud, and modern digital platforms.
Job Qualifications
Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Analytics, or a related field.
• MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification from a recognized institution.
• Less than 3 years of professional experience post-MBA.
• Prior professional experience in technology, software engineering, data, IT, digital, systems, or another technology-focused role.
• Strong understanding of technology-enabled business solutions and the software development lifecycle.
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, influencing, structured problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
• Ability to work effectively across business and technology teams and translate between the two.
About Us
We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders can lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories, and functions. title: Associate Product Manager/Product Manager (Reference Standards)
description:
Description
Who is USP?
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
Brief Job Overview
As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data-driven and analytic decision making and making customer-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.
How will YOU create impact here at USP?
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
The Reference Standards Product Manager Has The Following Responsibilities
• Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis
• Develop and present business case and supporting rationale for new and existing items
• Stays abreast of industry and market trends and key competitive intelligence to drive product strategies.
• Lead pipeline prioritization efforts, aligning pipeline to segment value and organizational strategies/prioritization
• Work with Industry Programs, Science and Operations, and others to facilitate new product launches
• Support Industry Programs, Regional and Sales staff in new product training and related customer solutions
• Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
• Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
• Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
• Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
• Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.
Who is USP Looking For?
The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.
• Minimum three (3) to seven (7) years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical industry or related field
• At least one (1) to two (2) years managing large product portfolios across B2B and/or B2C companies and managing high performance cross-functional teams.
• Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, data and analytical tools
• Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills with ability to handle complexity and drive data-driven solutions.
• Ability to develop and present dashboards, templates and business cases supported by strong rationale, customer insights and business growth goals.
• Self-starter and highly self-motivated, assumes personal accountability for results and performance.
• Working knowledge of syndicated data and analysis, such as IQVIA, Cortellis, Dailymed, etc
• Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint
• Strong written and verbal communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Supervisory Responsibilities
None, this is an individual contributor role.
Benefits
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

• Conduct market and competitive analysis across provider data vendors, directories, credentialing, and provider network management solutions.

• Data quality and enrichment

• Predictive insights

• Communicate roadmap priorities, business cases, metrics, risks, and trade-offs effectively.

title: Product Manager
description:

Why This Job’s a Big Deal
As a Product Manager in the Product Operating Model (POM), your focus is on defining, prioritizing, and delivering products or capabilities that solve customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. You are accountable for the success of your product, partnering closely with design, engineering, and business stakeholders. Who You Are
• Requires a Bachelor's degree; an MBA is preferred.
• 4-6 years of experience taking full ownership of product success by defining visions and managing priorities to drive business and customer value.
• A strategic thinker capable of connecting business opportunities with technical execution across engineering and design teams.

WE ARE PRICELINE.
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
Flexible work at Priceline
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
Perks & Benefits At Priceline

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
Specific benefits and programs vary by location.
Inclusion is a Big Deal!
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

title: Product Manager
description:
Twin Health 
At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.
We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.
Working here 
Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.
Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .
With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.
Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.
We are only looking for candidates either based in Chennai or are willing to relocate to Chennai.
We are looking for a Product Manager, Member Experience to define the vision and strategy for Twin’s member product in India.
This is a senior product leadership role with responsibility for the end-to-end experience members have with Twin — from their first days in the program through the daily experiences that help them understand their bodies, take the right actions, and achieve lasting health outcomes.
You will define what a world-class, AI-native healthcare experience should look like for millions of members. You will shape how the Digital Twin comes to life across mobile, chat, voice, connected devices, and human care — transforming complex streams of health data into simple, personalized guidance that helps each member know what to do, why it matters, and what is likely to happen next.
This role requires both vision and execution. You will develop a deep understanding of our members, identify the most important problems to solve, set the product direction, and work closely with Design, Engineering, AI/ML, Clinical, Data, and Operations to turn that vision into experiences members use and value every day.
You will be a senior product leader within Twin’s India organization and a key partner to product and company leadership globally.
Responsibilities
• Define the vision for Twin’s member experience. Establish a compelling product vision and strategy for how Twin helps members understand and improve their health.
• Own the end-to-end member journey. Think beyond individual features to create a coherent experience spanning onboarding, daily guidance, nutrition, medications,
activity, connected devices, progress, care-team interactions, and long-term behavior change.
• Reimagine healthcare as an AI-native experience. Define how AI, the Digital Twin, and human care work together across app, chat, voice, and proactive experiences to create a deeply personalized relationship with every member.
• Drive measurable member outcomes. Define success through engagement, sustained behavior change, treatment adherence, member satisfaction, and clinical outcomes rather than feature delivery.
• Lead through experimentation. Create hypotheses, rapidly test new experiences, learn from member behavior, and scale what works.

title: Associate Product Manager - Product Discovery & Strategy
description:
Who We Are
Simpplr is the AI-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low-code extensibility and enterprise-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.
Who We Are
Simpplr builds AI-powered intranet for modern enterprises. Our platform unifies employee engagement, enablement, and services, leveraging state-of-the-art AI models to deliver a seamless, cohesive, and personalized employee experience for everyone — wherever and however they work.
Our mission is to transform the work experience for billions of people across the world. Because we believe that when work is good, life is better.™
Trusted by more than 1,000 leading brands, including DocuSign, Penske, Splunk, Nutanix, Okta, Eurostar, and SoFi, our customers are achieving measurable improvements in employee engagement, productivity, and accelerated business performance.
Simpplr is headquartered in Silicon Valley, CA with offices in the UK, Canada, and India, and is backed by Sapphire Ventures, Norwest Venture Partners, Salesforce Ventures, and Tola Capital. Learn more at simpplr.com.
The role
We have more ideas than we can build. Your job is to figure out which ones are real, and turn the survivors into a product specification sharp enough for engineering to build from.
You won't be generating ideas!! You'll be the person who decides which ones deserve investment — through live customer conversations, rigorous market sizing, and a written case that leadership can act on. Some of what you look at should die. Killing an idea well is as valuable here as championing one !!
What You'll Do
• Take a rough concept and design the fastest honest test of whether there's a real need behind it
• Run customer and prospect interviews; separate what people said from what you concluded
• Size the opportunity — TAM/SAM, pricing, unit economics — and be clear about which assumptions the number actually rests on
• Write the recommendation memo: build, don't build, or build something narrower. Own the call.
• Turn a validated concept into a PRD — problem, scope, what's in the first version and what isn't
• Work with engineering leads on feasibility early enough that it changes the spec, not after
What We're Looking For
• MBA from IIM A/B/C/L/I/K or equivalent.
• Exceptional structured writing. Your memos are the product of this role.
• High Comfort with numbers: financial modeling in Excel/Sheets, basic SQL, product analytics
• Can hold a real conversation with a senior Global executive based in developed markets (or a frustrated customer without a script !!)
• Already using AI tools in how you work, not just aware of them
What You Get
Direct access to CXOs on a daily basis, real ownership of investment recommendations, and a short path between your analysis and what actually gets built.
Your Voice, Unfiltered
We value the real you. To ensure a fair and authentic experience for everyone, we ask that you do not use AI tools (such as real-time answer generators, transcription apps, or note-taking bots) during your interview
Our process is designed to hear your unique story, thought process, and lived experience in real-time. Use of unauthorized AI tools may result in disqualification, as we want to ensure every candidate is evaluated on their own individual merits. We’re excited to meet the person behind the resume!
If you need assistive technology or AI tools for accessibility (e.g., live captioning), please notify your recruiter in advance. We are committed to providing an inclusive interview experience.
Simpplr’s Hub-Hybrid-Remote Model
At Simpplr we believe that when work is good, life is better and that belief guides all we do. Including how we approach our flexible work model. Simpplr operates with a Hub-Hybrid-Remote model. This model is role-based with exceptions and provides employees with the flexibility that many have told us they want.
• Hub - 100% work from Simpplr office. Role requires Simpplifier to be in the office full-time.
• Hybrid - Hybrid work from home and office. Role dictates the ability to work from home, plus benefit from in-person collaboration on a regular basis. 
• Remote - 100% remote. Role can be done anywhere within your country of hire, as long as the requirements of the role are met.

If you think this

description:
Overview
Dynamics 365 and Power Platform depend on a core data platform that manages business data, transactions, security, extensibility and application lifecycle at enterprise scale. As customers modernize applications and adopt AI, the platform keeps data governed, available and economically sustainable, with the controls enterprise business systems require.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the administrator experience and self-service workflows on the shared Dataverse + Finance & Operations platform team. You will independently set the strategy and roadmap for experiences that make environments easier to understand, manage and trust, translating platform governance policies into clear administrator controls and actionable workflows. Through customer discovery, evidence-led prioritization and close engineering partnership, you will deliver measurable improvements in service awareness, administrator control and self-service, strengthening the application foundation that connected experiences depend on.
This Hyderabad-based role offers meaningful product ownership at an important point in the evolution of enterprise applications: improving the administration and governance experiences that help customers operate mission-critical applications (such as their ERP) and provide dependable foundations for business applications, analytics, and AI. You will work closely with engineering, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform teams, administrators, customers, and partner teams to turn operational needs into clear product priorities and measurable customer outcomes. The role is well suited to a product leader who enjoys understanding complex customer problems, shaping a focused roadmap, and making enterprise platforms easier to manage and trust.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
•  Own product strategy, roadmap and outcomes for the F&O administrator experience and self-service workflows, grounded in user research, service signals and support insight.
•  Define the experience for understanding service health, data and environment status, and the actions available to keep business operations dependable.
•  Translate platform governance policies into administrator controls and lifecycle workflows that help customers understand usage, apply policies and manage their data with appropriate visibility and control.
•  Set product requirements for availability, performance, observability, compatibility, administrator control and successful task completion.
•  Use customer discovery, support insight and product evidence to identify administrator needs and prioritize reusable platform improvements with engineering.

About the Role:
At Moving Tech, Product Managers own the product journey end-to-end, balancing product development, operations, and customer engagement. This is an opportunity to be a true creator, not just a coordinator.
Can PMs become TRUE creators?
• Can they CODE?
• Can they Design?
• Can they analyze data programmatically?
• Can they deeply empathize with the users they’re building for?
Yes, they can! At Moving Tech, PMs are empowered to upskill themselves and collaborate across teams, including Development, Design, Growth, Communications, Support, and Operations. PMs here don’t just write product specs—they actively participate in the creation process, ensuring specifications are practical and deliverable.
The PM in the Age of AI
We believe AI is the next S-curve, a phase transition on the scale of the microprocessor or the internet that will reprice everything. The cost of building software is collapsing, and the bar for real value is rising fast: the PMs who lead will be the ones who use AI to go faster, deeper, and broader.
It is a new way of working. What used to be 10x PM work will become the baseline. Tool users must become tool builders. Spec writers, code writers. Specialists, generalists who move fluently across design, engineering, and growth. The PMs who thrive will be the ones who pair theory with hands-on building.
What does not change is what we believe about building software: that it must create real value, exhibit supreme craft, and be reasoned from first principles. AI is a lever for these beliefs, and a means to deepen our understanding of the problems we solve and the solutions we build.

● Proactive get-things-done attitude.
● Ability to balance big-picture and attention to detail.
● Self-motivation and drive.
● Persuasive, but not forceful—influence with respect.

title: Associate Product Manager – Payments (GCC & Global)

About The Function
MakeMyTrip is one of India's leading online travel platforms, and its Global business ( GoMMT ) serves travelers across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the wider GCC and other international markets. The GCC Product team owns the customer journey from first search to final payment and beyond, working on funnel conversion, monetization , ancillary uptake, payments and NPS.
About The Role
Payment is the moment a customer decides to complete a booking or walk away. As an Associate Product Manager – Payments, you will own journeys at this step for GCC customers who pay in AED, SAR and USD using local cards, wallets, Apple Pay, bank-linked payments and loyalty points.
You will work with a senior product owner, engineering, finance, design, analytics and external payment partners to raise payment success, widen payment-method coverage and manage the cost of every transaction.
What will you be doing
•  Payment success: analyze drop-offs and failures by payment method, issuing bank, gateway, currency and device; run experiments to lift success rate and checkout conversion. 
•  Local and alternate payment methods: drive integration and launch of methods preferred in the UAE, KSA and wider GCC, and improve how customers discover them at the payment step. 
•  Gateway and processor partnerships: work with payment partners on integrations, smart routing, retries and performance reviews. 
•  Payment cost and P& L: help reduce processing cost per transaction through routing, pricing and mix decisions, without hurting success rate. 
•  Checkout experience: design, test and improve a fast, clear and trusted payment experience across web , Android and iOS. 
•  Authentication and compliance: partner with risk, finance and engineering on 3D Secure, tokenization , fraud controls and local regulatory requirements. 
•  Loyalty and offers at payment: improve how customers redeem points, bank offers and promotions at checkout. 
•  Metrics and reporting: own dashboards for payment success, conversion, cost and method mix, and turn the data into clear recommendations. 
•  Delivery: write product requirements, manage releases with engineering, design and QA, and measure impact after launch. 
Qualification & Experience
•  MBA from a reputable institute; an engineering background is preferred. 
•  1–3 years of experience in product management, or in payments, fintech, e-commerce, travel or consumer internet. 
•  Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break ambiguous problems into clear actions. 
•  Working knowledge of SQL and dashboards; comfort reading funnel and conversion data. 
•  Clear written and verbal communication with engineering, business and external partners 
•  Understanding of payment flows: cards, wallets, bank transfers, 3D Secure, tokenization , authorization and settlement. 
•  Exposure to the GCC or other multi-currency markets. 
•  Experience running A/B tests or conversion experiments. 
•  Familiarity with Adobe Analytics or similar tools. 
Key Success Factors for the Role
•  Customer centricity: deep interest in why customers succeed or fail at payment. 
•  Ownership and execution: turns ideas into shipped products with cross-functional teams. 
•  Analytical rigor : decisions backed by data and clear success metrics. 
•  Innovation and agility: keen to experiment, learn fast and adapt to new markets. 
•  Communication and influence: can explain a recommendation simply and bring teams along.

description:
About Trademo :
Trademo is an AI-native platform for global trade management and intelligence. It helps enterprises stay compliant with global trade regulations, optimize tariffs, uncover new business opportunities, and discover qualified suppliers.
At its core is a proprietary global trade data foundation spanning tariffs, customs, duties, taxes, FTAs, import-export controls, corporate ownership, and 675 sanctions and PEP lists across 140+ countries. title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Associate Product Manager – Discover
Job Description
About the Position
As an Associate Product Manager – Discover, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Sense’s intelligent automation and agentic AI ecosystem.
You will work on some of Sense’s most strategic problem spaces, including:
• Empower recruiters to rapidly identify top-tier candidates for open job orders across ATS and Sense platforms, accelerating time to fill job orders.
• Drive higher application rates for open jobs by connecting job seekers with the most relevant jobs across Email, SMS, Voice, and Chat surfaces.
• Structured AI Decisioning out of unstructured data within automation workflows to ensure rapid yet meaningful outreach and audience engagement
• LLM-powered Recommendation and Decisioning Engines which drive above outcomes
• Reliable Feedback Loop - AI Quality, Observability & Data Quality monitoring to ensure reliable and explainable outcomes for recruiters and customers
This role sits at the intersection of AI, workflow orchestration, automation infrastructure, and recruiter productivity. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, AI/ML teams, Customer Success, and GTM teams to conceptualize, build, and scale products that automate recruiting workflows and empower recruiters with AI-driven assistance.
This is an excellent opportunity for a high-potential Product Manager who enjoys solving complex platform and systems problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to grow into a larger product leadership role over time.
Role And Responsibilities
Strategy & Discovery 
• Identify opportunities where AI and automation can meaningfully improve recruiter productivity, operational efficiency, and candidate experience.
• Work closely with Product Leadership to define and evolve the vision for Sense’s Discover roadmap. More specifically, contribute to the roadmap for:
• Candidate Matching
• Job Matching
• AI Decisioning & Actions
• AI Observability
• Stay current with advancements in Agentic AI, LLM ecosystems, workflow orchestration, and enterprise automation trends.
• Conduct structured discovery sessions with enterprise customers, recruiters, implementation, customer success, sales and leadership teams to understand and document feedback, pain points and user flow inefficiencies clearly.
Execution - Design, Development and Delivery
• Translate ambiguous business and customer problems into clearly defined user flow diagrams, user stories, and acceptance criteria within a PRD - explaining aha! moments, self-serve features, guided onboarding, activation experience and instrumentation to track post launch activation and repeat usage metrics.
• Contribute to the implementation of intelligent orchestration capabilities across recruiting workflows and user journeys.
• Partner with user experience and design teams to ship consumer-grade, highly flexible yet scalable and delightful user experiences. Help define interaction patterns and experiences for features owned by your EPD triad across Voice, Chat, Recruiter Hub, Workflows, Sequences and other surfaces.
• Partner with engineering, platform and ML teams to deliver scalable, reliable and maintainable solutions across ingestion pipelines, document processing, feature extraction, data transformations & indexing, vector storage & embeddings, structured and low latency retrieval and amongst other product and platform capabilities.
• Ensure product, design and engineering decisions are documented, and shared with stakeholders in a timely manner.
• Drive feature prioritization, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination by maintaining a groomed / ungroomed backlog / project plan in Asana or Jira.
• Work closely with QA teams and perform hands-on UAT to ensure comprehensive test coverage and delivered features meet customer and usability expectations.
• Ensure customer reported issues are resolved under pre-defined SLA windows and are escalated proactively to the appropriate leadership to ensure timely resolution.
• Contribute towards shipping internal tools for engineering and customer support to easily track and debug issues.
Enablement and GTM
• Run a structured post launch program to ensure awareness, activation and adoption of key features
• Analyse past usage, revenue and churn risk signals to identify customer segments where a feature is launched and will be useful to drive targeted adoption
• Work closely with product marketing and knowledge base team to create and update the customer facing how-tos and other useful artifacts
• Create internal and customer facing announcement artifacts and adoption playbooks for customer success and implementation teams
• Run structured training sessions for new capabilities, office hours and workshops
Product Adoption and AI Observability  
• Define, review and present adoption and AI Observability metrics to stakeholders on a bi-weekly basis
• Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Synthesis
• AI Quality / Reliability / Faithfulness -
• Feature extraction accuracy
• Hit Rates, Miss Rates, Relevant Results Density
• Faithfulness of AI explanation on a sample dataset
• Indexing and Retrieval Reliability - Latency, Failure Rates, Zero Result Rates
• Conversion Funnel Analysis
• Personally inspect AI Quality - LLM outputs, traces, retrieval results, source-ingestion failures, irrelevant results, failed actions, and downstream customer outcomes.
• Analyse customer reported issues via bugs and support tickets and identify improvement opportunities
• Partner with Product Analytics and Data teams to ensure timely and evolving instrumentation, derive actionable insights and identify optimization opportunities on a bi-weekly basis.
Professional Qualifications
• BE/B.Tech or M.B.A with at least 1-3 years of experience in product management role with deep familiarity with software development lifecycle.
• You need to be a highly analytical problem solver to succeed in this role.
• [Must Have] - You bring hands-on experience with data analysis using SQL and present your findings in a structured way. Experience with tools like Mixpanel, Heap or Amplitude is preferred.
• [Highly Preferred] Previous experience in working closely with engineering and ML on retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, evaluations and observability. Familiarity with AI Observability tools like Arize, Braintrust etc is highly desired.
• Familiarity with project management tools like Asana or Jira.
• Proficient in English, with good written and oral communication and presentation skills
• Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, ability to prioritize and balance multiple tasks
• Ability to process and apply feedback constructively without ego
• Ability to “do what it takes to get the job done” - no job is small for you.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.
Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.
Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.
Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.
The Playbook
Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.
Every MetaGO journey kicks off with a massive 35+ biomarker deep dive. From there, we bring in the heavy hitters—endocrinologists, cardiologists, and internal medicine experts—to craft a highly personalized roadmap.
Throw in GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the MetaGO app. With absolute legends like Dr. Kaushal Patel leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.
The Growth & Product Team
Where the GO of MetaGO happens!
This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.
You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.
Here’s What You’ll Be Driving
•  The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.
•  Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.
•  The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.
•  The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.
•  The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.
What We’re Looking For
•  Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.
•  Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.
•  Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.
•  Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.
•  Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.
•  Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.
•  Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.
•  Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.
•  Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.
Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)
Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)
We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.
If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.
Let’s build something epic together.

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
As Associate Product Owner you will start by working closely with a Senior Product Owner, contributing across discovery, delivery and adoption before progressively taking full ownership of a planning module as your domain and platform expertise deepens.
Once you own a module, you will drive it end-to-end from identifying capability gaps through design, build, UAT and go-live, to sustained adoption. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and business planning teams to deliver measurable improvement in planning capability and commercial outcomes.
You will be accountable for metrics that matter to your users, not a task list. You will be expected to have a point of view on what best-in-class looks like for your module and to argue for it.
Key Responsibilities
You will be expected to take end-to-end ownership of one planning module. This includes: 
Drive discovery and design with business
• Run discovery with planners, buyers and planning centre of excellence to translate planning into clear product requirements.
• Write crisp PRDs, process flows and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from without a second round of interpretation.
• Work with solution architects and engineering on solution fitment; make explicit build-vs-configure-vs-defer calls and phase them sensibly.
Drive delivery with engineering
• Run the squad's backlog with the engineering leads — groom, refine, unblock, and protect the sprint from scope drift.
• Work with data engineering on the pipelines, integrations and data models your module depends on.
• Own UAT planning and execution with business users; drive defect triage, cutover, training material and go-live readiness.
• Partner with QA on test coverage for planning calculations — where a wrong number is a commercial decision gone wrong, not a cosmetic bug.
Drive adoption and outcomes
• Track and move your module's metrics
• Run post-go-live adoption: spend time with planners, find where the workflows are inadequateand close those gaps.
• Report module performance and business impact to leadership on a regular cadence.
Build intelligence in, not on
• Work with data scientists to identify and specify intelligence use cases for your module.
• Define how recommendations surface inside the planner's workflow, what the planner can override, and how model output is validated.
• Use AI natively in your own work. We expect you to be materially faster because of it.
Knowledge, Skills & Experience
Experience
• 3–6 years of experience in Product Owner / Associate Product Owner / Business Analyst / Consultant roles, with at least 2 years in a product ownership capacity.
• Planning domain or planning product experience is essential — one or more of: 
• Worked in a retail planning, merchandising, buying or supply planning team 
•  or
• Worked on an enterprise retail planning product or implementation — Board, Anaplan, o9, Blue Yonder, Oracle Retail, SAP IBP or equivalent.
• AI-native. Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI across the product lifecycle — not curiosity, but working practice. Bonus if you have shipped a product feature where an ML/AI model drove the user-facing decision.
• Experience owning a product or module end-to-end through a full delivery cycle, including a go-live.
• Comfortable working directly with engineering teams, solution architects and data engineers; able to hold a credible conversation about data models, integrations and calculation logic.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams across geographies and time zones.
• Experience in enterprise or platform products (as opposed to consumer apps) is preferred.
• Retail or e-commerce background strongly preferred.
• MBA preferred, not mandatory. A strong domain and delivery track record counts for more.
Skills & Attributes
• Structured thinker; can take an ambiguous business complaint and turn it into a prioritised, sequenced roadmap.
• Analytical; you should be comfortable interrogating planning data, variance, forecast accuracy and stock cover yourself rather than waiting for an analyst.
• Outstanding written and verbal communication; can write a document that a head of planning and a backend engineer both find useful.
• Strong stakeholder management; you will be saying "not this quarter" to senior people, and keeping them on side while you do it.
• Bias to action and high ownership; Things you ship go live and get used the same week.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills; able to run multiple parallel workstreams to deadline.
• Attention to detail;precision and accuracy are your strong suit.
