title: Senior Associate, Product Manager-Clinical Intelligence
description:
About Amplify Health 
Who We Are 
Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.
Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.
Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.
Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.
As an ISO27001 certified organization, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.
Our Vision and Ambition 
To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.
Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.
By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.
The Position
Summary
The Senior Associate, Product Manager, Clinical Intelligence at Amplify Health plays a critical role in shaping the future of digital health solutions across Asia. This position operates at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation, driving transformative initiatives that improve patient outcomes and redefine healthcare delivery models.
The Product Manager is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle management of products—from ideation and concept validation to development, launch, and continuous optimization. This includes defining the product vision, setting strategic priorities, and ensuring that every product aligns with Amplify Health’s mission to make healthcare more accessible, affordable, and effective.
The role requires a strategic thinker and hands-on executor who can translate high-level business objectives into actionable product roadmaps. The Product Manager leverages emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, and cloud-native architectures to deliver innovative solutions that meet evolving customer needs and regulatory requirements.
As a key leader, the Product Manager collaborates cross-functionally with business, technology, and external partners to ensure seamless delivery. They champion customer-centric design principles, integrating behavioral insights and advanced analytics to personalize health experiences and improve engagement.
This position is ideal for a visionary product leader who thrives in a fast-paced, scale-up environment, embraces complexity, and is passionate about leveraging data and technology to transform healthcare across Asia.
Responsibilities
1) Clinical Product Strategy & Vision
• Own 1 clinical‑backed product strategy and multi‑year roadmap aligned to customer outcomes and business objectives.
• Drive the clinical, insurance and technology roadmap and vision of the product will intersect clinical and insurance 
• Define target problems, personas, JTBDs, and success metrics for payers, providers, employers, and members.
• Drive data‑informed prioritization using frameworks such as WSJF, RICE, or equivalent value models.
• Make explicit trade‑offs balancing customer value, technical complexity, regulatory risk, and commercial impact.
2) Discovery, Design & Outcomes
• Run structured discovery (customer interviews, prototype tests, betas, VOC programs), and instrument products with dashboards/analytics to measure adoption, engagement, and outcomes.
• Champion API-First design for B2B scalability and enhanced Integration experience adoption through use-cases based interfaces, SDKs, Implementation guide.
3) Interoperability & Data Architecture
• Partner with architecture/engineering to deliver API first, cloud agnostic services and integrations, leveraging HL7 FHIR/SMART on FHIR for data models, auth and scopes, and secure EHR/payer connections. 
• Ensure solutions can ingest/serve longitudinal health data and payer data, and support bulk data and near real-time workflows where appropriate. 
4) Privacy, Security & Compliance
• Embed privacy by design; for example, align to PDPA in Singapore (and analogous regimes in other markets), and incorporate NEHR/HIB data sharing requirements in Singapore. 
• Collaborate with InfoSec to implement ISO/IEC 27001 controls and pursue standard like HITRUST aligned assurance for healthcare customers, as appropriate to product scope. 
5) Delivery & Quality
• Run Agile delivery with crisp backlog management, well-formed PRDs/Epics/Stories, and definition of done that includes security, privacy, performance, and observability.
• Drive experimentation and A/B testing; ensure robust post launch monitoring and incident response playbooks are in place for mission-critical B2B Integrations.
6) Go-To-Market & Commercialisation
• Partner with Sales, CS, Clinical and Operations on packaging, pricing, launch readiness, and product enablement playbooks, with minimum adjustments to different customer segment and country.
• Own success metrics: time to value, logo/market expansion, renewal/retention, measured clinical/financial outcomes per solution.
Candidate Profile
Experience and Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline required. 
• Medical degree (MD/MBBS), health sciences background, MBA, or other advanced degree is highly advantageous. 
• Minimum of 5+ years of experience in either: 
• B2B product management with end‑to‑end lifecycle ownership and a demonstrated track record of delivering impactful features, or
• A healthcare insurer environment, with strong understanding of end‑to‑end processes, operational workflows, and key pain points.
• Proven ability to deliver complex, cross‑functional products within agile development environments. 
• Strong interoperability awareness, including understanding of OpenAPI concepts, FHIR resources, and how SMART on FHIR enables secure, scoped access to health data (OAuth 2.0/OIDC and app launch patterns). 
• Working knowledge of data privacy and security requirements, including PDPA obligations (consent, purpose limitation, protection, and breach notification), with experience collaborating with Information Security teams toward ISO 27001 controls. 
• Demonstrated proficiency in prioritization and value‑based decision‑making, leveraging frameworks such as WSJF and RICE, defining KPIs and OKRs, and applying product analytics to measure outcomes.
Preferred:
• Possess understanding in insurance and healthcare ecosystems and products would be advantageous.
• Experience with AI/ML in healthcare (e.g., risk scores, triage, personalization) and familiarity with governance and policy framework would be preferred.

title: Associate Product Manager - AI
description:
Associate Product Manager (AI-First) – Sovos SOVOS Associate Product Manager (AI-First)
Product Management
•  Full-Time
•  India
Build Your Future With Us
The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
The Role
At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.
More Specifically, You Will
• Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
• Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
• Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
• Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
• Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
• Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.
What You Bring to Sovos
• You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.
• Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Jira (epics, stories, sprints, boards); you're comfortable managing backlogs and running agile ceremonies.
• Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
• Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
• AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.
• Domain knowledge in tax, compliance, or fintech is a plus, as is experience with UI prototyping tools, design systems, or evaluating and shipping AI-powered features.
• Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.
The Process
We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
1
Pre-Employment Assessment
Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
2
Video Interview
A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
3
Meeting with a Recruiter
A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
4
Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
Life at Sovos
The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
• Global Mentoring Programs
• AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
• Continuous Learning and Development
• Language Learning Support
• Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
• Global Parental Leave Policy
• Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
• Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
• Hybrid Work Arrangement
• Annual Health Check-up
Equal Opportunity Employer
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
Company Background
Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

title: Associate Product Manager - Supply Chain (Logistics B2B)
description:
About The Team
Purplle’s Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business.
About The Role
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who will own the product charter for B2B logistics, covering how we move goods to retailers, distributors, modern trade, marketplaces, and institutional buyers, as well as stock movement between our plants and warehouses. You will work at the intersection of product, logistics operations, and finance systems, turning the needs of operations and business stakeholders into reliable, well-built features. This is an individual contributor role with end to end ownership of the B2B logistics roadmap and its business impact. You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and logistics partners to deliver it.
Key Responsibilities
B2B Logistics Product Ownership
• Own the product roadmap for B2B logistics flows, including customer orders, stock transfers between locations, and B2B returns, prioritised by business impact.
• Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
• Lead initiatives such as automatic carrier enablement for B2B shipments and the CPG forward and returns flow, from problem definition to rollout and adoption.
• Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
• Maintain a separate B2B layer for carrier and logistics partner integrations, and coordinate with the B2C logistics owner on anything shared.
Delivery Reliability and Network Performance
• Own delivery promise reliability for B2B orders, defining and tracking the metrics that show whether commitments to customers are met.
• Improve network cost, capacity, and delivery performance across carriers and lanes through structured product changes.
• Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground and define improvements that scale.
Compliance and ERP (SAP)
• Own B2B compliance flows such as e-way bills and invoicing, and keep them aligned with SAP.
• Support integration and data consistency between the warehouse systems, logistics partners, and SAP for sales, stock movement, and returns.
• Work with engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.
Governance, Analytics, and Stakeholders
• Drive operations governance and risk reduction by defining clear processes, escalation paths, and checks that prevent repeat failures.
• Use logistics data and dashboards to track performance, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
• Delegate and escalate effectively, and push repeatable manual work toward automation.
• Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to operations, business, and engineering stakeholders.
Must-Have Skills And Requirements
• 1+ years of experience in a product, analytics, or supply-chain technology role.
• BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
• Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
• Working understanding of ERP systems such as SAP and how sales, invoicing, and compliance data flow through them.
• Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
• Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
• High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.
Good-to-Have Skills
• Exposure to logistics, 3PL, carrier management, or B2B supply chain operations.
• Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
• Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
• Familiarity with e-way bill and GST compliance in the Indian supply chain context.
• Exposure to Warehouse Management Systems or quick-commerce operations.
What You Will Gain
• End to end ownership of the B2B logistics charter, from roadmap to measurable impact.
• A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
• Deep exposure to carrier integrations, compliance flows, and SAP across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
• A clear growth path from Associate Product Manager toward a full Product Manager role.
About Company
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Associate Manager Product Growth
description:
Overview
How are you creating an impact?
We are looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented Associate Manager Product Growth, to drive the strategy, development, positioning, launch, and lifecycle management of products and learning solutions for the Higher Education market.
The role will be responsible for translating market, faculty, student, and institutional needs into compelling product propositions, while partnering closely with Editorial, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Customer Success, and Global Product teams.
The ideal candidate should be able to combine product thinking, market understanding, commercial acumen, digital fluency, and strong execution capability to build products that drive adoption, revenue, engagement, and long-term customer value.
What will you be doing?
Product Lifecycle & Adoption
• Create structured plans for product launch, adoption, renewal, and lifecycle management.
• Monitor adoption at institutions, faculty, course, and student levels.
• Develop intervention plans for products with low adoption or declining usage.
• Recommend product revision, repositioning, bundling, migration, or discontinuation based on performance.
Revenue & Commercial Management
• Own and contribute to product-level revenue and margin targets.
• Develop annual product business plans and revenue forecasts.
• Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing, discounting, commercial models, and profitability.
• Monitor product performance against budget and forecast.
• Identify corrective actions for underperforming products
Identify opportunities for:
• 
• 
• Institutional contracts
• Digital subscriptions
• Bundling
• Custom publishing
• Licensing
• Institutional solutions
• E-commerce
• Cross-sell and upsell
Internal Positioning & Messaging
• Defining and communicating the product’s unique value proposition, positioning, and key differentiators, translating product capabilities into clear, compelling messages that resonate with target audiences.
• Develop product positioning frameworks that clearly articulate the customer problem, product solution, key benefits, differentiators, and business value.
• Translate complex product features, content, and technology into simple, customer-centric benefits and outcomes.
• Develop competitor positioning and differentiation statements to help Sales teams communicate the product’s strengths effectively.
• Partner with Marketing to ensure consistency of product messaging across campaigns, websites, email, social media, webinars, events, and sales collateral.
• Equip Sales and KAM teams with product messaging toolkits, battlecards, pitch decks, talking points, and competitive response guides.
• Ensure that internal stakeholders have a clear understanding of “What the product is, Who it is for, Why it matters, and Why customers should choose it.”
List Management & Product Data Governance
• Own and maintain the master list of active products, ensuring completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely updates.
• Maintain accurate product information including product name, ISBN/SKU, edition, discipline, segment, pricing, status, format, digital availability, and other relevant attributes.
• Establish strong data hygiene and governance processes for product and campaign-related databases.
• Ensure product lists are campaign-ready and sales-ready for Marketing, Sales Enablement, e-commerce, reporting, and business operations.
• Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure new products, revisions, discontinued products, pricing changes, and product status updates are reflected accurately and on time.
• Maintain appropriate product lists for marketing campaigns, sales collateral, CRM, e-commerce, reporting, compliance, and management reviews. 
Sales Enablement & Planning
• Enable Sales and KAM teams to effectively communicate product value, articulate differentiation, handle objections, and drive customer adoption.
• Develop and maintain sales enablement tools, including product decks, battlecards, pitch documents, FAQs, competitive guides, product comparison sheets, and objection-handling guides.
• Conduct regular product training and sales enablement sessions to ensure teams understand product features, positioning, target customers, use cases, and value propositions.
• Partner with Sales leadership to identify sales process gaps, productivity opportunities, and adoption barriers.
• Support the effective use and optimization of CRM and sales technology platforms to improve sales visibility, productivity, and execution.
• Develop and maintain sales reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and performance tracking to support data-driven decision-making.
• Support territory planning, account prioritization, opportunity management, and pipeline planning in collaboration with Sales and KAM teams.
• Ensure CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, and governance across relevant product and customer records.
• Analyze sales and customer data to identify product trends, whitespace opportunities, adoption gaps, and revenue opportunities.
We are looking for someone with:
Product Management Expertise 
• Strong understanding of product lifecycle management - ideation, development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
• Ability to develop product strategy, roadmap, positioning, and value proposition.
• Strong understanding of market research, customer insights, competitor analysis, and portfolio management.
• Ability to translate customer and market needs into product requirements and actionable product initiatives.
• Strong commercial understanding of revenue, pricing, margins, adoption, and profitability.
Sales Enablement
• Ability to translate product features into sales propositions and customer benefits.
• Experience developing sales decks, product brochures, battlecards, FAQs, competitor comparisons, objection-handling guides, and product demos.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, pipeline management, account prioritization, and opportunity management.
• Ability to conduct product training and enablement sessions for Sales and KAM teams.
• Strong collaboration skills to bridge Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
CRM, Marketing Automation & Technology
• Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce/SFDC.
• Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or equivalent.
• Understanding of CRM data management, lead management, campaign workflows, and reporting.
• Ability to leverage technology to streamline processes and improve sales and marketing efficiency.
• Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys is desirable.
Data & Analytics Expertise
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to interpret sales, marketing, customer, product, and campaign data and convert insights into actions.
• Experience with dashboards, reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking.
• Knowledge of GA4 or similar digital analytics platforms.
• Strong understanding of marketing and product KPIs including conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, pipeline, and revenue.
• Advanced MS Excel skills; familiarity with Power BI or other visualization tools is an advantage.
Communication & Stakeholder Management
• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
• Ability to communicate complex product concepts in a simple, compelling, customer-focused manner.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, Marketing, Editorial, Technology, Finance, Operations, and senior leadership.
• Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
• Strong facilitation and presentation skills for internal and external audiences.
Strategic & Commercial Thinking
• Strong business acumen and commercial orientation.
• Ability to connect product decisions with revenue, margin, customer value, and business objectives.
• Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on execution mindset
• Strong understanding of competitive dynamics and ability to develop data-backed recommendations.
Education / Domain Knowledge
• Preferred Educational Background: MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Product Management, Business Strategy, or related discipline.
• Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
Preferred Industry Experience:
• Higher Education Publishing
• EdTech / Digital Learning
• SaaS / Technology

Why Work for us?

This position offers a strong foundation and a clear growth path toward product management for the right candidate. You will gain broad exposure to product, commercial, and operational functions within a globally recognized education business working with real data, real products, and real business decisions from day one.

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
Job Description
We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.
Job Summary
As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.
Job responsibilities
• Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
• Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
• Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
• Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
• Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
• Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
• Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
• Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
• Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
• Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
• Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
• 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
• Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
• Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
• Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
• Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
• Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
• Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
• Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
• Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
• Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
• Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate or Data Engineer Associate (or Generative AI Engineer Associate).
• GitHub certification (for example, GitHub Foundations or GitHub Actions) and/or formal Copilot training or enablement.
• Substitution: 2+ years of production, hands-on experience delivering end-to-end business requirements or testing using Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, and GitHub Copilot Agent Mode in banking.
ABOUT US
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
About The Team
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Associate Product Manager - Supply Chain (WMS)
description:
About The Team
Purplle’s Product Management team builds the technology products that power a comprehensive e-commerce platform. The team constantly ships new supply chain features that are scalable, reduce cost, and enhance customer experience. As a team, every individual is expected to make a significant, measurable impact on the business.
About The Role
We are looking for a Product Manager who will own the product charter for our Warehouse Operations end to end, along with the SAP ERP flows that run through it. You will work at the intersection of product, operations, and finance systems, turning the needs of warehouse and business stakeholders into reliable, well-built features. This is an individual contributor role with full ownership of the roadmap, its business impact, and its escalations. You will work closely with backend engineering, the SAP team, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver it.
Key Responsibilities
WMS Product Ownership
• Own the product roadmap for operations and the Warehouse Management System (WMS) workflows used by warehouse teams, prioritised by business impact.
• Translate operational problems into clear Product Requirement Documents, use cases, and acceptance criteria for engineering and QA.
• Own product work on inward, outward, cross dock, throughput, audits, inventory, driving each from problem identification to closure.
• Partner with backend engineering to design, build, and roll out new features, and drive adoption with operations teams.
• Identify workflow gaps and inefficiencies on the ground, then define structured improvements that scale.
• Act as the single owner for the WMS charter, including cross-functional escalations and stakeholder communication.
ERP Systems (SAP)
• Own the integration and data consistency between the WMS and SAP for sales, inventory, stock movement, and reconciliation flows.
• Work with the SAP team, engineering, finance, and operations to debug system-level discrepancies and drive root causes to closure.
• Define, validate, and track the impact of SAP-related product changes on the WMS and on financial accuracy.
• Ensure SAP stays the reliable financial record for WMS inventory and movements.
Business Impact and Execution
• Define success metrics for every initiative and track their impact after launch.
• Use data to monitor warehouse health, surface insights, and drive data-informed product decisions.
• Run regular reviews with engineering and business teams to keep delivery on track and priorities clear.
Must-Have Skills And Requirements
• 3 to 6 years of experience in a product management role.
• BE / B.Tech from a reputed institute. MBA is a plus but not mandatory.
• Strong product fundamentals, including the ability to write clear PRDs and use cases, prioritise by impact, and ship in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
• Some exposure to WMS, DC operations, or SAP, with the ability to quickly learn how inventory and sales data flow across systems.
• Solid data analysis fundamentals and the ability to understand discrepancies across systems.
• Strong verbal and written communication and stakeholder management skills across product, engineering, operations, and finance teams.
• High ownership mindset with the ability to drive a problem from identification to resolution.
Good-to-Have Skills
• Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems and distribution center operations such as inbound, storage, and outbound flows.
• Experience with SAP or a similar enterprise ERP.
• Working knowledge of SQL and comfort querying datasets in a cloud warehouse such as BigQuery.
• Hands-on experience with BI or data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Metabase.
• Exposure to inventory management, e-commerce fulfilment, or quick-commerce operations.
What You Will Gain
• End-to-end ownership of a business-critical WMS charter, from roadmap to impact.
• A role at the intersection of product, supply chain, and technology, with real influence on the roadmap.
• Deep exposure to SAP and ERP integration across a high-volume e-commerce supply chain.
• A clear growth path toward Senior Product Manager.
About Company
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

• MBA (preferred) or advanced marketing certification
Experience

• Minimum 3-4 years in brand management or marketing manager role
• Experience managing ₹2000+ crore revenue brands
Core Competencies & Skills

• Brand Management: Demonstrated expertise in brand building, positioning, architecture, and equity management; understanding of brand architecture and portfolio strategy.
• Digital Marketing Acumen: Proficiency in digital channels (social media, e-commerce, search, content); exposure to marketing automation, CRM, and analytics platforms; understanding of omnichannel consumer journey.

• Communication & Storytelling: Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to craft compelling brand narratives and present insights to senior leadership and external stakeholders.

• Leadership & Collaboration: Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority; proven track record of building and developing marketing teams.

Specific Domain Expertise

• Experience with modern trade (modern retail, e-commerce, quick commerce) and traditional trade (wholesale, kiranas, general trade)

Faces Canada is a leading colour cosmetics brand in India and part of the Purplle Group. We create high-performance, comfortable makeup products for Indian consumers, with a strong presence across e-commerce platforms, Purplle beauty stores, modern trade, and general trade.
The Lips category is one of our largest and fastest-growing portfolios, offering significant opportunities for innovation, growth, and consumer engagement.
About The Role
We are looking for a driven and consumer-focused Senior Brand Manager to lead the Faces Canada Lips portfolio end to end. The role involves ownership of business growth, profitability, pricing, product innovation, brand communication, and channel marketing across online and offline platforms.
You will collaborate closely with R&D, sourcing, sales, e-commerce, digital, design, and retail teams to build winning products, strengthen brand positioning, and drive sustainable category growth.
Key Responsibilities
• 1. Business & P&L Management
• Own revenue, gross margin, and growth targets for the Lips portfolio.
• Monitor sell-in, sell-out, market share, and SKU performance to identify growth opportunities.
• Drive annual and quarterly business planning, including volume and inventory forecasting.
• 2. Pricing & Portfolio Management
• Develop pricing strategies, pack-price architecture, and promotional plans across channels.
• Track competitor pricing, shade ranges, product formats, and claims.
• Optimise the product portfolio by scaling high-performing SKUs and rationalising underperforming ones.
• 3. New Product Development (NPD)
• Identify consumer needs and market opportunities across shades, formats, finishes, and product claims.
• Develop product briefs and drive new product launches in collaboration with R&D, sourcing, packaging, and quality teams.
• Own launch timelines, costing, shade selection, and go-to-market plans.
• 4. Brand Strategy & Communication
• Develop the brand story, positioning, and campaign strategies for the Lips category.
• Brief and collaborate with creative agencies and internal teams on campaigns, packaging, content, and influencer marketing.
• Ensure consistent brand communication across all consumer touchpoints.
• 5. 360° Channel Marketing – Online & Offline
• Partner with e-commerce and performance marketing teams to improve product listings, ratings, search visibility, advertising, and platform performance across Purplle, Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, and quick-commerce platforms.
• Drive in-store visibility across Purplle stores, modern trade, and general trade through visual merchandising, gondolas, testers, sampling, and beauty advisor training.
• Plan trade schemes and consumer promotions with sales teams and evaluate marketing spend effectiveness.
Who We’re Looking For
• MBA/PGDM in Marketing from a reputed business school, preferably Tier 1 or Tier 2.
• 1–2 years of post-MBA experience in brand management, category management, or sales, preferably in beauty, cosmetics, personal care, or FMCG.
• Strong interest in makeup, particularly lip products, including formats, finishes, shade trends, and competitor offerings.
• Understanding of business fundamentals, including revenue, pricing, margins, product innovation, and brand communication.
• Exposure to both online marketplaces/D2C platforms and offline retail channels.
• Strong consumer understanding, market awareness, and the ability to translate insights into business opportunities.
Key Skills & Competencies
• Strong commercial acumen and understanding of P&L fundamentals.
• Analytical thinking and proficiency in Excel, sales data, and business performance dashboards.
• Excellent communication, presentation, and creative briefing skills.
• Strong understanding of beauty trends, consumer behaviour, and influencer-led marketing.
• An eye for aesthetics, packaging, colour trends, and visual merchandising.
• Ownership mindset, agility, and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
Success Metrics – First 12 Months
• Deliver revenue and gross margin targets for the Lips portfolio.
• Launch 2–3 new products on schedule, with at least one emerging as a hero SKU.
• Establish a consistent brand story across online and offline channels.
• Strengthen digital visibility, product ratings, search rankings, and in-store presence for core SKUs.
• Improve portfolio productivity through effective SKU management.
Why Join Us?
• Lead one of the most visible and high-potential categories within a growing Indian beauty brand.
• Take ownership of business outcomes and product innovation from day one.
• Work cross-functionally across product development, brand marketing, digital commerce, sales, and retail.
• Build products and brand experiences that connect with India's evolving beauty consumers.
Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.
About Company
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

Experience marketing in FMCG or OTC healthcare brands is highly desirable. 5+ years of senior level marketing and general managerial experience

title: Category Manager (Diagnostics & Supplements)
description:
Designation: Category Manager (Diagnostics & Supplements)
Reporting to: Chief Growth Officer
About Sova Health
Sova Health is a leading D2C preventive healthcare company focused on transforming personalized wellness through science, data, and AI. Our mission is to build India’s most trusted precision health platform by delivering tailored health solutions that drive measurable outcomes.
The Role
Diagnostics is Sova’s wedge and our largest line. It is where a customer stops guessing about their health and starts acting on evidence. As Category Manager, you are the general manager of this business. You set the price, decide the assortment, choose the channel a launch opens in, and carry the gross margin. You brief the creative and performance teams rather than report into them, and you write the plan everyone else works to.
What You Will Own
Penetration: Make testing simple, affordable and credible enough to become an ordinary purchase. Define the entry point, the ladder above it, and how quickly curiosity turns into a decision.Market Expansion: Take the category into new tests, markets and channels, including partners and B2B2C routes, on evidence rather than enthusiasm.New Products: Find the need through research, write the brief, and take it through product, medical and operations until a customer can buy it.Efficiency: Improve order-to-cash speed, cost per test and how much of the experience runs without intervention, so margin improves as you scale.Marketing: Own personas, messaging architecture and the competitive read. Build the language the category uses, keep it compliant, and brief the studio and performance team against it.Category P&L and Analytics: Diagnose each month’s movement (volume, price, cost, creative fatigue, channel plateau) and run test-and-learn frameworks.
A Typical Week
Reviewing numbers, working with operations on turnaround, working with medical on what a claim can say, analysing why one hook sold and four did not, doing consumer research, and spending protected time on where this category should be in India in three years.
What We Expect
• The category grows faster than the money behind it: more people tested, at better margin, for lower acquisition cost each year. 
• Customers who test once come back for a second and third product, so value sits in the relationship rather than the transaction. 
• Operating economics improve with scale instead of being traded for volume. 
• Reports are clear enough to share with a spouse, a doctor or a group chat. 
• A written playbook that can launch the next condition. 
Who We Think You Are
• 6-10 years of experience, including at least a couple owning a revenue line, not just a roadmap. 
• You have set a price and defended it, and can read a category P&L and tell whether a bad month was volume, price or cost. 
• You can work with clinicians on what a claim is allowed to say without being one. 
• You write clearly, because much of the job is a one-page argument others act on. 
• Background in D2C, healthcare, diagnostics or wellness is a plus. An MBA is useful but not required. 
Key Skills
Category & P&L Management
•  Pricing & Revenue Optimisation
•  Portfolio, Variant & Lifecycle Management
•  Go-To-Market Strategy
•  Category & Cohort Analytics
•  Consumer Research & Personas
•  Competitive Intelligence
•  Test-and-Learn Frameworks
•  Cross-Functional Leadership
•  Partnership & B2B2C Development
Success Metrics (First 6 Months)
• One new test, variant or bundle live, built off a sample we already collect. 
• A measurable lift in the share of people who start the journey and complete it. 
• Turnaround time and cost per test both improving. 
• A clear, measured link between testing and what customers buy next. 
• A go-to-market playbook ready to launch the next condition. 
Hiring Flow: R1 (HR Round) ------> R2 (CGO) ---------> Assignment Discussion -----------> R3 (Founder's Round).

Anesthesia | Intensivist & Critical Care | Antibiotics & Anti-Infectives | Parenteral Nutrition
Organization
Experience
8–12 years in pharmaceutical marketing; relevant hospital therapy experience is essential
Education
B. Pharm / M. Pharm / Life Sciences or relevant scientific qualification; MBA in Marketing preferred
Role Purpose
To drive strategy, brand development and commercial growth across the Hospital Care portfolio, with a strong focus on Anesthesia, Intensivist/Critical Care, Antibiotics/Anti-Infectives and Parenteral Nutrition. The role will translate clinical and market insights into differentiated brand strategies, scientific engagement programmes, effective product launches and actionable field plans to improve hospital access, product adoption, revenue and market share.
Key Accountabilities
1. Portfolio Strategy & Business Growth
• Develop annual brand plans and portfolio growth strategies for anesthesia, critical-care, anti-infective and parenteral nutrition products, aligned with business priorities.
• Identify growth opportunities by therapy, molecule, hospital segment, customer type, geography and account potential.
• Assess market size, growth, competitive intensity, pricing, treatment trends and unmet hospital needs; convert findings into business plans.
• Recommend portfolio expansion, lifecycle management, line extensions and new product opportunities in collaboration with Business Development and cross-functional teams.
• Track revenue, market share, profitability and brand performance; recommend corrective actions against plan.
2. Anesthesia & Critical-Care Marketing
• Build strong therapy-area understanding and brand strategies for products used in anesthesia, operation theatres, ICUs and critical-care settings.
• Develop customer-specific value propositions and communication for anesthesiologists, intensivists, critical-care physicians, surgeons and relevant hospital stakeholders.
• Create scientific and promotional tools addressing approved product benefits, clinical evidence, appropriate use and relevant care-setting needs.
• Map priority hospitals, OT/ICU opportunities, key prescribers and institutional decision-makers with Sales to focus field execution.
• Track competitor activity, product availability, usage trends and customer feedback to refine positioning and engagement plans.
3. Antibiotics & Anti-Infectives Strategy
• Develop brand and portfolio strategies for hospital antibiotics and anti-infectives, including differentiated positioning based on approved indications and evidence.
• Build a clear understanding of infectious-disease and hospital anti-infective pathways, resistance-related challenges, microbiology inputs and institutional treatment protocols.
• Design appropriate scientific engagement plans for intensivists, infectious-disease specialists, microbiologists, pharmacists and antimicrobial stewardship stakeholders.
• Work with Medical Affairs and relevant experts to ensure scientific accuracy, balanced communication and responsible antibiotic promotion.
• Support appropriate antimicrobial stewardship initiatives and ensure all brand activities are aligned with company policy, applicable codes and approved product information.
3A. Parenteral Nutrition & Clinical Nutrition Marketing
• Develop brand and portfolio strategies for parenteral nutrition products, including relevant amino-acid, lipid, glucose, electrolyte and other nutrition formulations where applicable to the approved portfolio.
• Build understanding of nutrition needs and care pathways in ICU, peri-operative, critical-care and other relevant hospital settings.
• Develop appropriate scientific communication for intensivists, anesthesiologists, surgeons, clinical nutrition specialists, dietitians, pharmacists and hospital nutrition teams.
• Work with Medical Affairs to translate approved product information and relevant evidence into accurate, balanced educational and promotional materials.
• Partner with Sales to identify high-potential hospitals, nutrition-support teams, institutional protocols and product access opportunities.
• Track competitor activity, market trends, product availability and customer feedback to refine positioning and identify portfolio opportunities.
4. Brand Planning, Campaigns & Scientific Engagement
• Own end-to-end brand planning: segmentation, positioning, messaging, annual plans, campaign calendars and execution priorities.
• Develop scientific meetings, focused educational initiatives, expert interactions and other compliant engagement programmes for relevant hospital audiences.
• Translate brand strategy into clear field-force messages, detailing aids, objection-handling tools and customer engagement materials.
• Measure campaign effectiveness and return on marketing investment; use feedback and performance data to optimize future activities.
5. New Product Launches & Lifecycle Management
• Lead launch strategy and go-to-market planning, including opportunity assessment, target-account selection, positioning, forecasting and launch milestones.
• Coordinate launch readiness with Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance and Business Development.
• Develop launch training, communication plans and post-launch tracking to support uptake and sustainable performance.
• Monitor lifecycle opportunities, market feedback and competitive response; recommend timely brand-plan adjustments.
6. Sales Force Enablement & Hospital Development
• Partner with Sales leadership to translate brand plans into territory- and account-level action plans.
• Conduct regular field visits and joint work to understand customer needs, assess execution quality and identify opportunities.
• Support product and therapy-area training for KAMs and managers, ensuring strong scientific understanding and consistent communication.
• Work with Sales to identify high-potential hospitals, corporate chains, government institutions, tenders and formulary opportunities.
• Review performance regularly and recommend actions to close gaps in reach, frequency, adoption and sales delivery.
7. Market Intelligence, Forecasting & Business Reviews
• Track relevant market data, competitor brands, pricing, product launches, hospital trends and portfolio performance.
• Prepare sales forecasts, brand dashboards, monthly reviews and strategic presentations for management.
• Establish KPIs for revenue growth, market development, launch performance, campaign effectiveness and resource utilization.
• Use primary and secondary research, customer feedback and field insights to support evidence-based decisions.
8. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Compliance
• Work closely with Sales, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance and Business Development to deliver portfolio objectives.
• Manage marketing budgets and prioritize investment based on business potential and measurable impact.
• Ensure promotional materials and activities meet applicable regulatory requirements, company policies and pharmaceutical marketing codes.
• Maintain scientific integrity, fair-balance communication, approved-indication compliance and responsible antibiotic-use principles.
Candidate Profile
• 8–12 years of pharmaceutical marketing experience, with demonstrated exposure to hospital products in one or more of the following: anesthesia, critical care/intensivist, antibiotics/anti-infectives or parenteral nutrition/clinical nutrition.
• Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience across at least two of the four therapy areas, including meaningful hospital-care exposure.
• Demonstrated success in brand planning, product launches, market development and delivery of measurable business outcomes.
• Good understanding of Indian hospital business, institutional sales, clinical stakeholders, formulary processes and competitive dynamics.
• Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
• Ability to convert scientific and market information into clear brand strategy and practical field execution.
• Willingness to travel for market visits, customer interactions and business reviews.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
• Achievement of portfolio sales, growth and profitability targets.
• Brand performance and market-share improvement across anesthesia, critical-care, anti-infective and parenteral nutrition portfolios.
• Successful launch execution and achievement of launch milestones and forecasts.
• Growth in priority hospital access, formulary inclusion and institutional business opportunities.
• Effectiveness of brand plans, scientific engagement initiatives and marketing investment.
• Improvement in field-force capability, campaign adoption and quality of execution.
• Accuracy of forecasts, quality of market insights and timely delivery of business reviews.
• Compliance with company policies, applicable marketing codes and responsible antibiotic communication standards.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

• Enable society-led robotic education, evidence generation, and guideline influence.
• Establish strategic relationships with society leaders, elevating Intuitive as a trusted partner in shaping the future of surgical care.

• Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to influence across sales, clinical, regulatory, and regional teams.
• Proven leadership of multi-stakeholder initiatives in complex environments.
• Strong wing-to-wing experience with launching complex medical device products in India – leadership experience across all aspects of launch planning and execution
• Deep, hands-on data analysis skills with a demonstrated ability to use data to develop market and product insights, inform decision-making and tailor product messaging

description:
Job Description
Purpose of Role
The Regional Marketing Manager owns the development of integrated marketing plans across an assigned portfolio of schools, translating Group, Regional and School objectives into prioritised activity that supports enrolment growth, strong brand positioning and local market needs.
The role acts as the integrator of Marketing capability, identifying business needs, setting priorities and orchestrating delivery through school Marketing teams and specialist Marketing Hub capabilities. The Regional Marketing Manager is a hands-on Marketing leader and expected to personally deliver work where appropriate but is not expected to replicate specialist Hub capabilities. The role identifies needs, sets priorities and brings together the right local/school and specialist capability to deliver the strongest business outcome.
Successful candidates will think like a business owner (not just a marketer), communicate clearly, take ownership of outcomes, prioritise effectively across multiple schools, and balance strategy with execution.
Key Responsibilities
• School Marketing Planning Develop and own integrated Marketing plans for assigned schools, aligned to enrolment priorities, market dynamics and school positioning. Ensured Group, Regional and school-specific priorities are integrated into one holistic school marketing plan.
•  "> ">undefined

Own Marketing performance across assigned schools. Use agreed Marketing and enrolment data to identify demand, lead-quality and conversion gaps, drive corrective action at the school level and request specialist intervention where required.

Ensures USPs and proof points are translated into effective storytelling assets across priority parent touchpoints. While content delivery is shared across school teams and specialist Hub capability, this role is expected to be a hands-on marketer who can personally conceptualise, develop and improve high-priority content where required.

title: Marketing Manager, RBS Retail Efficiency
description:
Description
Are you customer centric, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution focused, entrepreneurial, and passionate about protecting brands? Do you want to be part of one of the fastest growing and most innovative brand protection businesses? Are you interested in a high impact, high ownership role that sits at the intersection of product authenticity, brand trust, and customer confidence? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you. Come join our team and help define the course of Amazon's product authenticity and brand protection business.
Amazon's vision is to be Earth's most customer-centric company and the most trusted place for brands to grow and protect their business. We build programs and solutions that help brand owners verify product authenticity, secure their supply chain through serialization, and build customer trust — delighting millions of brands and customers every day.
We are looking for a smart, metrics and results-oriented Product Marketing Manager to independently own our most important brand-facing product authenticity initiatives — the "big rocks" that move the business. You will set the go-to-market and adoption roadmap for our product authenticity and serialization programs, build and scale marketing campaigns across the funnel, and define the dashboards and mechanisms that track enrollment, adoption, engagement, and retention.
Key job responsibilities
•  Owning and driving the biggest, product marketing initiatives for brand protection and authenticity programs end to end — from strategy through execution and measurable business impact.
•  Designing and scaling account-based marketing (ABM) programs that target high-value brands and segments with tailored, high-touch messaging around supply chain integrity and anti-counterfeiting solutions.
•  Owning the full marketing funnel — awareness, lead generation, enrollment, activation, and retention — and independently driving conversion improvements at each stage.
•  Building and scaling lifecycle and nurture programs (email, social, webinars, outbound, onboarding journeys) that move brands from awareness to active adoption of authenticity solutions.
•  Leading go-to-market strategy for major new feature and program launches, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, and cross-program placements.
•  Defining the metrics, dashboards, and mechanisms used to measure program health (enrollment rates, serialization adoption, scan rates, brand engagement), and reporting performance and recommendations to senior leadership.
•  Developing content and thought-leadership strategies (case studies, playbooks, webinars, brand-facing events) that drive awareness and enrollment at scale for product authenticity programs.
•  Establishing best practices and reusable playbooks, and mentoring peers and junior team members to raise the bar across the org.
Basic Qualifications
•  3+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
•  Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
•  Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
•  Experience using Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data

description:
Description
We are building Amazon's first horizontal self-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule-based systems into outcome-learning, context-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each with distinct adoption barriers, decision types, and stakeholder personas.
We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own and execute the adoption strategy for this platform. This is not a traditional marketing role — it requires equal parts strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and hands-on execution in a highly technical, multi-org environment where trust is earned
Key job responsibilities
Demand Generation & Awareness

•  Drive multi-tenant, multi-org awareness across diverse personas: system owners, engineering leads, domain SMEs, and senior leadership sponsors
Adoption Funnel Ownership
•  Own the full adoption funnel: awareness → consideration → prototyping → onboarding → live
•  Identify and address persona-specific barriers at each stage — awareness and perceived ROI at the top, data readiness and bandwidth commitment in the middle, trust and governance at launch
•  Build and maintain tenant pipeline visibility — track where each prospect is in their lifecycle and what moves them forward
Go-to-Market Execution
•  Develop and iterate on messaging and positioning that resonates with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple organizations
•  Create onboarding enablement assets: tenant-facing toolkits, self-serve assessment guides, workshop playbooks, and experiential prototyping materials
•  Partner with product, science, and engineering teams to translate platform capabilities into customer-facing value narratives
Cross-Org Stakeholder Management
•  Navigate complex multi-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries
•  Build relationships with decision-makers in prospective tenant orgs and drive them through consideration cycles
•  Work closely with UDE organizations to align defect-driven demand with platform onboarding pipeline
Measurement & Iteration
•  Define and track adoption metrics: funnel conversion rates, time-to-onboard, awareness penetration, pipeline quality
•  Run experiments on messaging, channels, and engagement tactics — iterate based on data
•  Report adoption health to platform leadership with actionable insights
Basic Qualifications
•  5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
•  5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
•  Experience communicating technical concepts and processes using clear, simple language and visuals
•  Experience driving demand and managing a customer funnel across multiple channels
•  Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
•  Experience marketing horizontal platforms or developer/infrastructure tools to internal or external enterprise audiences
•  Demonstrated ability to drive adoption in multi-stakeholder environments where the buyer ≠ the user ≠ the sponsor
Preferred Qualifications
•  Experience in platform adoption within large-scale technology organizations (internal platforms, SaaS, or enterprise tooling)
•  Familiarity with ML/AI product marketing — ability to credibly engage with science and engineering teams
•  Experience with multi-tenant platform economics and self-serve go-to-market models

• Competitive Intelligence: Monitor the competitive landscape across healthcare communications and practice management technology. Translate competitive insights into actionable sales battlecards, targeted marketing campaigns, differentiation strategies, and product roadmap recommendations.
• Internal and Partner Enablement: Equip Sales, Customer Experience, and partner teams with effective enablement materials, sales guides, case studies, and customer proof points to support conversion and strengthen opportunities across priority healthcare verticals.
• EHR/PMS Ecosystem and Partner Marketing: Collaborate with Partnerships teams to develop co-marketing strategies for integrations with electronic health record (EHR) and practice management software (PMS) providers. Create campaigns that leverage partner channels to generate qualified leads, expand reach, and drive mutual pipeline growth.
• Growth and Revenue Optimization: Use product analytics and funnel performance data to identify opportunities for improved feature adoption, conversion, customer expansion, and revenue growth. Align marketing initiatives with measurable business outcomes, including pipeline velocity and annual recurring revenue (ARR).
Requirements
• Professional Experience: 3–8 years of product marketing experience in B2B SaaS, with a proven track record of owning marketing initiatives for a specific industry vertical, product line, or business unit.
• Market Research Expertise: Strong experience conducting qualitative and quantitative research, including surveys, customer interviews, focus groups, measurement tools, and data analysis. Familiarity with research platforms such as Qualtrics is an advantage.
• Healthcare Industry Knowledge: Solid understanding of healthcare practice operations, patient journey touchpoints, and the EHR/EMR technology landscape. Familiarity with dental technology, patient communications, or healthcare practice management software is a plus.
• Product-Led Growth (PLG): Experience working with product-led growth funnels and using analytics platforms such as Pendo, Mixpanel, or Amplitude to measure feature adoption, understand user behavior, and optimize growth loops.
• Data-Driven Marketing Mindset: Ability to combine compelling messaging and positioning with analytical rigor. Comfortable measuring marketing effectiveness through pipeline velocity, conversion rates, customer expansion, and vertical-specific ARR.
• Lifecycle and Expansion Marketing: Experience in customer marketing, cross-selling, upselling, customer migration, or retention campaigns, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively with Product Managers, Growth Engineers, Sales Leaders, and external partners without relying on formal authority.
• Technical and Marketing Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, survey platforms, interview-recording tools, data analytics solutions, and internal sales enablement tools.
• Strategic Thinking and Execution: Strong problem-solving skills, a bias for action, and the ability to simplify complex challenges, identify long-term opportunities, and deliver sustainable solutions.

description:

Lead Generation & Outreach Strategy
