title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
About Sibros Technologies
Who We Are
Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
Our Mission
Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
Follow us on
LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram
About The Role
Job Title: Supply Chain Manager
Experience: 8+ years
Location: Pune
We are looking for a Global Supply Chain Manager to own the end to end supply chain for Sibros hardware. This is an ownership role, not a coordination role. You will own supplier relationships and agreements, demand planning against long component lead times, global trade and customs compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India, carrier and third party logistics partnerships, and the inventory system of record. You will set the policies that govern how we forecast, buy, hold, move, and return hardware, and you will be accountable for the cost, timing, and compliance of every unit that moves.
The role sits at the point where customer commitments meet supplier capacity. Component lead times run six to twelve months, we order against forecasts ahead of customer purchase orders, and we are building our own telematics control unit alongside our existing supplier portfolio. You will own the risk that sits inside that gap. You will work directly with Finance on inventory exposure, with Sales and Technical Program Management on customer commitments, with Legal on supplier and export compliance, and with Engineering on new product introduction.
This role is built for someone who raises problems early, escalates without being asked, and closes them without being chased.
What You'll Do
• Supplier Management and Procurement- Own supplier relationships end to end, from qualification and onboarding through agreement execution and ongoing commercial management. Ensure every supplier is onboarded under a signed agreement before we transact. Issue approved purchase orders to suppliers within 24 hours and drive supplier follow through to committed dates.
• Demand Planning and Inventory Strategy- Build and maintain the rolling demand forecast that long component lead times require. Set and maintain regional buffer stock levels and reorder points. Own the inventory position against both committed and forecast customer demand, and surface working capital exposure to Finance before it is committed rather than after.
• Global Trade and Customs Compliance- Own import and export compliance across the United States, the European Union, and India. Maintain entity registrations, EORI and VAT numbers, product classifications, Incoterms, and customs broker relationships. Ensure every shipment departs with complete and correct documentation so that clearance is routine rather than an escalation.
• Logistics, Carrier, and 3PL Management- Own carrier and third party logistics relationships, contracts, and rates. Manage freight and landed cost per unit as a reported metric with a target. Own shipment escalation end to end, including direct escalation into carriers, so that Engineering and Technical Program Management are never asked to execute logistics work.
• Returns, Warranty, and Device Lifecycle- Own the returns and warranty process from customer intake through supplier claim and closure. Maintain unit level traceability across serial number, IMEI, and SIM for every device from receipt through decommissioning.
• Systems, Reporting, and Process Ownership- Own the inventory system of record and its accuracy. Maintain the operating procedures and runbooks that govern the hardware process. Publish the weekly open order report, the monthly inventory reconciliation, and the quarterly demand forecast, and hold the numbers to an audit ready standard.
• New Product Introduction Support- Support the launch of Sibros designed hardware by owning supplier selection, component sourcing strategy, contract manufacturer evaluation, and the supply chain readiness plan from prototype through production.
What You Should Know
• Education: Bachelor's / Master's degree in any discipline.
• Professional Experience: 8+ years in supply chain, procurement, or global logistics, including at least 3 years owning a function rather than executing within one.
• Demand Planning: Demonstrated ownership of a demand forecast against component or finished goods lead times of six months or longer, including buffer stock policy and reorder point setting.
• Trade Compliance: Hands on ownership of import and export documentation and customs clearance in at least two of the United States, the European Union, and India, including direct management of customs brokers.
• Commercial Management: Experience negotiating and managing supplier, carrier, and third party logistics contracts, and managing freight and landed cost as a controlled expense.
• Systems: Ownership of an ERP or inventory management system as the system of record, with advanced Excel and Google Sheets capability for reconciliation and reporting.
• Ownership and Escalation: A proven record of raising risks early, escalating without prompting, and closing issues without follow up. This is the most important requirement of the role.
• Communication: Clear and timely communication across the United States, European Union, and India time zones with internal teams, suppliers, carriers, and customers.
Preferred Qualifications
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field. APICS CPIM, APICS CSCP, or CIPS certification.
• Industry Context: Experience in hardware enabled, IoT, automotive, or embedded systems environments, including exposure to automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949.
• New Product Introduction: Experience taking a new hardware product from prototype to volume production, including electronics manufacturing services and contract manufacturer selection.
• Regional Expertise: Established customs broker and freight forwarder relationships in India, and working familiarity with the India to European Union and India to United States shipping lanes.
• ERP Proficiency: Experience with NetSuite, Odoo, Zoho, QuickBooks, or other ERP and inventory tools, and with Jira as an operational workflow system.
• Lifecycle Management: Exposure to returns, reverse logistics, refurbishment, and end of life device disposition.
What We Offer
• Competitive Compensation: A package inclusive of performance incentives.
• Growth Environment: A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and rapid career advancement.
• Learning & Development: Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
• Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and a culture that promotes balance.
• Comprehensive Benefits: Health insurance and wellness programs.
• Modern Policy: Flexible vacation and paid time off, you decide when you need a break.
• Team Culture: Regular team events, off-sites, and a budget for online courses, books, and conferences.
Employment Opportunity
Sibros is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. We recruit, employ, train, compensate, and promote without regard to race, color, age, sex, ancestry, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, present or past history of mental disability, genetic information or any other classification protected by state or federal law.

title: Manager Business Optimization
description:
About Us
As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.
Overview of the role
Work with Procurement and planning teams to optimize the economic and operational performance of the plan-to-produce and source-to-pay processes across multiple food-ingredient manufacturing sites. The role combines demand and production planning, procurement analytics, cost analytics, and the digitalization of both functions — including applied AI and automation. It exists to close the value leakage that sits between planning, buying, and finance, and to engineer it out of the process permanently.
Key Responsibilities
• Demand & production planning — work alongside the demand and production planners who own the plan: strengthen the statistical forecast baseline for a multi-thousand-SKU portfolio, introduce forecast variance and FVA discipline, improve line-level scheduling logic across blending and packaging capacity, and sharpen MRP shortage, scenario and S&OP analytics.
• Procurement analytics — equip category buyers with the analysis behind their decisions: vendor pricing and spend visibility, category planning and coverage tooling, BOM-based demand attribution to suppliers, supplier risk classification, and should-cost and make-vs-buy support.
• Cost & financial analytics — give Finance and Operations a common, trusted view of where value leaks: standard cost roll-up through multi-level BOMs, manufacturing variance analysis (PPV, yield, absorption), margin and working-capital impact of planning policy, SLOB/E&O exposure, and inventory and DIO reporting.
• Service performance — measure OTIF and fill rate on the customer's own methodology and attribute every miss to a planning, supply or capacity root cause, so the accountable function can act on evidence rather than opinion.
• Digitalisation & AI — the accountability owned outright: replace manual spreadsheet processes with auditable automated systems, build the planning and procurement decision tools the functions run on, and apply AI to analysis, extraction and workflow automation with defined validation and governance.
• ERP & planning systems — support the functional process owners through ERP and planning-platform implementation and migration: requirements definition, master data governance, data migration, UAT, cutover and hypercare.
• Influence & team leadership — direct and quality-assure an offshore analytics team, and earn adoption without direct authority by working through the incumbents in Commercial, Procurement, Manufacturing, IT and Finance who own the processes being improved.
Experience and Qualification 
• Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Statistics, Accounting or a related quantitative field.
• Cost or management accounting qualification (CMA / CIMA / ICMAI or equivalent) held alongside operational supply chain accountability.
• 10+ years spanning all three of demand planning, production planning, and procurement analytics — depth in one or two is not sufficient.
• 3+ years in food, beverage, spice or food-ingredient manufacturing (allergen controls, lot traceability, shelf life).
• Administrator-level configuration experience on an advanced planning system (DemandCaster strongly preferred), plus hands-on ERP data-level SQL in more than one dialect (Plex and Snowflake strongly preferred).
• Full-lifecycle ERP or planning-platform implementation as business process owner, through cutover and hypercare.
• Applied intermittent-demand forecasting (Croston, SBA, TSB, ADI/CV² classification, Forecast Value Add).
• Proven ability to build and deploy production-grade planning and procurement tools independently — advanced Excel engineering plus browser-based analytics applications. No dedicated developer support in this role.
• Demonstrated AI-enabled automation in production use, with a stated efficiency or accuracy result and a described validation and governance approach.
• Multi-site accountability and experience directing an offshore analytics team.
• Preferred: CPIM / CSCP / CPSM; Python or R; SAP IBP / S4 or Blue Yonder exposure; agricultural commodity or packaging category experience.
First Year Success Measures
Success in year one is evidenced by working systems in daily use and a quantified benefit, not by analysis delivered:
• Planning — corrected end-to-end capacity model in live use by the planners, and FVA reporting running in the monthly S&OP cycle.
• Procurement — buyer category console deployed and adopted by the buying team, with coverage and supplier risk visible in one place.
• Cost & working capital — quantified PPV and working-capital benefit agreed with Finance, and reduced aged SLOB exposure.
• Service — measurable OTIF and fill-rate improvement on the customer's own methodology, with every miss attributed to a root cause and owner.
• Digitalisation — phase one of the roadmap delivered, with the manual spreadsheet routines it replaced retired rather than run in parallel.

You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. You will be at the forefront of delivering impactful solutions to our clients, leveraging your skills to optimize procurement processes and enhance value capture strategies. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. • Lead localization, resourcing and product transfer initiatives to improve cost, lead time and supply security.
Customer & Supplier Planning
• Own project-level demand planning; translate order backlog and forecast into a rolling 18–24 month supplier forecast.
• Align customer required dates with supplier capability; manage buffer, safety and consignment stock strategies for critical items.
• Actively represent supply chain in the S&OP process; balance project demand against capacity and component availability.
• Manage production prioritization jointly with Operations based on order urgency and component readiness.
Engineering Interface
• Partner with Engineering on BOM readiness, make-or-buy decisions, alternate/approved-vendor qualification and obsolescence management.
• Provide supply chain feedback into design-to-cost, standardization and component rationalization programs.
• Ensure engineering change requests are assessed for cost, lead time and inventory impact before release.
Tendering Management
• Support Tendering and Sales with cost inputs, supplier quotations, lead-time commitments and risk assessment during bid preparation.
• Validate scope, terms and delivery feasibility before bid submission; flag supply-side risks, escalation clauses and currency/commodity exposure.
• Ensure a clean handover from tender to execution, with cost assumptions, supplier selections and schedules carried through.
Cost, Data & Reporting
• Deliver annual cost savings targets (material cost, freight, inventory) and track them transparently.
• Own SAP master data governance for the project business: material master, MDF, delivery and payment terms, contracts and outline agreements.
• Provide MIS dashboards and reporting on OTD, shortages, backlog, overdue orders, inventory turns, PPV and savings pipeline.
Risk, Compliance, HSE & Integrity
• Ensure compliance with internal and external regulations, procurement policy, export/import requirements and sub-contracting rules.
• Maintain supply risk register with mitigation plans for single-source, geopolitical and capacity risks.
• Uphold Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, taking responsibility for own actions while caring for colleagues and the business.

• Proven leadership of a supply chain / procurement team in a project or ETO (engineer-to-order) business.
• Strong exposure to EMS suppliers and knowledge of the electronic and electrical component landscape.
• Demonstrated expertise in strategic and tactical procurement, supplier negotiation and contract management.
• Solid understanding of project planning, S&OP, MRP logic and medium- to long-term supply planning.
• Experience supporting tendering/bid processes with cost and lead-time inputs.
• Working knowledge of export/import processes, sub-contracting and consignment models.
• Hands-on SAP ERP (MM/PP) experience; advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint; comfortable with data analysis and dashboards.
• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional influence at management level.

title: Strategy & Planning Manager
description:
Meet the Team
Join Cisco’s Global Supply Chain Strategy & Planning team, an internal consulting organization focused on solving the most complex, cross-functional supply chain challenges that span multiple functions.
The team takes ambiguous business problems from problem framing through analysis, recommendation, and leadership decision-making. Recent engagements have included designing operating models for new fulfillment capabilities, benchmarking Cisco against competitors, and building analytical business cases for significant inventory and sourcing decisions.
Your Impact
As a Strategy & Planning Manager, you will own a workstream within a larger strategic engagement and work closely with the Engagement Lead. You will be accountable for structuring the problem, leading the analysis, engaging stakeholders, and developing a clear recommendation that leadership can act on.
You will combine quantitative analysis, business judgment, external benchmarking, and stakeholder management to develop a point of view, clearly articulate trade-offs, and influence senior leaders toward informed decisions.
What You’ll Do
You will own a workstream end-to-end, from problem definition and structuring through analysis and final recommendation.
You will build the quantitative analysis that underpins strategic decisions, including financial models, scenarios, business cases, and analytical frameworks, using clearly defined assumptions where data is incomplete.
You will independently manage stakeholder relationships across Business Units, Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Channel, and Finance, bringing together conflicting inputs and driving alignment without unnecessary escalation.
You will conduct external benchmarking and competitive analysis where relevant, translating findings into clear implications and recommendations for Cisco.
You will develop and defend a clear point of view, articulate key trade-offs, and confidently respond to challenge from senior stakeholders.
You will present your workstream findings to senior leaders and contribute to the broader engagement storyline and recommendation.
You will guide analysts supporting your workstream by reviewing their analysis, strengthening problem structuring, and developing their communication and presentation skills.
Who You’ll Work With
You will collaborate with Business Units, Supply Chain Planning, Sourcing, Logistics, Channel, Finance, and senior business stakeholders across Cisco.
You will also work closely with the broader Strategy & Planning team and Engagement Leads on cross-functional strategic engagements.
Who You Are
You are a structured, analytical, and commercially minded problem solver who is comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information.
You can quickly break down open-ended problems, determine the key questions that need to be answered, build a fact base, and turn analysis into a clear recommendation.
You are confident working directly with senior stakeholders, can navigate conflicting perspectives, and are comfortable defending your point of view with data and business logic.
You communicate top-down and answer-first, ensuring that your recommendations are clear, concise, and actionable.
Minimum Qualifications
• 7+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or supply chain operations.
• Proven experience owning workstreams from problem definition through completion.
• Demonstrated ability to structure open-ended and loosely defined business problems into an actionable analytical framework.
• Strong ability to build quantitative models from incomplete data using clearly stated assumptions.
• Experience independently managing relationships with senior stakeholders.
• Strong ability to communicate top-down and lead with the answer rather than the analysis.
• Demonstrated ability to form, communicate, and defend a recommendation under challenge.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in operations or supply chain consulting, particularly in operating model design, inventory, network design, or process improvement.
• Experience mentoring, coaching, or reviewing the work of junior analysts.
• Experience with analytical tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, or Tableau.
• Experience working across global teams, geographies, and time zones.
Why Cisco?
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Demand Planner
description:
ABOUT THE WELLA COMPANY
Together, WE enable individuals to look, feel, and be their true selves.
Wella Company is one of the world’s leading beauty companies, comprised of a family of iconic brands such as Wella Professionals, Clairol, OPI, Nioxin and ghd. With 6,000 employees globally, presence in over 100 countries, Wella Company and its brands enable consumers to look, feel, and be their true selves. As innovators in the hair and nail industry, Wella Company empowers its people to delight consumers, inspire beauty professionals, engage communities, and deliver sustainable growth to its stakeholders.
For additional information about the Wella Company please visit www.wellacompany.com
THE ROLE
The primary objective of this role is to lead the strategic demand planning function for the India business. This position bridges the gap between commercial strategy and supply chain execution, overseeing a portfolio exceeding $50M+ and driving digital transformation through advanced analytics and standardized planning ecosystems.
The incumbent will lead the end-to-end planning cycle; from the moment a marketing idea is born to the moment the product lands in a regional DC. You will drive project management through cross-functional leadership, spearheading network optimization and process improvements that unlock significant working capital. As a people manager and S&OP leader, you nurture a high-performing team while aligning country-level sales targets with global supply capabilities.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: INDIA
S&OP & Demand Orchestration: The role acts as the "Custodian of Demand" for the India business, you own the demand signal across a complex, multi-layered market, ensuring supply chain agility for diverse business models:
S&OP Orchestration: You lead the monthly S&OP cycle, collaborating with commercial team to integrate brand building blocks into 18-month consensus forecast
Omnichannel Strategy: Direct the demand planning strategy for the rapidly growing Ecommerce and Quick Commerce channels, utilizing historical data and promotional inputs
Forecast Excellence: Optimize demand sensing for a portfolio of 1,000+ SKUs, consistently targeting and achieving forecast accuracy above 80%.
Portfolio Health: Manage the Phase-In/Phase-Out (PIPO) transitions for new product launches, collaborating with global initiative leaders to keep E&O inventory below 1%.
Inventory Optimization: Strategize stock deployment to maintain a 75-day inventory holding at local Distribution Centres while balancing service levels with working capital constraints.
Cost Savings Initiatives : Leading cross-functional projects to improve the structural efficiency of the supply chain. This is where you drive bottom-line value through "smart" supply chain moves
Unlocking Capital: Identify and execute network optimization projects, such as the strategic addition of new import locations, to bring efficiency in working capital
Operational Excellence: Steer strategic initiatives related to product transfers between manufacturing plants and optimizing container utilization to reduce annual logistics costs.
PRINCIPLE KPIs: Forecast Accuracy, BIAS, Fill Rate, Inventory Excess & Obsolete, Cost saving initiatives.
KEY REQUIREMENTS:
• MBA from Premier Institute like IIM, NITIE, S P Jain, IIT etc
• Minimum 5-7 years prior experience
• The person should have handled Demand Planning preferably in an FMCG industry
• Technical Knowledge: SAP, IBP, Kinaxis, O9, Advanced Excel, Forecasting tools etc.
• Strong quantitative and analytical skills
KEY INTERNAL / EXTERNAL RELATIONSHIPS:
• Sales – RSMs, Trade Marketing team and Ecom KAMs
• Marketing – Brand Managers
• Finance
• Distribution requirement planners, Logistics Operations Managers etc
• Global supply chain stakeholders (ESP, Process experts, LCM, SP, IP etc)
KEY LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES:
• Drive for results
• Creates Collaborative Relationships
• Action Oriented
• Business Acumen
• Organizational Agility

title: Manager- ROI Operations
description:
Porter: Creating Impactful Journeys
At Porter, we're not just passionate about improving productivity; we're on a vision to Moving a billion dreams one delivery at a time. We empower businesses, both large and small, to optimize their operations and unleash unprecedented growth in their core functions. Join us in pioneering the future of last-mile logistics, one that's poised to disrupt the industry and redefine the way we think about transportation.
Why Porter?
• Industry Leadership: As the fastest-growing leader in last-mile logistics, we have a pan India and International presence with operations spanning multiple cities. With a fleet size exceeding 750k driver partners and 15 million customers. Porter is at the forefront of this dynamic and rapidly expanding sector.
• Cutting-Edge Technology: Our industry-best technology platform has garnered over $150 million in investments from renowned backers, including Sequoia Capital, Kae Capital, Mahindra Group, LGT Aspada, Tiger Global, and Vitruvian Partners. We leverage technology to drive efficiency, innovation, and unparalleled service.
• Ambitious: We're not just solving problems; we're addressing a massive challenge and going after a market with a valuation surpassing $50 billion USD. Our ambition extends beyond last-mile delivery; we aim to disrupt all facets of logistics, including warehousing and LTL transportation.
• Thriving Community: Join a community of passionate individuals who are committed to doing the best work of their lives. At Porter, we value the spirit of collaboration, innovation, and embracing challenges head-on.
If you’re looking for a high-ownership, high-impact HR role where culture, speed, and scale intersect, this is your chance to shape it from the ground up.
Be a Part of Something Extraordinary:
If you're ready to make an impact, be at the forefront of innovation, and embrace the challenges and opportunities of a fast-paced work environment, Porter is the place for you. We're not just building a brand; we're creating a household name in transportation. Join us and be part of the revolution – where every day is an opportunity to redefine what's possible.
If you are ready to make a significant impact and shape the future of Porter, apply now and be part of our exciting journey!
Company URL: https://porter.in/
Why this role exists
Kanpur is a city full of potential that hasn't been fully unlocked yet. We need someone who'll walk in, feel the pulse of the city, and build Porter into the brand people think of first when they need to move anything a sofa, a full house, or a single carton.
This isn't a "maintain and report" role. This is a "figure it out, fix it, grow it" role. You'll own everything revenue, demand, supply, team, customer experience, and P&L. If Kanpur wins, it's because of you. Simple.
What you'll actually do
1. Own the City. All of it.
• Full P&L ownership across all Porter service lines in Kanpur.
• Diagnose what's not working. Build what's missing. Scale what's working.
• Ensure operational discipline TAT, SLAs, quality. No shortcuts.
2. Drive Demand. Not Just Fulfill It.
• Design and execute demand initiatives campaigns, partnerships, local activations. Whatever it takes to get more orders rolling in.
• Work with central marketing and product teams to localize strategies that actually land in Kanpur.
• Think like a founder for the city. If demand isn't growing, that's your problem to solve.
3. Build a Supply Engine
• Own supply onboarding, activation, and retention.
• Quality-first supply base. Weed out the unreliable. Double down on the best.
• Make Kanpur a city where partners want to work with Porter.
4. Customer Experience- Obsess Over It
• Every bad experience is a story that spreads. Fix root causes, not symptoms.
• Handle escalations with speed. Build systems so the same problem doesn't come back twice.
5. Lead a 20+ Member Team
• Hire sharp. Coach hard. Retain the best.
• Own attrition like it's your P&L metric, because it is.
• Set clear goals, run tight reviews, create a culture of ownership.
6. Know Kanpur Better Than Anyone
• Micro-market dynamics, pricing, competition, routes, customer behavior, you should have an opinion on all of it.
• Feed insights back to central teams. Be the voice of Kanpur in every leadership room.
7. Cross-Functional Hustle
• Partner with Product, Analytics, Central Ops for SOPs, GTMs, and process rollouts.
• You're not waiting for a playbook. You're writing one.
Who are we looking for?
The non-negotiables:
• 2–4 years in ops, category, or city-level P&L roles. You've run something, not just supported it.
• You've built teams. Not coordinated- actually hired, fired, coached, and led.
• High data comfort + even higher ground instinct. You use both.
• You'll visit the field on day one. And day hundred.
• Communication that moves people- up, down, sideways.
Bonus points if you have:
• Stints at companies obsessed with experience- Swiggy, Zomato, Zepto, Rapido, Delhivery , FMCG organisation.
• Logistics, mobility, or marketplace ops background.
• Tier 1/2 MBA or Tier 1 engineering (IIT/NIT/BITS).
The kind of person who'll love this role
You're the one who reads a bad customer review and can't sleep until it's fixed. You get energy from chaos, not anxiety. You've probably told your last manager "just let me run it" at least once. You want a city-sized canvas, a team to build, and the freedom to make real decisions.
If the idea of owning an entire city's operations at one of India's fastest-growing logistics companies makes you lean forward- we should talk.

title: Sr. Operations Manager- South Asia supporting RMIT University
description:
Designation- Sr. Operations Manager- South Asia supporting RMIT University
Experience- 5+ years
Education- MBA Operations or Business Management or a related degree
Location- Delhi
About OneStep Global: 
OneStep Global, a market entry firm specialized in the higher education sector. OneStep Global helps
global universities, colleges, and government organizations to land and expand across Asia, through
stakeholder management and in country representation. OneStep Global has been working with some very
prestigious universities and colleges across the world. The solutions vary from market development,
market entry and market presence. 
About RMIT University
RMIT is a global university of technology, design and enterprise, committed to creating transformative
student experiences and making a meaningful impact through research, innovation and engagement.
At RMIT, leadership is a shared responsibility demonstrated by all staff. It is grounded in RMIT’s six core
values and reflected through the Be–Know–Do Leadership Model:
 Be: Open, authentic, inclusive, empowering and purpose-driven.
 Know: Self-aware and informed about stakeholders, the sector and priorities.
 Do: Set clear expectations, develop others and promote accountability for results.
Role:
The Senior Manager, Operations – South Asia provides strategic and operational leadership for RMIT’s
South Asia teams. The role ensures that operations are efficient, compliant, consistent and aligned with
RMIT’s strategic priorities and student-centred approach.
Working with Melbourne-based functional leaders across Admissions, Recruitment, Sales and Conversion,
the role translates global priorities into effective local delivery. It leads operational coordination, people
capability, process governance, performance, risk, compliance and continuous improvement across the
teams.
Functional ownership of Admissions, Recruitment and Conversion remains with the relevant Melbourne-
based functional leader. The Senior Manager, Operations ensures that these priorities are translated into
coordinated, compliant and effective local execution across South Asia.
Reports to: Associate Director, Admissions, Pathways and Operations
Dotted reporting lines to:
 Assistant Director, Global Sales & Conversion
 Associate Director, International Student Recruitment
Key accountabilities
1. Operational leadership and stakeholder coordination
 Lead the day-to-day operations of RMIT’s South Asia across Admissions, Recruitment and
Conversion.
 Translate RMIT and global functional priorities into clear local plans, priorities, service expectations
and operating rhythms.
 Coordinate activities across Melbourne and South Asia, managing capacity, workloads,
dependencies, risks and escalations.
 Provide local operational insight to support planning, resourcing, decision-making and student-
centred service delivery.
 Build effective relationships with functional leaders, corporate teams and other
stakeholders.
2. Process governance, risk and compliance
 Translate global requirements into practical local procedures, controls and operating guidance.
 Drive adherence to RMIT policies, approved systems, delegations, workflows, turnaround times,
quality standards and service levels.
 Maintain clear documentation, role responsibilities, approval pathways, escalation arrangements
and audit trails.
 Identify and reduce process deviations, duplication, rework, inconsistency, unclear ownership and
compliance risks.
 Maintain risk and issue registers, coordinate corrective and preventative actions, and support
audits and compliance reviews.
3. People leadership and capability
 Lead, support and develop South Asia Team Leads and staff in partnership with Melbourne-based
functional leaders.
 Set clear expectations for performance, conduct, accountability, priorities and service delivery.
 Monitor team productivity, capacity, workload distribution and effectiveness.
 Support workforce planning, resource allocation, training, succession planning and professional
development.
 Build an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing culture aligned with RMIT’s Be–Know–Do
Leadership Model.
4. Performance, improvement and change
 Establish and monitor measures for productivity, quality, compliance, service levels, turnaround
times, backlogs and capacity.
 Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify trends, resolve root causes and improve operational
outcomes.
 Lead process reviews and approved changes to systems, policies, processes and operating models.
 Ensure changes are communicated, implemented and embedded effectively.
 Promote continuous improvement that strengthens efficiency, compliance, service quality and
student outcomes.
Key selection criteria
 Minimum five years’ experience in operations, service delivery or delivery management, preferably
in education, admissions, student services, international recruitment or another compliance-driven
environment.
 Experience leading high-volume, process-intensive operations and managing teams across multiple
functions, locations or markets.
 Experience translating global or organisational processes into practical local procedures and
operating models.
 Experience with governance, risk, compliance, audit, quality assurance or internal control
frameworks.
 Experience using performance data to improve productivity, quality and service outcomes.
 Experience working with senior stakeholders in a global, matrixed or geographically dispersed
environment.
 Experience in international education, student services, process improvement, systems
implementation or organisational change is desirable.
 Ability to lead change and embed consistent ways of working.
 Integrity, accountability, sound judgement and attention to detail.
 Commitment to RMIT’s values, student-centred approach and Be–Know–Do Leadership Model.
Availability and start date: 
Immediate, however any notice period for the right candidate will be honored.
NOTE: 
OneStep Global is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to the employment policies, procedures and practices which do not discriminate on grounds such as gender, marital status, family status, age, disability, race, religious belief, sexual orientation.

title: Manager - P2P Operations - GO/JC/4607/2026
description:
Job Title: P2P Operations
Job Location: Hyderabad
Work Model: WFO
Candidate Expectations
Total Experience and Relevant Experience: 10–15 years of overall experience with strong relevant experience in Procure-to-Pay (P2P) operations and service delivery management.
Candidate Location: PAN India
Skills – Mandatory
End-to-end service delivery management
SLA and KPI management
Customer relationship and governance
Financial and business performance management
Escalation management
Resource and workforce planning
Cost optimization
Process automation, RPA and analytics
Compliance and process governance
People and performance management
Attrition management
Pyramid optimization
Stakeholder management
Education and Certification
Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / MBA / ICWA / CA
Jd
Detailed Job Description
Lead end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) operations while ensuring adherence to agreed SLAs, KPIs and customer commitments.
Manage P2P processes including procurement support, purchase orders, invoice processing, exception management, vendor management and payment-related activities.
Ensure zero-surprise delivery through proactive monitoring of operational performance, risks and potential issues.
Drive delivery against financial, operational and business objectives.
Manage customer and stakeholder relationships through structured governance, performance reviews and regular communication.
Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement, value creation and additional business within existing engagements.
Ensure timely resolution of customer escalations, invoice exceptions, process issues and operational challenges.
Drive P2P KPI metrics such as productivity, turnaround time, invoice accuracy, exception rate, SLA adherence and process efficiency.
Identify and implement automation opportunities using RPA, analytics and digital solutions across P2P processes.
Identify key cost drivers and implement initiatives for cost optimization and productivity improvement.
Ensure compliance with financial controls, audit requirements, policies and defined P2P process standards.
Plan resources based on transaction volumes, business requirements and available headcount.
Drive effective workforce utilization, capacity planning and responsibility allocation.
Conduct performance reviews and appraisals while driving individual and team performance.
Manage attrition through employee engagement, skip-level meetings and targeted retention initiatives.
Drive continuous improvement, standardization and process transformation across P2P operations.
Ensure effective pyramid optimization to improve productivity, cost efficiency and workforce effectiveness.

title: Program manager - growth
description:
Operation Manager Growth: Admissions, Marketing, Operations & Academics (Bangalore and Hyderabad)
Tilia Children's House | Bangalore and Hyderabad | Full-time, on-site
About us
Tilia Children's House is a new Montessori-led school group that grows into Cambridge (IGCSE). We are opening and running campuses in Bangalore and Hyderabad, and we are backed by the K-12 / Orchids network.
The role
You will be the single point of ownership for how our schools perform in the market and on the ground. You will fill seats, run campuses smoothly, and make sure the Montessori classroom experience is delivered well. You will report directly to the Chief Academic Officer and work across both cities.
What you will do
Admissions and marketing:
Own the enquiry-to-enrolment funnel for each campus, including lead follow-up, campus tours, counselling and conversion.
Plan and run local marketing: community and apartment outreach, open houses, events, referrals, digital and print.
Track enquiries, visits and enrolments weekly, and fix what is leaking.
Operations:
Keep campuses running day to day: staffing, vendors, facilities, safety, compliance, parent communication.
Support campus launches, including setup checklists, hiring support and readiness for opening.
Manage budgets and cost discipline across campuses.
Academics:
Work with the academic team to make sure the Montessori programme is implemented well: classroom quality, teacher practice, materials and observation routines.
Be the parent-facing academic voice, handling concerns, progress conversations and expectations.
Leadership:
Lead and develop campus coordinators and teachers across both cities.
Report regularly on admissions, operations and quality, and flag problems early.
Who we are looking for
Either an MBA (marketing, operations or general management) with a strong bias for action, or hands-on experience running or working in a preschool or early-years school.
2+ years of experience in school admissions, preschool operations, education marketing or a similar field-facing role. We will weigh energy and ownership over pedigree.
A strong communicator with parents, staff and vendors, in English plus Kannada, Telugu or Hindi (preferred).
Comfortable with data, simple dashboards and weekly review rhythms.
Willing to travel between Bangalore and Hyderabad regularly.
A builder's mindset: you are happy to work in a start-up setting where you will often have to make things up as you go.
To apply
Send your CV and a short note on why this role suits you to [email / form link]. Shortlisted candidates will be called immediately.Role & responsibilities
Preferred candidate profile 
Experienced School Operations:
Candidates with 8–10 years of experience managing operations across two or more preschools, primary schools, or school campuses. Strong experience in team leadership, admissions growth, parent engagement, budgeting, and academic operations is preferred.

title: FINANCE OPERATIONS-SCO-Proc-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY-GDS: Business Consulting -SC&O (Supply Chain & Operations) – Manager (Procurement Operations)
As part of our EY‑GDS team, you will play a critical role in shaping and elevating our clients’ Procurement Operations. As a manager, you will lead complex engagements that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen compliance and controls, and embed digital solutions across the end‑to‑end procurement lifecycle. You will guide teams in delivering measurable improvements in service delivery, process performance, and procurement maturity, while developing the next generation of operations talent. Your leadership and operational expertise will directly influence how our clients modernize their procurement function. Additionally, you will contribute to building our procurement operations capability, supporting go‑to‑market initiatives, and leading key operational excellence pursuits.
The opportunity
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager with 8–10 years of strong procurement and supply chain operations expertise, backed by a solid Managed Service background and deep knowledge across core procurement sub‑functions such as P2P, sourcing operations, supplier management, contract, spend analytics and operational governance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic, operations‑focused leader capable of designing and optimizing procurement operating models, driving process excellence, embedding digital procurement capabilities, and leading large‑scale transformation initiatives. This role requires exceptional stakeholder management, the ability to build trusted relationships at senior levels, and the leadership skills necessary to guide high‑performing teams while delivering measurable, high‑impact improvements in procurement operations.
Your Key Responsibilities
The Manager will lead end‑to‑end Procurement Operations across PR‑to‑PO processing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Management, Spend Analytics, and Managed Services Governance. Responsibilities include overseeing the requisition‑to‑order process, ensuring contract activation, amendments, renewals, and compliance, and aligning all transactions with contracts, catalogs, and pricing agreements. The role will also manage transitions through knowledge transfer, documentation, readiness assessments, and stabilization while ensuring SLA performance and continuous improvement. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
• PR to PO Operations & Contract Management
• Lead end-to-end PR to PO operations, including requisition processing, approvals, PO creation, amendments, and closures.
• Oversee Contract Lifecycle Management, including contract activation, amendments, renewals, expiry management, and compliance.
• Ensure alignment between PR/PO transactions and active contracts, catalogs, and pricing agreements.
• Govern procurement controls, approval matrices, and audit readiness across operations.
• Transition Management & Service Stabilization
• Lead transition activities for procurement operations, including knowledge transfer, process documentation, and readiness assessments.
• Manage transition planning across PR-PO and Contract Management processes, ensuring minimal business disruption.
• Drive stabilization post-transition, including SLA tracking, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
• Managed Services & Stakeholder Management
• Manage managed services engagements, including service governance, SLA/KPI management, and performance reviews.
• Act as the primary interface with client stakeholders, service providers, and internal teams.
• Drive effective communication, issue escalation, and resolution across procurement operations.
• Procurement Process Integration & Enablement
• Apply working knowledge of adjacent procurement areas such as supplier onboarding, sourcing handoffs, spend visibility, and compliance.
• Ensure smooth integration between procurement operations, contracts, and downstream finance processes (e.g., invoice compliance, accruals).
• Leverage procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, ServiceNow, ERP systems, and supplier portals to enable operational efficiency.
• Continuous Improvement & Governance
• Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation.
• Support reporting, governance forums, audits, and internal control reviews.
• Mentor and guide team members within procurement operations.
• Supplier Management & Governance
• Lead supplier onboarding, performance management, compliance monitoring, and issue resolution.
• Establish and manage supplier governance frameworks including KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, and review cadences.
• Monitor supplier risk, dependency, and compliance, and escalate issues to senior stakeholders as required.
• Act as the primary interface between suppliers, procurement teams, and business stakeholders.
• Spend Analytics & Optimization
• Lead spends analytics to identify cost reduction, demand management, and value optimization opportunities.
• Analyse spends across categories, suppliers, and regions to generate actionable insights.
• Develop and present dashboards, reports, and management insights to support decision-making.
• Partner with sourcing and finance teams to track savings and benefits realization.
• Systems Enablement, Managed Services & Stakeholder Leadership
• Leverage procurement and analytics platforms such as SAP Ariba, ServiceNow, ERP systems, BI tools, and supplier portals to enable supplier governance and spend visibility.
• Ensure data accuracy, reporting integrity, and adherence to controls.
• Lead supplier and managed services governance forums, including SLA and performance reviews.
• Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior client and internal stakeholders.
Skills And Attributes For Success
• 8–12 years of experience in Supplier Management, Spend Analytics, Procurement Operations, or related roles.
• Strong experience in supplier governance, spend analysis, and stakeholder management.
• Hands-on exposure to procurement and analytics tools such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, iValua, Jaggaer, ServiceNow, ERP platforms, and BI tools.
• Proven ability to operate in managed services and transformation environments.
• Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
• Supply chain consulting experience in Big 4, Supply chain global consulting firms preferred
• Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30%, depending on project requirements
To qualify for the role, you should have
• Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Analytics, or related discipline.
• MBA or professional certifications (CIPS, CPSM) preferred.
• Consulting or global delivery experience is an advantage.
What We Look For
• A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
• An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide
• Opportunities to work with EY SCO practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What Working At EY Offers
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
• Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
• Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
• The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
EY | Building a better working world 
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: USI-EH27-Consulting Services-FT-FinOps-Manager/Executive Manager – Treasury Operations

title: Program Manager
description:
Job Description – Program Manager
K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd. | Orchids The International School
Location : Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Coimbatore, Mumbai
About K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd.
K12 Technoservices Pvt. Ltd. is associated with Orchids The International School, an education organisation focused on delivering quality schooling and creating meaningful learning experiences for students.
Website: www.orchidsinternationalschool.com
Job Title: Program Manager – School Operations & Business Development
Role overview
The Program Manager will be responsible for managing the overall operations, business development, admissions, and revenue growth of the assigned school branch. The role requires an individual who can effectively manage cross-functional teams, drive admission and revenue targets, execute field marketing initiatives, build strategic partnerships, and ensure smooth day-to-day school operations.
The position will act as a key link between the school branch, parents, employees, management, and central corporate teams to ensure operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business growth.
Key responsibilities
1. Business development, admissions & revenue growth
• Drive overall admission targets and revenue generation for the assigned school branch.
• Develop and execute strategies to increase student enrolment s and achieve business objectives.
• Monitor admission pipelines, conversion ratios, revenue performance, and collection targets.
• Identify new business opportunities and potential catchment areas for student admissions.
• Build and maintain relationships with parents, preschool partners, tutors, and other relevant stakeholders.
• Establish and manage preschool tie-ups and strategic partnerships to generate admission leads.
• Ensure timely collection of tuition fees, transport fees, fines, and other applicable charges.
• Monitor outstanding fee dues and ensure timely follow-up and collection.
2. Field sales & team management
• Lead, manage, and monitor a team of approximately 5-10 members responsible for field sales, counselling, and business development.
• Set individual and team targets, monitor performance, and ensure achievement of assigned goals.
• Guide, motivate, and develop team members to improve productivity and business outcomes.
• Conduct regular performance reviews and provide necessary coaching and support.
• Ensure effective coordination between field sales, counselling, admissions, and marketing teams.
• Participate in recruitment and selection of administrative and business development team members.
3. Marketing, field activities & brand promotion
• Analyse local marketing needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
• Develop and implement field marketing and business development plans.
• Plan and execute Below-the-Line (BTL) activities, promotional campaigns, events, and community engagement initiatives.
• Identify opportunities for school promotions and increase brand visibility within the assigned catchment area.
• Coordinate with internal marketing and corporate teams for campaign execution.
• Plan, organise, and host admission-related events and promotional activities.
• Evaluate campaign performance and submit reports on lead generation, conversions, and outcomes.
4. School & branch operations
• Ensure smooth day-to-day operations of the assigned school branch.
• Oversee administrative functions, campus maintenance, housekeeping, inventory, and vendor management.
• Ensure the school campus, playgrounds, courts, and other facilities are maintained appropriately.
• Monitor inward and outward movement of materials and maintain relevant records.
• Coordinate with Procurement, Logistics, Projects, Academics, Marketing, HR, and other corporate departments.
• Identify operational gaps and implement standardised processes to improve efficiency.
• Monitor branch-related operational reports and present updates to management.
5. Parent relationship management & grievance resolution
• Act as the primary point of contact for parents regarding non-academic matters.
• Ensure timely resolution of parent complaints and grievances.
• Monitor the complaint register and coordinate with the Front Office, Accounts, and Campus teams for closure.
• Build strong parent relationships and maintain a high level of service satisfaction.
• Handle escalations professionally and ensure effective communication with stakeholders.
6. Staff administration & employee coordination
• Monitor staff strength, attendance, and workforce requirements at the branch.
• Coordinate with HR for recruitment, attendance regularisation, salary processing, and employee-related matters.
• Ensure employee grievances are addressed and escalated to the appropriate departments.
• Maintain proper recruitment and employee-related records.
• Support training and development initiatives for branch operations and administrative teams.
7. Transport & infrastructure management
• Monitor daily school transport operations and ensure smooth functioning of the bus fleet.
• Ensure timely vehicle maintenance and proper functioning of GPS/GPRS tracking systems.
• Coordinate with transport vendors and ensure compliance with prescribed safety procedures.
• Ensure regular driver breathalyser testing as specified by company procedures.
• Monitor campus maintenance registers and ensure timely closure of maintenance issues.
8. Finance, collections & vendor management
• Monitor branch-level fee collections, outstanding dues, and revenue reports.
• Manage branch petty cash and ensure supporting documentation is maintained.
• Coordinate vendor payments and ensure timely submission of invoices and supporting documents.
• Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed service standards.
• Coordinate with Finance and Accounts teams for financial and operational requirements.
9. Management reporting & stakeholder coordination
• Prepare and present regular reports on admissions, revenue, collections, marketing activities, and branch operations.
• Conduct periodic performance reviews and provide updates on business targets.
• Coordinate with management, trustees, parents, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
• Support quarterly reviews and ensure timely closure of assigned action points.
• Ensure effective communication and coordination across all business verticals.
Desired candidate profile
• Educational qualification
• Graduate in any discipline is required.
• Postgraduate qualification or MBA in Business Administration, Marketing, or Operations will be an added advantage.
Experience
• Experience in business development, field sales, school operations, admissions, or education-sector management.
• Hands-on experience in managing and driving field sales teams.
• Experience in handling revenue targets, admissions, marketing activities, and stakeholder relationships.
• Exposure to branch operations, vendor management, and administrative functions will be preferred.
Skills and competencies
• Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Strong business acumen and revenue-driven mindset.
• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and stakeholders.
• Excellent planning, execution, and problem-solving abilities.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret business and operational reports.
• Customer-centric approach with a focus on parent satisfaction.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
• Willingness to travel locally between branches and assigned locations.
Key performance indicators (KPIs)
• The performance of the Program Manager will be evaluated on:
• Achievement of admission and revenue targets.
• Fee collection efficiency and reduction in outstanding dues.
• Lead generation and admission conversion rates.
• Productivity and performance of the field sales team.
• Number and effectiveness of preschool and other strategic tie-ups.
• Execution and effectiveness of BTL marketing activities.
• Parent satisfaction and timely grievance resolution.
• Efficiency of school operations and campus maintenance.
• Vendor management and operational cost control.
• Timely reporting and coordination with corporate teams.

title: Manager, Operations as a Service, North America Supply Chain (NASC)
description:
Description
Amazon is a global technology and operations company serving customers across multiple businesses and geographies. Our teams build and operate scalable solutions across a wide range of functions, with a focus on customer experience, operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Employees work in a fast-paced environment, partnering across teams and geographies to solve complex business problems and deliver results at scale.
Operations as a Service (OaaS enables the business to deliver products and services to customers across the globe. Our teams manage complex, high-volume processes and continuously improve how work is executed through standardization, technology, data, and automation. The role offers an opportunity to work across teams and geographies, solve operational challenges, and drive improvements at scale.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities
An OaaS Manager within GSRC typically leads teams of up to 20 associates, including SMEs and ICs supporting broader programs. The role requires cross-geography stakeholder management and collaboration across programs. Key responsibilities include:
•  Business & Process Ownership: Own business metrics, process performance, and continuous improvement against defined goals.
•  Stakeholder Management: Partner with stakeholders across geographies to understand business priorities, align execution, and deliver agreed business outcomes.
•  Process Management: Onboard and stabilize new processes; identify and eliminate root causes of defects through cross-functional collaboration.
•  Metrics & Business Reviews: Analyze trends and gaps; provide insights and contribute to WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and other business reviews.
•  Automation & Scaling: Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and scalable solutions; drive adoption across teams.
•  SOP & Governance: Establish and maintain SOPs, processes, and tools to ensure consistent execution and performance.
•  Talent Management: Set goals, coach and develop associates, SMEs, and ICs, and build functional and leadership capabilities.

title: Manager, Embedded Finance Operations
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
Beyond point-of-sale and digital ordering, Toast offers financial solutions, including Toast Capital, that help restaurants access the funding they need to grow. We are building a new Embedded Finance Operations footprint in Bengaluru, and we're looking for the leader who will build it. This role is an extended arm of Toast's US Embedded Finance Operations team (40+ people) and is critical as we expand our footprint and international strategy. The role sits within the Embedded Finance Operations organization and partners closely with the US-based underwriting team and its leaders. As Manager of Embedded Finance, you will set up and lead a high-performing underwriting function from the ground up, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Risk partners in Bengaluru and with your leadership in the US.
This is a player-coach role. You'll understand the lending business deeply enough to make and review credit decisions yourself, while building the team, processes, and tooling that let the function scale.
The scope is big. This team sits at the center of how Toast uses automation, data, and AI to change how lending operations work. If you're a lending operations leader who loves building something new, brings an automation and analytics mindset, and can lead people through change, read on!
A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)
• Build the underwriting function from the ground up. Stand up Toast's Embedded Finance Operations presence in Bengaluru: define the operating model, workflows, quality standards, SLAs, and controls for a high-performing underwriting team. 
• Lead as a player-coach. Manage a team of underwriters directly and few team members on a dotted line. Stay hands-on with underwriting decisions, case reviews, and escalations while coaching the team to consistent, high-quality outcomes. 
• Hire and grow the team. Partner on annual planning to shape headcount and capacity needs, then recruit, onboard, and develop talent as the team expands. 
• Drive automation and AI transformation. Find opportunities to automate manual underwriting and operations work, and partner with Product and Engineering to build and roll out AI-enabled tools, decisioning workflows, and self-serve processes. 
• Make operations data-driven. Define the metrics that matter (throughput, turnaround time, decision quality, accuracy) and build the BI dashboards and analytics that track performance, surface risk, and guide decisions. 
• Build strong cross-functional partnerships. Act as the operations voice to Product, Engineering, and Risk stakeholders in Bengaluru. Translate operational insight into product requirements and policy feedback. 
• Work as part of a global team. Partner closely with the US-based underwriting team and leaders, and with global Embedded Finance counterparts, to align on priorities, policies, and standards across time zones. 
• Lead through change. Guide the team through new processes, tools, and ways of working with clear communication, empathy, and a steady focus on outcomes. 
• Maintain strong risk and compliance discipline. Make sure underwriting practices follow credit policy, regulatory expectations, and internal controls, and support audits and reviews as needed. 
• Use AI tools in your own workflow and help set how the team uses them well, including how to critically evaluate what they produce. 
What You'll Need To Thrive (Requirements)
• 10+ years of experience in lending, credit, or financial services operations, with a strong understanding of the lending business and the underwriting lifecycle. 
• Hands-on underwriting or credit decisioning experience (small business, merchant, or commercial lending preferred), with the judgment to make and review complex credit calls. 
• Proven people leadership experience: you have managed and grown teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and building team culture. 
• Experience building or scaling an operations function, ideally in a new market or a new team. 
• A strong background in process automation, BI, and data analytics. You can work with data directly (e.g., SQL, Excel, Looker, Tableau or similar) and use it to drive decisions. 
• A track record of leading teams through change, including adopting new tools, processes, or operating models. 
• Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, and Risk partners without direct authority. 
• Experience working in global teams and collaborating across time zones, including regular overlap with US-based leadership. 
• Strategic thinking combined with an execution-focused, roll-up-your-sleeves approach. 
• Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain complex operational and credit topics simply to a range of audiences. 
• Comfortable using AI-powered tools to improve productivity and decision-making, with the judgment to validate what they produce. 
What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)
• Experience in fintech, embedded finance, or merchant cash advance / small business lending. 
• Experience implementing AI or machine-learning-assisted decisioning or workflow automation in an operations setting. 
• Experience setting up a new center of excellence or global capability center in India. 
• Familiarity with credit risk frameworks, fraud prevention, or KYC/KYB processes. 
• Lean, Six Sigma, or other process-improvement experience. 
• Experience in restaurant, hospitality, or SMB-focused businesses. 
AI at Toast
At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.
Our Total Rewards Philosophy 
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.
How Toast Uses AI In Its Hiring Process
Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring
Our Approach to Hybrid Working
We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast
People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success
At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

description:
Manager, Transformation & Operations
Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
Experience: 10-15 years
About the Company
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global professional services firm providing advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management, and interim leadership services to companies, investors, and government entities. Founded in 1983 as a restructuring boutique, A&M is known for practical, action-oriented solutions that help organizations tackle complex issues, improve operating performance, create value, and accelerate results across six continents. Its mission is to help organizations solve complex business issues and maximize stakeholder value. A&M’s culture is grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with founding principles of Leadership, Action, and Results. In 2023, A&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The GCC partners with case teams on end-to-end delivery and thought leadership, serving industries including Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center has grown to more than 1,000 professionals.
About the Role
As Manager, Transformation & Operations, you will own transformation workstreams and operational initiatives within A&M’s Corporate Shared Services team in the Gurgaon Global Capability Center. Reporting to the Director of Corporate Shared Services & Operations, you will convert strategic priorities into executable plans, reliable transitions, improved processes, and reusable operating capability. Your scope will span GCC/GBS transition planning, process design, documentation, business-case analysis, and operational excellence across functions such as HR, Marketing, and IT. This is a senior execution role for a hands-on operator with consulting rigor. You will work independently with functional teams, local operations, regional partners, and senior leaders while influencing without direct authority. The role is not a people-management position or a client-facing advisory role, although you will mentor junior colleagues and contribute to capability building.
Key Responsibilities
• Own two to three transformation or operational workstreams from planning through execution, using structured project plans, risk controls, quality reviews, and leadership reporting to deliver agreed outcomes.
• Execute GCC process transitions through detailed plans, handover controls, process documentation, training content, and change support that enable stable adoption by functional and operations teams.
• Design and maintain reusable playbooks, job aids, process libraries, and knowledge assets that codify best practices, improve consistency, and reduce dependency on individual process owners.
• Analyze costs, volumes, productivity, and efficiency metrics to identify improvement opportunities and build financial models, ROI calculations, and business cases for leadership decisions.
• Translate complex operational information into clear leadership updates, recommendations, and implementation priorities that support operating model governance and timely decisions.
• Partner with HR, Marketing, IT, regional teams, and GCC operations to resolve dependencies, influence without direct authority, and maintain momentum across interconnected initiatives.
• Mentor junior team members in consulting-style problem-solving, documentation standards, and execution discipline while supporting training plans for new associates.
• Track lessons learned and transition outcomes to strengthen future implementation methods, improve operational readiness, and build scalable capability across the growing GCC.
Essential Skills & Technologies
• 10–15 years of experience, including at least 10 years in GCC/GBS transformation, shared services, operations consulting, or project-delivery-focused corporate operations roles.

title: Business Operations Manager
description:
About the role: 
Run our international patient business at CureMeAbroad as if it were your own company. You'll own the P&L end-to-end, know the revenue, margin, and unit economics of every specialty, hospital, and source market, and act on those numbers through pricing, package design, and cost control. You'll work directly with the founding team as a thought partner on where the business goes next. This is a founder-style, business-owner role, not a process-management role.
What you'll do:
• Own the P&L for patient services: revenue, gross and contribution margin, budgeting, and forecasting.
• Track unit economics by specialty, hospital, and source market, and turn them into decisions on pricing, packages, and cost control.
• Identify and test new growth bets, such as new specialties, packages, or source markets, and build the business case for the ones worth scaling.
• Work with the partnerships team on hospital commercial terms: rate cards, volume commitments, and quality-linked pricing.
• Work with finance on budgets, cost estimates, and monthly reporting.
• Drive patient operations and customer success outcomes (turnaround times, retention, referrals, patient satisfaction) through the ops and CS team, and stay accountable for their impact on margin.
• Flag and escalate critical and high-risk cases to the founders.
• Build dashboards and a regular business review that show where we make and lose money, and bring recommendations, not just reports, to the founding team.
What you'll bring (must-have)
• 4-6 years of total experience, with 2+ years owning or closely managing a P&L, business unit, or budget.
• 3+ years of full-time experience in a startup or scale-up. This is mandatory: you're comfortable with ambiguity, thin processes, and wearing multiple hats.
• An entrepreneurial track record: you've built something from scratch, launched a new line of business, or founded or co-founded a venture.
• Strong command of unit economics, margins, and forecasting, and comfort building models in Excel or Sheets.
• Ability to negotiate and structure commercial terms with external partners.
• Clear communication and comfort working with clinical, ops, finance, and partnership stakeholders across time zones.
Good to have:
Background in strategy, consulting, business-unit management, or finance business partnering.
Experience in healthcare, medical travel, hospitality, or another high-touch service business.
About CureMeAbroad:
CureMeAbroad is a global medical tourism technology platform helping patients from high-cost markets such as the US, UK, Germany, and Australia discover, compare, and connect with verified hospitals and surgeons across India, Turkey, Thailand, Mexico, and Spain. Join a fast-growing, global healthcare technology company and work closely with the founding team to build scalable people practices, strengthen organisational culture, and support business growth.
