Role Purpose
We are looking for an experienced and commercially astute Purchase Manager to manage end-to-end procurement of goods and services across programme, CSR, project and administrative requirements.
The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring competitive sourcing, value for money, timely procurement, vendor development, effective negotiations, documentation and compliance, while maintaining high standards of transparency and integrity.
The ideal candidate will be a hands-on procurement professional with strong commercial acumen, excellent negotiation capabilities and sound understanding of procurement governance. The individual should be comfortable managing multiple procurements simultaneously and dealing with diverse stakeholders, vendors and project requirements across locations.
The role requires an individual who can balance cost, quality, timelines, compliance and programme requirements while maintaining transparency and strong procurement controls.
Key Responsibilities
• Manage the end-to-end procurement cycle, from receipt of approved requirements through sourcing, RFQ/RFP, evaluation, negotiation, PO/WO issuance, delivery and closure.
• Review purchase requisitions/MRFs and ensure specifications, quantities, budgets, delivery locations and timelines are adequately defined.
• Identify, evaluate, develop and maintain a strong network of OEMs, manufacturers, authorized dealers, suppliers and service providers.
• Float RFQs/RFPs, obtain competitive quotations and prepare technical/commercial comparative statements.
• Lead commercial negotiations covering pricing, payment terms, delivery, warranty, AMC/CMC, transportation, installation, commissioning, training and after-sales support.
• Ensure procurement decisions consider quality, compliance, service capability and total cost of ownership, in addition to price.
• Prepare and manage Purchase Orders, Work Orders, rate contracts and procurement-related agreements.
• Manage diverse CSR and project procurements, including educational materials, IT equipment, healthcare/medical equipment, specialized vehicles, water systems, furniture, infrastructure and other programme requirements.
• Coordinate with user/technical teams for evaluation of specialized requirements and ensure technical specifications are appropriately approved.
• Monitor delivery, installation, commissioning and acceptance of goods/equipment.
• Track vendor performance, warranty obligations, service support and contractual commitments.
• Develop rate contracts and annual agreements for repetitive requirements and identify opportunities for procurement consolidation and cost optimization.
• Maintain complete procurement documentation to ensure audit readiness and process compliance.
• Prepare procurement MIS covering open requirements, POs, deliveries, savings, vendor performance and procurement turnaround time.
• Coordinate closely with Programme/Project Teams, Finance, Administration, IT, HR, technical teams and other internal stakeholders.
Qualification & Experience

Description
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Supply Chain & Procurement organization works to deliver solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!
The IPS Procurement Category Management Org is responsible for the procurement of all third party provided services required for the operation of our Data Center infrastructure globally, including Colo and Edge facilities for externally delivered services not provided by the facility owner. The team is responsible for the identification, on boarding and performance management of suppliers as well as developing category strategies, conducting competitive tendering processes, supplier negotiations and the preparation of associated Work Orders.
The team is structured into three regions, each led by a regional manager, with each regional team composed of category managers with responsibility for the management of specific areas of spend within the region and a cohort of procurement specialists who support the category managers. The category management approach facilitates a strategic approach to procurement by facilitating in depth market analysis coupled with a cross functional approach to identify supplier and associated contracting options which are focused on meeting the particular needs of the business. Category management moves beyond traditional transactional based purchasing negotiations to provide a strategic approach to longer term, sustainable cost reductions, reducing risk and increasing resiliency in the supply base and facilitating innovation from within the supply base that the business can leverage.
While cost reduction will always be a key focus of the team, the principle cynosure of the team is the delivery of services that are keenly focused on increasing reliability and supporting enhanced availability through robust relationships which support continuity of operations. As service and quality levels can vary greatly, principally based on the skill set within a supplier local organization, the regional structure facilitates tailoring of category strategies to meet local market considerations and closely monitor supplier performance at the local level.
Key job responsibilities
The ideal candidate thinks long term, drives multiple initiatives, and communicates appropriately and influences customers and suppliers at all levels. You must be collaborative, but also work with significant autonomy. To be successful in this role you must be highly analytical; think strategically and globally; have a sense of urgency to meet customer timelines; exhibit curiosity and learning drive; succeed in a fast-paced environment; engage and influence key stakeholders; and have a high level of customer focus and business judgement. Also, you must have a demonstrated track record of managing multiple projects and driving them to completion to meet business objectives. It will be critical to embrace and model Amazon’s Leadership Principles and have an entrepreneurial spirit with a “get it done” mentality.
• Manage a complex category within the Maintenance, Repair, and Operation (MRO) and Facility Management domains.
• Achieve cost savings through bidding and negotiations, drive collaboration to achieve long term value delivery.
• Obtain market intelligence, analyze category data and metrics to drive Procurement category strategies.
• Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns, across categories and regions, to influence customers’ priorities.
• Lead supplier selection process across multiple sub-categories, internal teams, and regions, and create longer-term supplier selection strategies for management.
• Ensure you are knowledgeable about the supply market, new innovations and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically.
• Ensure you are knowledgeable about sustainability, diversity, in-country value and have experience developing category strategies to incorporate same.

• Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle.
• Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as SRM and management of contracts post-execution.
Travel domestic and international as required.

• Frontline Listening Mechanisms: Uses pulse surveys, focus groups, and skip-level interviews to gauge employee sentiment and surface operational issues.

title: Senior Human Resource Business Partner
description:
About Voy
Voy is one of the largest DTC online healthcare providers in the world. Present in the UK, Germany, Brazil and India. Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. EarlyFit started as India’s first full-stack tech-led GLP-1 led weight loss platform. At the intersection of healthcare, science, and consumer technology, we combined GLP 1, medical expertise, endocrinologist-led care, diagnostics, nutrition coaching, and ongoing behavioral support into one seamless experience.
About The Space
GLP-1s represent a quantum leap in healthcare (think penicillin!) and possibly the biggest healthcare opportunity of our lifetimes. The GLP market went from 0 to $60B in just 8 years and estimated to grow to $200B in the next 10. Several multi-billion dollar companies like Voy, Found, Ro and Hims and Hers have ridden this wave that’s only just arrived in India with the 2025 launch of Mounjaro and Ozempic. We’re 8 years behind the US and Europe (which is super frustrating but also…) means there is a unique opportunity to category create in a white space (think Paytm for mobile wallets) and in the process, give 10+ years of healthy life to each patient we onboard. Sure, we have some catching up to do but the Indian GLP space has something the West doesn’t - Generics. The patent for semaglutide (Ozempic) in India expired in March 2026 bringing monthly medication prices from Rs 20k a month to Rs 3k a month. With 250 million obese Indians who can now suddenly afford life-changing medical help that’s never existed in the country before, you do the math.

• Coach leaders through change, growth & complex people matters.
• Build a culture where people and business thrive together.

• Expertise in talent, performance, engagement & organizational development.
• A curious mind, commercial thinking, and the courage to ask the uncomfortable questions.

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.
Position Overview
The Manager, People Business Partner will play a strategic role in driving people strategy, organizational effectiveness, and a high performance culture for Ralph Lauren's Technology teams in India. This role partners closely with senior finance and sourcing leaders, centers of excellence (Talent, Total Rewards, Employee Learning Experience), and global People Partners to deliver business outcomes and elevate talent experience. The ideal candidate brings strong HR business partnering experience within a Finance and Sourcing environment, thrives in a matrixed global setup, and is passionate about shaping culture in a dynamic, fast growing function.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
•  Serve as a trusted advisor to India Finance & Sourcing leaders on people strategy, organizational design, and talent planning.

•  Partner globally to maintain alignment with Ralph Lauren's talent philosophy
•  Lead workforce planning, succession planning, and capability-building for the Finance & Sourcing function.
•  Identify skill gaps and partner with ELX to design tech-focused learning journeys.
•  Support change management efforts as the technology organization evolves.
•  Lead initiatives related to Inclusion, well-being, culture transformation, and employee engagement to foster a positive workplace environment.
Key Requirements
Experience, Skills & Knowledge
•  MBA in Human Resources from premium institute
•  8-12 years of HR experience with exposure of working in GCCs with matrix structures preferably supporting Finance/ Sourcing teams
•  Strong business acumen with the ability to influence senior leaders
•  Deep understanding of HR fundamentals: talent management, employee engagement, ER, workforce planning, performance management
•  Analytical mindset with comfort using dashboards and data insights

title: HR Business Partner
description:
About HireRight
We empower organizations around the world to hire with precision and act with confidence. As a global leader in background screening and workforce intelligence, we combine smart technology, human expertise, and a passion for delivering speed and accuracy to create a seamless experience for both employers and candidates. Headquartered in Nashville, TN, and operating in over 200 countries and territories, we’re proud to help millions of people get hired — the right way.
Overview
We are seeking a high‑impact HR Business Partner who is not only a strategic thought partner but also exceptionally strong with numbers, analytics, and business insights. This individual will play a critical role in shaping people strategy in India, driving organizational transformation, and enabling business performance across global teams.
The ideal candidate is business‑savvy, highly analytical, action‑oriented, comfortable making decisions, and skilled at navigating complex stakeholder relationships while managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
This role partners closely with business leadership as an HRBP and additionally oversees select site responsibilities related to workplace governance and employee experience.
Responsibilities
 Key Outcomes 
•  Strategic & Analytical Impact: HR strategies informed by deep data insights and business metrics, resulting in measurable improvements in productivity, talent health, and organizational performance. 
•  Leadership Influence: Strong advisory capabilities with senior leaders, backed by clear data storytelling and evidence‑based recommendations. 
•  Change Leadership: Successful execution of organizational change initiatives with agility, clarity, and stakeholder alignment. 
•  Operational Excellence: High‑quality delivery of global HR programs with local relevance – on time, with discipline, and with a focus on measurable outcomes. 
•  Employee Experience: Strengthened engagement and improved retention through proactive interventions grounded in data and business acumen. 
 Core Competencies 
•  Ownership & Accountability: Critical for the role 
•  Employee Relations & Employment Law Acumen: Demonstrates strong working knowledge of local labour laws and applies it to manage complex ER matters 
•  Business Acumen & Financial Understanding – Connects business metrics (revenue, productivity, cost drivers) with people strategies; translates data into actionable decisions. 
•  Data-Driven Decision Making – Strong ability to analyze workforce data, identify trends, diagnose issues, and propose data‑backed recommendations. 
•  Influencing & Stakeholder Management – Builds trust, manages senior stakeholders effectively, and drives alignment across global teams. 
•  Change Leadership – Leads transformation initiatives with clarity, structure, and measurable outcomes. 
•  Execution & Action Orientation – Moves quickly from insight to action, makes informed decisions, and manages multiple projects with precision. 
•  Cultural Intelligence – Navigates global and local cultural nuances to design inclusive and impactful HR solutions. 
•  Prioritization & Multitasking – Manages high volumes of work and parallel projects without compromising quality. 
Qualifications
Experience & Knowledge
•  Proven experience as an HR Business Partner in a global matrix environment. 
•  Hands‑on experience in talent management, workforce planning, organizational design, performance management, and change management. 
•  Demonstrated ability to use analytics, dashboards, and data tools to diagnose challenges and influence decisions. 
•  Strong understanding of global HR practices, local compliance, and evolving workforce trends. 
Measures of Success
•  Improvement in business performance indicators tied to HR interventions. 
•  Strong leadership advocacy and trust reflected through feedback and collaboration outcomes. 
•  Increased employee sentiment, stronger inclusion markers, and reduced regrettable attrition. 
•  Effective local deployment of global HR initiatives with minimal rework and strong stakeholder alignment. 
•  Timely delivery and quality of multiple HR projects and priorities. 
•  Demonstrated ability to make fast, informed decisions with clear rationale. 
Qualifications And Requirements
•  7-10+ years of progressive HR experience in a global or matrixed HRBP role. 
•  Strong numerical, analytical, and problem‑solving skills; ability to interpret and act on data. 
•  Proven capability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives. 
•  Experience in organizational design, talent management, and leading change. 
•  Excellent communication skills, including data‑backed storytelling. 
•  Ability to operate in a fast‑moving, deadline‑driven environment while managing multiple priorities. 
•  High degree of ownership, decision‑making ability, and action orientation. 
What Do We Offer
Please submit resume/CV in English.
All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.
HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.

About Cognizant Corporate
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.

You will be a key member of the Human Resources team, collaborating with Talent Partner Leads, business leaders, employees, and HR teams including International HR, Immigration, and Payroll. You will provide HR expertise and consulting to assigned business units, execute the business unit talent agenda, and support employee engagement, HR processes, and people-focused interventions while helping leaders and employees navigate day-to-day HR needs.
In This Role, You Will
•  Provide HR partnership for Director and above associates by supporting both strategic and tactical initiatives for assigned business units.
•  Build and maintain effective working relationships with leaders and employees while providing guidance on HR policies, interpretation, and business-related issues.
•  Drive retention and engagement interventions through regular discussions, town halls, pulse checks, manager huddles, and virtual engagement initiatives.
•  Support frontline manager enablement and career management activities, including manager programs, career conversations, skill architecture refreshers, and PIP tracking and closure.
•  Execute employee life-cycle processes such as merit increase, incentive administration, allowances, and YER grievance support.
•  Partner with HR teams including International HR, Immigration, and Payroll to deliver robust HR services for supported groups.
•  Manage employee queries and issues related to BAU processes, special initiatives, projects, and life-cycle events through objective and effective resolution.
•  Support location or country-specific operational activities while maintaining awareness of day-to-day compliance requirements.
Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.
What You Must Have To Be Considered
•  Experience in HR business partnering or a related HR role supporting business units and leaders.
•  Strong communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
•  Good understanding of HR processes across talent, engagement, and employee life-cycle activities.
•  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a positive attitude and drive.
•  Ability to interpret policy, manage issues objectively, and work collaboratively across HR teams.
•  A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
•  The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It.
These will help you succeed
•  Experience supporting senior stakeholders and leading employee engagement initiatives.
•  Ability to identify training needs and support executive coaching or development conversations.
•  Experience working across multiple HR service lines in a fast-paced environment.
Work model – Onsite
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring presence for 5 days in a client or Cognizant office across multiple locations in India.
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Principal HRBP, Amazon Stores India, Amazon Stores PXT
description:
Description
This role anchors PXT support for a set of Corporate Operations teams in India under Udit Madan — one of the most strategically dense Principal HRBP charters in Amazon India. Three businesses, each large enough to demand its own people strategy, each navigating a different kind of change at once: ASCS is in business transformation, SCOT is in team-and-org evolution, and the broader Corp Ops portfolio is consolidating its PXT support model alongside a multi-year, GenAI-led workforce transformation. The incumbent partners directly with multiple L8 leaders (tech and non-tech), sets the HR strategy for the combined client group, and operates with the autonomy and influence of a Principal — shaping org design, talent, culture, and workforce transformation rather than executing someone else’s plan. The connective tissue is the common disciplines — org design, span-of-control, leadership depth, talent movement, change leadership — applied to three distinct problems.
Key job responsibilities
•  Org design & planning: set HR strategy and goals for the client group; lead org design, succession, and change leadership across all three businesses within OP1/OP2/R&O/S-Team goals..
•  Talent management: drive forward-looking promotions, succession and top-talent movement incl. L7→L8; coach senior business and tech leaders; partner with Comp/Benefits/Stock in a high-mobility market.
•  Workforce planning: partner with Finance & Recruiting on OP1/OP2/R&O headcount; set sourcing strategy and strengthen the senior tech/science pipeline.
•  Data & culture: use Clarity to diagnose and influence; role-model Leadership Principles and preserve Day-1 culture through scale.
•  Function as a coach and consultant to key leaders and their respective organizations; engage in strategic planning meetings to translate business needs into HR plans.
•  Review and analyze business metrics including data on retention and employee experience to recommend systemic improvements and drive data-informed decisions.
•  Engage COE partners (HR Partner, Talent Management, Organizational Effectiveness, Talent Acquisition, Compensation) to define and tackle organizational obstacles and drive broader PXT initiatives.
•  Leverage data, functional expertise, and sound judgment to influence long-term decisions, drive organizational effectiveness, and evolve ways of working across both functions.
•  Explore and apply GenAI tools where they add value to HR work, combining AI with human expertise while maintaining transparency, accountability, and sound judgment.
About The Team
the Amazon Stores PXT team provides high leverage HRBP support to multiple Stores organization working closely with leaders owning global charters. The HRBPs are at forefront of driving the leadership vision for the teams and driving excellence at the site. They engage across Tech, Business, and Non Tech customer groups working on unique problems to drive higher productivity, better experience, and building strong leadership and culture.
Basic Qualifications
•  10+ years of human resources management, or 10+ years of human resources leadership experience
Preferred Qualifications
•  Knowledge of compensation/total rewards, talent management, performance management, compliance, and organization design and development

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
1. POSITION SUMMARY
The Talent Acquisition Manager will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition function for the Hotel Group across corporate, hotel operations, leadership and support functions.
The role will be responsible for ensuring the availability of the right talent, at the right time and at the right cost, in line with approved manpower budgets and business requirements.
The incumbent will work closely with Corporate HR, Property General Managers, Department Heads and Business Leaders to understand manpower requirements, source suitable candidates, manage the selection process and ensure timely joining.
The role will also lead talent pipelines, employer branding, campus hiring, recruitment analytics, agency management and pre-opening manpower requirements.
2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
A. Manpower Planning & Recruitment Strategy
• Understand annual and property-wise manpower requirements in coordination with Corporate HR and Operations.
• Develop recruitment plans based on approved manpower budgets and business expansion plans.
• Ensure recruitment is aligned with sanctioned positions and approved manpower budgets.
• Prepare hiring plans for existing properties, new openings, replacement positions and business expansion.
• Prioritise critical and business-sensitive positions.
• Develop recruitment strategies for different levels, from entry-level associates to senior management.
• Maintain an active talent pipeline for critical hotel positions.
B. End-to-End Talent Acquisition
Manage the complete recruitment cycle, including:
• Manpower requisition
• JD finalisation
• Candidate sourcing
• CV screening
• Initial HR discussion
• Interview coordination
• Interview feedback
• Salary discussion
• Reference/background checks
• Offer approval
• Offer release
• Candidate follow-up
• Joining coordination
• Documentation and onboarding handover
• Ensure candidates receive a professional and timely recruitment experience.
• Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the hiring process.
• Ensure no candidate progresses to the next stage without appropriate interview feedback and approval.
C. Leadership & Critical Hiring
• Manage recruitment for critical and leadership positions such as:
• General Managers
• Hotel Managers
• HODs
• Executive Chefs
• F&B Heads
• Sales & Marketing Heads
• Revenue Heads
• Finance Heads
• HR Heads
• Engineering Heads
• Corporate positions
• Build and maintain a strong network of hospitality professionals.
• Proactively identify passive candidates for critical positions.
• Conduct market mapping for senior and specialised roles.
• Maintain succession-oriented talent pipelines for key positions.
D. Hotel Operations Hiring
Ensure continuous recruitment support for:
Front Office
• Front Office Manager
• Duty Manager
• Reception
• Guest Relations
• Bell Desk
• Concierge
Housekeeping
• Executive Housekeeper
• Housekeeping Manager
• Supervisors
• Room Attendants
• Public Area Associates
Food & Beverage
• F&B Manager
• Restaurant Manager
• Bar Manager
• Banquet Manager
• Stewards
• Service Associates
Culinary
• Executive Chef
• Sous Chef
• CDP
• DCDP
• Commis
• Bakery & Pastry
• Specialty Chefs
Other Functions
• Engineering
• Finance
• HR
• Sales & Marketing
• Revenue
• Security
• Purchase
• Stores
• IT
3. PRE-OPENING & EXPANSION HIRING
• Develop manpower recruitment plans for new hotel openings.
• Create property-wise recruitment timelines and hiring trackers.
• Drive bulk hiring for new properties.
• Coordinate recruitment drives in different cities and locations.
• Support recruitment of local talent while ensuring required experience and skill levels.
• Coordinate pre-opening recruitment with Operations and HR teams.
• Track position-wise hiring status until the property reaches approved manpower strength.
• Ensure critical positions are closed within the agreed timelines before opening.
• Build local talent pools for upcoming properties.
4. CAMPUS & INSTITUTIONAL HIRING
• Develop relationships with hotel management institutes, universities and colleges.
• Plan and execute campus recruitment drives.
• Manage recruitment of:
• Management Trainees
• Hotel Management Graduates
• Interns
• Apprentices
• Freshers
• Operational trainees
• Develop partnerships with leading hospitality institutes.
• Conduct campus presentations, interviews and selection processes.
• Build a long-term campus talent pipeline.
• Maintain a database of high-potential hospitality graduates.
5. SOURCING STRATEGY
Develop multiple sourcing channels including:
• Employee referrals
• LinkedIn
• Job portals
• Hospitality recruitment platforms
• Social media
• Campus recruitment
• Recruitment agencies
• Professional networks
• Industry references
• Hospitality institutes
• Internal talent pipeline
• Direct sourcing
• Continuously evaluate the effectiveness and cost of different sourcing channels.
• Reduce dependency on external agencies wherever an internal talent pipeline can be developed.
6. RECRUITMENT AGENCY MANAGEMENT
• Identify and empanel appropriate recruitment agencies.
• Maintain a preferred agency panel by position/category.
• Negotiate recruitment fees and commercial terms.
• Monitor agency performance and candidate quality.
• Ensure agencies understand approved JDs, salary ranges and hiring requirements.
• Track agency-generated profiles and closures.
• Review agency performance periodically.
• Avoid duplicate submissions and uncontrolled agency sourcing.
7. CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT & QUALITY
• Ensure candidates are assessed against defined JDs, KRAs and competency requirements.
• Conduct structured initial screening.
• Evaluate candidate experience, stability, functional competence, career progression and cultural fit.
• Ensure complete interview feedback is obtained from interviewers.
• Clearly document whether the candidate is recommended / not recommended / on hold, along with supporting feedback.
• Ensure salary, notice period and joining availability are accurately captured.
• Maintain quality standards rather than focusing only on recruitment volume.
8. OFFER MANAGEMENT & JOINING
• Coordinate salary discussions within approved compensation structures.
• Obtain required approvals before releasing offers.
• Ensure offer letters are released within defined TAT.
• Maintain regular follow-up with selected candidates until joining.
• Track offer acceptance, dropouts and joining ratios.
• Identify reasons for offer decline and candidate dropouts.
• Maintain a joining tracker for all open positions.
• Ensure proper handover to HR Operations / Property HR for onboarding.
9. RECRUITMENT TAT & PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT
Establish and monitor recruitment TAT for different categories:
Position CategoryIndicative TAT

7–15 days
Supervisory Positions
15–21 days
HOD Positions
21–30 days
Managerial Positions
30–45 days
Senior Leadership
45–60 days
Critical / Specialised Positions
As per business requirement
• Monitor open positions daily.
• Escalate positions exceeding agreed TAT.
• Maintain a position-wise recruitment tracker.
• Ensure regular updates to hiring managers and Corporate HR.
• Develop corrective action plans for delayed positions.
10. EMPLOYER BRANDING
• Support development of the hotel's employer brand.
• Promote the organisation as an employer of choice within the hospitality industry.
• Develop recruitment communication and career content.
• Showcase employee stories, career growth opportunities and organisational culture.
• Support social media campaigns for hiring.
• Participate in hospitality job fairs and industry events.
• Build relationships with hospitality professionals and talent communities.
11. RECRUITMENT ANALYTICS & MIS
Prepare and maintain regular recruitment reports covering:
• Total open positions
• Sanctioned positions
• Profiles received
• Profiles shortlisted
• Interviews conducted
• Candidates selected
• Offers released
• Offers accepted
• Candidates joined
• Offer dropouts
• Joining dropouts
• Position-wise TAT
• Source-wise hiring
• Agency performance
• Recruitment cost
• Critical vacancies
• Ageing vacancies
Prepare weekly and monthly Talent Acquisition dashboards for Corporate HR and Management.
12. COST CONTROL
• Manage recruitment expenditure within approved budgets.
• Monitor agency fees and recruitment costs.
• Analyse cost per hire.
• Optimise sourcing channels based on cost and quality.
• Increase direct sourcing and employee referral hiring.
• Ensure compensation offered remains within approved salary structures.
• Escalate exceptional salary requirements for approval.
13. EMPLOYEE REFERRAL PROGRAMME
• Develop and manage an effective employee referral programme.
• Communicate critical hiring requirements across the Group.
• Track referrals and conversions.
• Ensure timely referral incentive processing as per policy.
• Use employee networks to improve quality and speed of hiring.
14. HRMS / ATS & PROCESS AUTOMATION
• Ensure all recruitment data is accurately maintained in the HRMS / Applicant Tracking System.
• Maintain proper candidate records and recruitment status.
• Develop standard recruitment workflows and trackers.
• Use technology and automation to improve recruitment efficiency.
• Ensure data confidentiality and appropriate access controls.
• Generate recruitment dashboards and analytics from the system.
15. COMPLIANCE & GOVERNANCE
• Ensure recruitment processes comply with Group HR policies.
• Maintain proper documentation for all recruitment decisions.
• Ensure background/reference verification as applicable.
• Maintain confidentiality of candidate information and compensation data.
• Ensure no candidate is onboarded without appropriate approvals.
• Follow approved manpower and compensation structures.

Emphasis will be on building pipelines for leadership roles across functions/businesses and other emerging global capability roles.
The Regional TA Manager will support the identification and hiring of high-quality talent for SATS Ltd. across APAC and selected global functions, being based in India.
Key Responsibilities
1. Global & APAC Talent Acquisition
• Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned APAC and global positions, from intake discussion through offer and onboarding coordination.
• Partner with hiring managers to understand:
• Role requirements
• Critical competencies
• Technical/functional skills
• Market availability
• Location strategy
• Candidate profile
• Recruit across multiple markets, cultures and time zones.
• Manage multiple specialist and leadership searches simultaneously while maintaining hiring quality and candidate experience.
• Build talent pipelines for anticipated business and capability requirements.
2. Strategic Sourcing & Talent Mapping
• Proactively identify passive talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, referrals, talent communities, industry associations and targeted market mapping.
• Conduct talent intelligence and competitor mapping for critical and hard-to-fill positions.
• Build talent pools for recurring and future global requirements.
• Map relevant external talent across:
• Aviation and air cargo
• Logistics and supply chain
• Food solutions
• Technology and digital
• Commercial
• Finance and corporate functions
• Human Capital
• Reduce dependence on recruitment agencies through strong direct-sourcing capability.
3. Hiring Manager & Stakeholder Partnership
• Act as a Talent Acquisition advisor, rather than simply a recruitment coordinator.
• Work effectively with senior stakeholders based in Singapore, India and other APAC/global locations.
• Conduct structured role-intake meetings and translate business requirements into practical sourcing strategies.
• Provide stakeholders with fact-based views on:
• Talent availability
• Candidate expectations
• Hiring challenges
• Notice periods
• Compensation competitiveness
• Location considerations
• Maintain regular recruitment dashboards and pipeline reviews with hiring managers.
This is particularly relevant to the current India hiring environment. Internal recruitment discussions note that manager-and-above candidates in India can have approximately three-month notice periods, making proactive pipeline management important.
4. Candidate Assessment & Selection
• Conduct initial candidate screening and structured competency-based interviews.
• Assess candidates against technical requirements, leadership competencies, experience and organizational fit.
• Prepare concise candidate assessments for hiring managers.
• Coordinate panel interviews and selection processes across different countries/time zones.
• Support reference and pre-employment processes in partnership with relevant HC teams.
• Maintain strong engagement with shortlisted candidates throughout potentially long notice periods.
5. Offer Management & Candidate Conversion
• Partner with HC and hiring leaders on offer development and candidate closure.
• Understand candidate motivations, competing opportunities and potential joining risks.
• Support compensation discussions with appropriate internal stakeholders.
• Maintain engagement from offer acceptance through joining.
• Track offer declines, dropouts and counter-offer risks and identify improvement opportunities.
6. Global Capability
• Support recruitment of global positions that are based in India but serve regional or global stakeholders.
• Build targeted talent pools from established GCCs, technology companies, consulting organizations and multinational businesses.
• Help position India as a credible source of high-quality global talent.
• Support the development of India as a long-term talent and capability hub for SATS.
7. Recruitment Analytics & Governance
Maintain and periodically report key recruitment metrics, including:
• Time to shortlist
• Time to offer
• Time to fill
• Offer-to-accept ratio
• Offer-to-join ratio
• Source effectiveness
• Direct sourcing percentage
• Recruitment cost
• Pipeline conversion
• Candidate dropout/decline reasons
• Hiring manager and candidate feedback
Use recruitment data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
8. Employer Branding & Talent Engagement
• Represent SATS consistently and professionally in the external talent market.
• Communicate the company's global scale, business platforms and career opportunities to prospective candidates.
• Partner on LinkedIn, recruitment campaigns, talent events and targeted employer-brand initiatives.
• Build relationships with relevant professional communities and specialist talent networks.
• Deliver a high-quality candidate experience regardless of hiring outcome.
Candidate Profile
Education
• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Management or related discipline.
• Postgraduate HR qualification/MBA preferred
Experience
• 8-12 years of Talent Acquisition/recruitment experience.
• Demonstrable experience recruiting across APAC and/or international markets.
• Experience in a multinational, GCC, global shared-services, aviation, logistics, technology, consulting or similarly complex environment strongly preferred.
• Experience directly sourcing specialist and managerial talent rather than relying predominantly on recruitment agencies.
• Exposure to senior/leadership hiring preferred.
Technical / Functional Competencies
The successful candidate should demonstrate:
• End-to-end recruitment expertise
• Advanced sourcing capability
• LinkedIn Recruiter / Boolean search proficiency
• Talent mapping and market intelligence
• Competency-based interviewing
• Stakeholder and hiring-manager management
• Offer negotiation and candidate closure
• Recruitment analytics
• ATS/recruitment technology proficiency
• Employer branding awareness
Critical Success Attributes
The individual should be:
• Commercially minded: understands that recruitment is ultimately about enabling business outcomes.
• Consultative: comfortable challenging or advising hiring managers using market evidence.
• Globally oriented: able to work effectively across cultures and geographies.
• Strong networker: capable of creating talent pipelines before vacancies arise.
• Hands-on: personally comfortable sourcing and engaging candidates.
• Data driven: uses recruitment analytics to influence decisions.
• Highly responsive: able to manage priorities across different time zones.
• Candidate focused: maintains a professional and engaging experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Adaptable: comfortable operating in a growing global capability environment where requirements may evolve rapidly.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
Position: Talent Acquisition Lead
Location: Mumbai
️ Working Days: Minday to Friday
Experience Required: 8-15 years
Talent Acquisition Lead
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS
The company has grown from ₹2 Crore PAT to ₹181 Crore PAT in six years. Its networth has crossed ₹1,000 Crore. It has built 8 fast growing business verticals from the ground up. And it has achieved this with one belief, the right people, in the right roles, with the right ownership, can build anything.
But here is the truth: growth has outpaced the ability to hire at the speed and quality needed. The company is hiring across every vertical: Retail Broking, Investment Banking, Institutional Equities, AIF, PMS, Wealth Management, Compliance, Technology, and its upcoming AMC. Each role demands a specific kind of person - not just qualified, but entrepreneurial. Not just experienced, but hungry.
The company doesn't need an HR recruiter. It needs a Talent Acquisition Lead who thinks like a CEO, someone who understands that every hire either accelerates or slows down the company, and treats recruitment with that level of seriousness.
The Company Context — What Makes This Role Different
This is not a 10,000-employee company where hiring is a volume game. This is a high growth, high conviction platform where every hire is visible, every person matters.
A Few Things You Should Know Before You Apply
• Lowest attrition rate in the industry. People don't leave the company. Your job is to ensure the people who join are the reason others stay, not the reason they leave. 
• 8 verticals, each with distinct hiring needs. A Research Analyst is a fundamentally different hire from a Deal Originator or a Compliance Head. You need to understand every business deeply enough to know what "great" looks like in each role. 
• We have never hired through advertising. Every senior hire has come through networks, referrals, and direct outreach. You need to build and own those pipelines. 
Key Responsibilities 
•  Talent Strategy & Planning
• Own the entire talent acquisition function end-to-end, from workforce planning and JD creation to sourcing, screening, offer negotiation, and onboarding handoff. 
• Work directly with the CEO and business heads to understand hiring priorities, role requirements, and the specific DNA of candidates who succeed in the company, not just on paper, but in its culture. 
•  Sourcing & Outreach
• Develop a direct sourcing engine - headhunting, industry mapping, passive candidate outreach, alumni networks, conference networking. 
•  Screening & Quality Control
• Implement a rigorous screening process that filters for three things: competence, culture fit, and ownership mindset. Technical skills get you in the door. Attitude determines if you stay. 
•  Individual Contribution
• 
• While you lead a small team, you also personally drive the CXO and senior level hiring for the organization to find the right fit leaders for its next phase of growth. 
What We're Looking For
Parameter Requirement Experience 8-15 years in talent acquisition, with at least 3 years heading the function. Financial services experience strongly preferred. Industry Understanding Must understand the financial services talent landscape - broking, investment banking, research, compliance, fund management. Sourcing Expertise Proven track record of direct sourcing and headhunting for senior/niche roles. Tools Proficient in LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, recruitment analytics. Advanced Excel for MIS. Education MBA in HR / Postgraduate in Human Resources preferred. Location Mumbai

title: Management Trainee - Finance
description:
NEOLYTIX
Management Trainee, Finance (FP&A)
Finance & Accounts | Fresher Opportunity | Gurugram QUALIFICATION
MBA In FinanceEXPERIENCE
FresherLOCATION
Gurugram (Onsite)SHIFT
1:30 PM–10:30 PM ISTREPORTS INTO
Sr. Manager ⚠ Shift: This role operates on a 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST schedule, onsite at our Gurugram office, 5 days a week. Please apply only if you are comfortable with this window. ⚠ Education Gate: MBA with Finance as the primary specialization is mandatory. 12th in the Commerce stream (CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent) is required. Applications without this background will not be considered.
About The Role
Neolytix is a US-headquartered healthcare managed services organization serving 270+ provider organizations across Revenue Cycle Management, Credentialing, Medical Coding, and Payer Analytics, with delivery centers in Gurugram, Manila, and Chicago.
If you chose Finance as your MBA specialization because you find budgeting, financial planning, and business performance analysis genuinely interesting, and not just because it was available, this role is worth reading in full.
As a Management Trainee in our Finance and Accounts team, you will work directly under the Senior Manager, Finance on Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) activities. This is a hands-on, learn-while-you-do role. You will not shadow someone else's work. You will contribute to real financial reporting, variance analysis, and planning cycles from your first month, with structured guidance and training built into the role. After six months, on successful completion of the probation period, you transition to Associate.
What is FP&A?
Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) is the function inside a company that answers three questions: what did we plan to spend and earn, what did we actually spend and earn, and why is there a gap? FP&A teams own budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and variance analysis. They are the finance team's link between raw numbers and business decisions. This is the work you will be doing and learning.
Career Path
Management Trainee
First 6 Months (Probation)Associate, Finance
Post ProbationSenior Associate & Beyond
Performance-Linked Growth
Key Responsibilities2. Reporting & MIS3. Forecasting & Variance Analysis4. Month-End Close Support5. Compliance & Data Management
•  Financial Planning & Budgeting Support
• Assist in compiling annual and quarterly budget templates by gathering inputs from department heads
• Track budget submissions, flag inconsistencies, and follow up on missing data
• Prepare actuals vs budget comparison reports and highlight key variances for review
• Prepare monthly MIS reports and financial dashboards for management review
• Assist in building P&L summaries, cost-centre reports, and expense trackers
• Maintain and update financial reporting templates in Excel, ensuring accuracy and consistency
• Support the rolling forecast process by collecting data inputs and updating financial models
• Perform variance analysis (actual vs budget vs forecast) and write clear summaries of key findings
• Help identify cost drivers and revenue trends from operational and financial data
• Support the month-end close process: accruals, provisions, and expense reconciliations
• Coordinate with accounts payable and receivable teams to collect required data inputs
• Maintain documentation and audit trails for all finance activities you are involved in
• Maintain accurate financial records and ensure data integrity across reports and trackers
• Ensure adherence to company financial policies and internal control procedures
• Support internal and external audit requirements as and when needed
What You Will Learn
This role comes with structured on-the-job training alongside your work. Over your first six months, you will be trained on:
• FP&A workflows: how budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis work in a live business environment
• Advanced Excel for finance: pivot tables, dynamic dashboards, formula-based financial models, and data reconciliation techniques
• US healthcare business context: how revenue cycle operations generate financial data and what drives performance
• Professional finance reporting: how to structure numbers into insights that leadership can act on
What You Bring
Must-Have
• MBA with Finance as the primary or first specialization. This is non-negotiable
• 12th in the Commerce stream (CBSE, ICSE, or equivalent board). Mandatory
• Strong academic record. A consistent performance history across 12th and graduation is expected
• Working knowledge of MS Excel. You should be able to build and navigate spreadsheets independently
• Strong numerical aptitude and attention to detail. A wrong number in a financial report is not a minor error
• Good written and spoken English. You will be coordinating with internal teams and presenting findings
Strong Preference
• Basic understanding of financial statements: P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow. Even from coursework
• Any internship or project work involving financial analysis, MIS, budgeting, or accounts
• Familiarity with variance analysis or management reporting concepts
Nice-to-Have
• Exposure to ERP or accounting software such as Tally, SAP, or QuickBooks
• Basic awareness of financial modelling or data analysis tools
Who You Are
• You chose Finance, not just MBA. This is the field you want to build a career in, and FP&A is where you want to start
• Numbers bother you when they are off. You catch the error before someone else does
• You ask why a number moved, not just what it is. Curiosity about business performance is natural to you
• You are structured in how you think and communicate. Whether it is an Excel sheet or a verbal update, you present clearly
• You take ownership of your work and meet your deadlines without needing to be reminded
Eligibility Criteria
• Education: MBA in Finance (primary specialization) is mandatory. 12th in Commerce stream is mandatory. Both are non-negotiable
• Academic record: A strong, consistent academic background is expected. 70% or above in both 12th and graduation is preferred
• Batch: Freshers and recent graduates. Up to 1 year of experience (including internships) is acceptable
• Tier: Graduates from recognized universities across India, including tier 2 institutions, are encouraged to apply
• Shift: 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST, onsite in Gurugram, 5 days a week. Non-negotiable
• Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred
Selection Process
• Round 1: HR Screening. Profile review against education gate and eligibility criteria
• Round 2: Finance Assessment. Aptitude and concept test conducted at the Gurugram office, covering financial concepts, numerical reasoning, and Excel basics
• Round 3: Interview with the Senior Manager, Finance covering academic background, finance knowledge, and analytical approach
• Round 4: CEO Connect
Why Join Neolytix
Real FP&A Work from Month One
You are not shadowing someone else's work. You contribute to live budgeting, forecasting, and reporting cycles with structured guidance.Learn from a Finance Leader
Direct day-to-day mentorship from the Senior Manager, Finance. Feedback is part of the role, not an annual event.Global Business Exposure
Work on financial data from US healthcare operations. The business context you build here is hard to find at the fresher level.Clear Path Forward
Management Trainee to Associate after 6 months, then Senior Associate and beyond, based on performance, not time served.

title: Management Trainee
description:
At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA
Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.
AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.
CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.
AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.
Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)
We are seeking highly motivated and analytically driven individuals to join our Trading & Treasury function of AMINA. This program is designed to provide a structured and accelerated learning journey across trading & trading systems, treasury and quantitative research. As a Management Trainee, you will gain exposure to global financial and digital asset markets, trading operations, market-making activities, pricing methodologies, and risk management frameworks. Through hands-on experience, mentorship, and rotational assignments, you will develop the skills required to progress into specialized roles within Spot Trading, Derivatives Trading, eTrading or Quantitative Research. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates passionate about financial markets, technology, quantitative analysis, and trading strategies to build a long-term career in a fast-paced and innovative environment.
Your AMINA To-Do List
• Gain hands-on exposure to spot trading, market-making and the trade lifecycle across global markets.
• Develop an understanding of financial markets, including digital assets, foreign exchange, commodities, derivatives and other financial products.
• Monitor market developments and contribute to market research, analysis and internal reporting.
• Support analysis of market data and contribute to projects involving quantitative analysis, automation and technology-enabled trading solutions.
• Build a strong understanding of how trading, liquidity, risk and technology come together to support AMINA’s global business.
• Take ownership of learning opportunities and contribute to projects that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the function.
Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:
Must Have:
• MBA in Finance or related disciplines from a reputable institution.
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or another quantitative discipline.
• Prior internship or work experience in Trading, Treasury, Risk Management, Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Quantitative Research, or Asset Management.
• Understanding of financial instruments, including FX, commodities, fixed income, equities, derivatives, or digital assets.
• Strong quantitative aptitude with the ability to interpret market data and identify trends. • Strong communication and presentation skills.
• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Willingness to work in a 24/7 market environment, including rotational evening, night, and weekend shifts when required.
Good to Have:
• Knowledge of blockchain technology, digital assets, and cryptocurrency markets.
• Exposure to trading & treasury functions.
• Familiarity with trading platforms, market data systems, and quantitative research tools .
Why We’re Awesome
We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!
Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Management Trainee (Immediate Joiners Only)
description:
Company: Sushine Exports Private Limited (factori.com) 
Location: Bangalore, Karnataka 
Employment Type: Full-time 
Joining: Immediate
About factori.com
factori.com is a technology-driven platform that enables businesses to launch and scale through three core verticals — Ready-to-Ship products, Contract Manufacturing, and Retailing. We are building India's next-generation commerce infrastructure that empowers retailers, manufacturers, and brands to grow faster and smarter.
About the Role
We are looking for ambitious, high-energy Management Trainees to join our growing team. This is an opportunity to get hands-on exposure across multiple business functions — from sales and marketing to fulfilment, procurement, and contract manufacturing — right from day one.
As a Management Trainee, you will work directly with the leadership team, take on real responsibilities, and contribute meaningfully to building and scaling factori.com. Based on your interests, strengths, and performance, you will be assigned to a specific function where you can grow into a full-time leadership role.
What You'll Do
• Work closely with the founders and leadership team on day-to-day business operations
• Get hands-on experience across key functions, including sales, marketing, fulfilment, procurement, and contract manufacturing
• Take ownership of projects and deliverables from your very first week
• Interact with retailers, manufacturers, and partners to understand and solve real business problems
• Contribute ideas, identify opportunities, and help shape the growth strategy of factori.com
Whom We're Looking For
• Graduates or post-graduates in B.Com, BBM, BBA, B.Tech, M.Com, or MBA from a recognised university
• Must have completed graduation/post-graduation (final-year students awaiting results are not eligible)
• Freshers welcome — prior experience is a plus, but not required
• Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn
• Self-starters who are comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
• Passionate about e-commerce, retail, or manufacturing
• Available to join immediately
Compensation & Growth
• Salary: Rs. 25,000 per month during the 6-month training period
• Performance Review: At the end of 6 months, trainees will receive a salary increment and promotion based on their performance
• Career Path: Opportunity to grow into functional roles in sales, marketing, operations, procurement, or business development based on your strengths and interests
Why Join factori.com?
• Work directly with the company's leadership — no layers, no red tape
• Real ownership and responsibility from day one, not just observation
• Be part of a company that is building something new in India's commerce space
• Fast-track your career — your growth here is limited only by your performance

title: Management Trainee - Target Market Management
description:
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing and protecting in the building sector and manufacturing industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 104 countries, manufactures in 400+ factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers around the world that facilitate the sustainable transformation of the construction and manufacturing industries. With more than 33,000 employees, the company generated annual sales of CHF 11,2 billion in 2023.
Sika In India
In India, the company started its operations in 1985 and was known as Qualcrete India Limited. In 1987, Qualcrete India Limited forged an alliance with Sika AG, Switzerland and was renamed as Sika Qualcrete Limited. In 2002, Sika AG, Switzerland acquired 100% stake in the company  and since then the company has been rechristened as Sika India Pvt. Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Sika AG.
Sika Automotive & Industry Business delivers innovative solutions to the world’s leading manufacturers and service providers in automotive OEM, commercial vehicles, automotive aftermarket, marine vessels, renewable energy, sandwich panels, industrial equipment, HVAC, home and commercial appliances, modular building, facades and fenestration. Sika India services direct customers and distributors and stay close to them via the central sales & marketing office in Pune, and a pan India sales team presence.
Job Description
• Generate qualified project leads by reviewing Biltrax, GlobalData, IRR and other databases. 
• Prepare priced BOQs to support the specification team in submissions. 
• Monitor sales pipeline health and publish dashboards for Target Market Managers. 
• Maintain trackers for key Target Market initiatives and follow up on progress. 
• Support TM Engineering with refurbishment product management tasks and documentation. 
• Keep the TM SharePoint updated with all relevant data, documents, and trackers. 
Qualifications
BE | BTech (Civil | Mechanical | Chemical ) + MBA (Sales and Marketing)
Additional Information
We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training.  We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

About Us
Visit Health is a pioneering HealthTech platform founded by four BITS Pilani alumni with a mission to democratize healthcare. Since launching as a telemedicine platform in 2016, we've evolved into an end-to-end healthcare ecosystem delivering preventive care, primary healthcare, holistic wellness, condition management, and care services to 80 lakh+ Indians through a network of 80,000+ doctors, 25,000+ hospitals & clinics, 8,500+ diagnostic centres, and 5,500+ pharmacies.
Today, Visit Health partners with 500+ enterprises, 7,000+ SMEs, and 22+ leading insurers to deliver seamless healthcare experiences through cashless OPD benefits, preventive health programs, Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), chronic care management, diagnostics, pharmacy services, and digital wellness solutions.
Our technology-first platform integrates effortlessly with enterprise systems through HRMS integrations, SingleSign-On (SSO), API-based insurer & TPA integrations, customizable benefit configurations, and real-time analytics, enabling organizations to build personalized healthcare ecosystems for their workforce.
Backed by $40 million in funding and recognized by leading industry bodies, we're building the future of accessible, affordable, and preventive healthcare for millions of Indians.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Why Join Us?
• Work with one of India's rapidly growing HealthTech companies.
• High ownership and steep learning curve.
• Opportunity to build relationships with leading insurance and healthcare partners.
• Exposure to enterprise sales and strategic partnerships.
• Fast-paced, collaborative, and growth-oriented culture.

title: International Graduate Program (IGP) -Specialist – SMD – Sales and Business Development
description:
Are you ready to accelerate your career with a global leader in the tech industry? As a pioneer in semiconductor solutions, Infineon invites you to join us enabling the shift towards a carbon-neutral world, empowering a connected and sustainable future. The International Graduate Program (IGP) at Infineon is a unique opportunity to fast-track your development and become a future expert in your field. Over 18 months, you'll embark on a journey that takes you to at least three different assignments at three different departments, including one abroad. As a global company with a local presence, Infineon offers a unique blend of international collaboration and regional expertise which you’ll become part of. This program is designed to give you a deep understanding of our company, its operations, and yourself as well, given you’ll become aware of what are your strengths and weaknesses by working on different departments.
Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
Sales and Business Development
•  Support account managers in managing strategic customer relationships.
• Identify and evaluate new business opportunities across target market segments.
• Conduct market and competitive analyses to support growth strategies.
•  Assist in customer engagements, business reviews, and sales planning activities.
• Support demand forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity tracking.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer requirements are effectively addressed.
• Prepare customer presentations, business cases, and management reports.
Application Marketing Insights
•  Support the development of application-focused marketing strategies for key market segments. Analyze market trends, customer requirements, and competitive positioning. 
•  Collaborate with product marketing, application engineering, and sales teams.
•  Assist in defining value propositions and go-to-market strategies.
• Support customer workshops, industry events, and product launches
• Develop marketing collateral, presentations, and application success stories.
• Contribute to market sizing and business opportunity assessments.
•  Learning Outcomes
• Deep understanding of semiconductor applications and market ecosystems
•  Strategic marketing and value proposition development.
• Customer-centric solution positioning and commercialization
Digital Customer Interface
• Support initiatives that enhance digital customer engagement and experience.
•  Analyze customer interaction data to identify improvement opportunities.
•  Collaborate with digital sales, e-commerce, CRM, and customer experience teams.
• Support implementation of digital tools and customer-facing platforms.
• Monitor digital performance metrics and prepare management insights.
• Participate in digital transformation and process improvement projects
• Assist in developing customer journey maps and engagement strategies.
Your profile
Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
• You are curious and interested in a broad range of topics. You don’t expect things to be handed to you on a silver platter – you go search for them. You love change – which is guaranteed in the semiconductor industry. You are pragmatic and analytic, because we need both at Infineon. Standing still is not your thing. You find inspiration in teamwork, collaborating with your colleagues on the big picture. You can confidently lead and drive results in your field, leveraging your skills and expertise to achieve success.
Plus, you fulfill the following qualifications:
• You have a degree in BE in Electronics and Communication or Electricals
• MBA (Sales or Marketing) is must.
• You thrive in an agile working environment, effortlessly adapting and collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.
• Speak and write fluent English 
• If this is you, then we want to make it easy for you to apply: All we need is your CV and your relevant certificates, such as your final university degree or your most recent university transcripts. Also, tell us a bit more about your motivation for applying in a short cover letter. Convince us with your personality, special skills and experiences.
#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?
We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.
Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

title: DELHI/NCR Fresh MBA Graduate - Pricing Analyst
description:
About the job
At Monetizely, we specialise in driving scalable growth for high-growth SaaS companies by providing tailored pricing strategies that align with both market needs and business objectives. Our approach is grounded in practical insights and backed by extensive industry expertise. With clients ranging from startups to post-IPO companies, we’ve successfully helped businesses achieve sustainable revenue growth through strategic pricing models. As we continue to expand our footprint, we are seeking fresh MBA graduates with a keen interest in data analysis, business strategy, and a desire to grow with us. This is a fantastic opportunity to start your career at a company that thrives on innovation and offers ample opportunities for personal and professional development.
Responsibilities
• Excel Math Modeling: Leverage your analytical skills to work with complex data sets, building advanced Excel models for pricing strategies and financial forecasting. You will be expected to clean, analyze, and interpret large volumes of data to provide actionable insights.
• Presentation Creation: Develop clear, structured, and visually appealing presentations that effectively communicate technical and business insights to internal teams and clients. You'll need to present confidently and ensure clarity in all deliverables.
• English Communication: Demonstrate exceptional English communication skills, with a primary focus on clear and concise writing. Your ability to articulate complex ideas in writing is crucial, alongside polished verbal communication.
• Diligence & Professionalism: Display a professional, deadline-oriented approach to all tasks. We value a learning mindset with no "chalta hai" attitude—our team thrives on excellence and accountability.
• Vision for Growth: Be proactive in your personal and professional development. We're looking for individuals with a clear ambition for growth, who are eager to learn and contribute to our mission of delivering top-tier pricing solutions.
Qualifications
• Education: MBA or another relevant postgraduate degree from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution, preferably in Strategy, Finance, Economics, Business, or Analytics.
• Academic Excellence: Outstanding academic track record, with consistently strong performance throughout education.
• Analytical Skills: Advanced Excel proficiency, with experience in complex data analysis, financial modeling, and quantitative research.
• Research & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and structured thinking, with exposure to conjoint analysis, pricing research, or similar quantitative methodologies preferred.
• Presentation Skills: Excellent PowerPoint skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into compelling, insight-driven presentations and tell a clear story through data.
• Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and professionally.
• Work Ethic: Highly diligent, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering accurate, high-quality work.
• Growth Mindset: Intellectual curiosity, a strong willingness to learn, and the ambition to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth consulting environment.
Why Join Monetizely?
• Be part of a pioneering company specializing in SaaS pricing strategies that drive real impact.
• Work with an innovative team that values creativity, analytics, and strategic growth.
• Hands-on experience with clients ranging from startups to post-IPO companies.
• Ample opportunities for continuous learning, career development, and leadership growth.
• A collaborative, high-performance environment where your contributions directly influence business outcomes.
